dbang po'i sgo sdom pa dang / ngag 'jam pa rnams mtshan ma'i rnam g.yeng dang / tshul 'chos dang kha gsag tu gsungs so/ /des na kun slong la rtog pa gal che bas dus rgyun du rang sems dge mi dge brtags shing spong len byed pa'i bram ze sgra mkhan dang / dge bshes 'ban dang / kyi dpe grags rin dpon slob lta bu re byed dgos so/ /des na/ re zhig dang por 'di 'dra'i sems/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar mi dge bas ma gos par bya/ gal te gos na'ang / mi dge ba las sdug bsngal 'byung / /de las ji ltar nges thar zhes/ /sdig pa sbyong ba la 'bad nas/ /bdag la phyis 'di mi 'byung bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ phyin chad mi dge bas ma gos par byas la/ de bas dge la mos bya zhing / /gus pa nyid du bsgrub par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dge ba phra zhing phra ba nas dang du blang ngo / /de ltar dge sdig phra mo nas blang dor bya ba la 'bad dgos/ sngar de ltar ma byas pas 'khor ba dang ngan song du 'khyams pa yin no/ /bdag ni sngon dang da ltar yang / /chos la mos dang bral ba yis/ /phongs pa 'di 'dra byung gyur na/ /su zhig chos la mos pa gtong / /zhes so/ /da dung yang brtson par ma byas na 'khor ba dang ngan song du 'khyam ste/ deng nas brtson par ma byas na/ /'og nas 'og tu 'gro bar 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /'o na 'khor ba dang ngan song du 'khyams na skyon dang nyes dmigs ci yod snyam na/ shin tu mang ste/ de la gnyis/ 'gro drug so so'i nyes pa bsam pa dang / 'khor ba spyi'i nyes pa bsam pa'o/ /dang po ni/ 'gro ba ris drug las/ dmyal ba ni/ tsha ba'i dmyal ba brgyad/ grang ba'i dmyal ba brgyad/ nye 'khor ba dang nyi tshe ba ste dmyal khams bco brgyad do/ /de la tsha dmyal brgyad ni/ yang sos/ thig nag bsdus 'joms/ ngu 'bod/ ngu 'bod chen po/ tsha ba/ rab tu tsha ba/ mnar med rnams so/ /grang dmyal brgyad ni/ chu bur can/ chu bur rdol ba/ a chu zer ba/

kyi hud zer ba/ so tham tham pa/ ut+pal ltar gas pa/ pad+ma ltar gas ba/ pad+ma ltar cher gas pa rnams so/ /de dag tu skyes pa'i sdug bsngal la gcig gis gcig gsod pa dang / dmyal srung pas gsheg pa dang / gtub pa dang / brdung ba dang / 'tshed pa dang / bsreg pa la sogs pa dang / grang bas nyen nas chu bur byung ba la sogs pa dang / me ma mur gyi 'obs las brgal ba la sogs pa sdug bsngal dpag tu med pa 'byung ste/ sems can nyes par spyad pa spyod rnams la/ /yang sos thig nag rab tu tsha ba dang / /bsdus 'joms ngu 'bod mnar med la sogs pa'i/ /dmyal ba rnams su rtag tu sdug bsngal 'gyur/ /'di na nyin gcig mdung thung sum brgya yis/ /rab tu drag btab sdug bsngal gang lags pa/ /de ni dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal chung ngu yi'ang / /'ol yang mi bzod char yang mi phod do/ /zhes dang / dmyal ba bris pa mthong dang thos pa dang / /dran dang bsams dang gzugs su bgyis pas kyang / /'jigs pa skyed par bgyid na mi bzad pa'i/ /rnam smin nyams su myong na smos ci 'tshal/ /zhes dang / kha cig til bzhin 'tshir te de bzhin gzhan/ /phye ma zhib mo bzhin du phye mar rlog /kha cig sog les 'dra ste de bzhin gzhan/ /sta re mi bzad rnon po rnams kyis gsheg /de bzhin gzhan dag khro chu bzhus pa yi/ /khu ba 'bar ba 'khrigs pa ldud par bgyid/ /kha cig lcags kyi gsal shing rab 'bar ba/ /tsher ma can la kun tu brgyud par bgyid/ /ces sogs sdug bsngal gyi bye brag mang du gsungs shing / gzhan yang dran pa nyer gzhag sogs dang / bshes spring slob spring sogs kyi mdo bstan bcos man ngag rnams las shes par bya'o/ /de ltar sdug bsngal shin tu mi bzad lo/ /bye ba phrag brgyar nyams su myong yang ni/ /ji srid mi dge de zad ma gyur pa/ /de srid srog dang 'bral bar mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs shing / /tshe'i tshad kyang / yang sos la sogs drug rim bzhin/

/'dod lha'i tshe dang nyin zhag mnyam/ /zhes gsungs shing / 'dod lha'i tshe yang / mi rnams lo ni lnga bcu la/ /'dod pa dag gi lha rnams las/ /'og ma dag gi nyin zhag gcig /des na tshe lo lnga brgya'o/ /gong ma gnyis ka nyis 'gyur ro/ /rab tu tsha phyed mnar med ni/ /bar gyi bskal pa'o zhes gsungs shing / grang dmyal gyi tshe tshad ni/ til rdzangs nang nas lo brgya zhing / /til gcig phyung bas zad 'gyur ba/ /chu bur can gyi tshe yin te/ /gzhan gyi tshe ni nyi shur 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /de ltar dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal dang tshe tshad shes par byas te bsams pas der skye yis dogs te 'jigs na de'i rgyu mi dge bcu spong ba zhig gzod 'byung ngo / /yi dwags la rigs mi 'dra ba sum cu rtsa drug gsungs shing / bsdu na gnas na gnas pa dang / mkha' la rgyu ba gnyis yin la/ de dag gi sdug bsngal yang thun mong bkres skom dang / grang dro dang / ngal 'jigs drug yod par gsungs te/ yi dwags na yang 'dod pas phongs pa yis/ /bskyed pa'i sdug bsngal rgyun chags mi 'chos pa/ /bkres skom grang dro ngal dang 'jigs pa yis/ /bskyed pa shin tu mi bzad bsten 'tshal lo/ /zhes dang bye brag tu/ kha cig kha ni khab kyi mig tsam la/ /lto ba ri yi gtos tsam bkres pas nyen/ /mi gtsang gyi nar bor ba cung zad kyang / /'tshal ba'i mthu dang ldan pa ma lags so/ /kha cig pags rus lus shing gcer bu ste/ /ta la ya thog bskams pa lta bu lags/ /zhes dang / smad rigs 'gas ni gcin dang phyi sa dang / /khrag sogs mi gtsang ba yang mi rnyed do/ /zhes dang / yi dwags rnams la so ga'i dus su ni/ /zla ba'ang tsha la dgun ni nyi ma'ang grang / /ljon shing 'bras bu med 'gyur 'di dag gis/ /bltas pa tsam gyis klung yang skems par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / mi bzad skom pas rgyang nas chu klung dri ma med/ /mthong nas btung bar 'dod de song na de nyid kyang /

/skra shad nya lcibs tshogs dang rnag gis 'dres pa dang / /'dam rdzab khrag dang phyi sas gang ba'i chur 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang / khab mig tsam gyi kha la dpag tshad mang 'jigs pa'i/ /lto chen nyam thag rgya mtsho chen po'i chu 'thungs kyang / /mgul phugs yangs pa nyid du phyin par ma gyur bar/ /kha yi dug gis chu yi thigs pa'ang bskam par 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /tshe'i tshad kyang / nye bar spyad ba'i las kyi zhags pa ni/ /sra bas bcings pa'i lus can kha cig lo/ /lnga stong dag dang khrir yang 'chir mi 'gyur/ /der skye ba'i rgyu yang / de yi rgyu ni skye bo 'jungs dga' ba/ /ser sna 'phags min lags par sangs rgyas gsungs/ /zhes pas yi dwags kyis 'jigs nas rgyu de spong ba'o/ /dud 'gro la rigs mi 'dra ba bye ba sum cu rtsa bzhi gsungs shing / /bsdu na byings na gnas pa dang / kha 'thor ba gnyis su 'dus la/ de dag gi sdug bsngal yang / dud 'gro'i skye gnas na yang gsod pa dang / /bcing dang rdeg sogs sdug bsngal sna tshogs dang / /zhi gyur dge ba spangs pa rnams la ni/ /gcig la gcig za shin tu mi bzad pa/ /kha cig mu tig bal dang rus pa dang / /sha dang pags pa'i ched du 'chi bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pas ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal bsams nas 'jigs pa'i blo skyes na de'i rgyu mi dge ba spong ba zhig 'byung ste/ mi dge ba las sdug bsngal kun/ /de bzhin ngan 'gro thams cad do/ /zhes pas de'i rgyu mi dge ba yin no/ /bde 'gro mi dang lha dang lha ma yin gyi sdug bsngal phyogs tsam brjod na/ mi la sdug bsngal brgya rtsa bcu sogs mang du yod kyang / 'dus che ba brgyad de/ skye rga na 'chi bzhi dang / mi sdug pa dang 'phrad pa/ sdug pa dang bral ba/ med pa btsal gyis mi rnyed pa/ yod pa bsrung gis ma thub pa bzhi ste brgyad do/ /de lta bu sogs sdug bsngal dpag tu med pa myong bas grub cing / lha ma yin la'ang lha'i dpal la phrag dog pa'i yid kyi sdug bsngal dang 'thab rtsod dang /

lus gcad cing dral ba la sogs ba'i sdug bsngal mang ste/ lha min dag na'ang rang bzhin gyis lha yi/ /dpal la sdang phyir yid kyi sdug bsngal che/ /de dag blo dang ldan na'ang 'gro ba yi/ /sgrib pas bden pa mthong ba ma mchis so/ /zhes so/ /'dod lha rnams la'ang 'chi ltas kyis zin pa na/ yid kyi sdug bsngal dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal las che ba yod par gsungs te/ mtho ris na yang bde chen de dag gi /'chi 'pho'i sdug bsngal nyid ni de bas che/ /de ltar bsams nas ya rabs rnams kyis ni/ /zad 'gyur mtho ris slad du sred mi bgyi/ /lus kyi kha dog mi sdug 'gyur ba dang / /stan la mi dga' me tog phreng rnyings dang / /gos la dri ma chags dang lus las ni/ /sngon chad med ba'i rngul 'byung zhes bgyi ba/ /mtho ris 'chi 'pho sbron byed 'chi ltas lnga/ /lha yul gnas pa'i lha rnams la 'byung ste/ /sa steng mi rnams 'chi bar 'gyur ba dag /sbron par byed pa'i 'chi ltas rnams dang 'dra/ /zhes so/ /de'i sdug bsngal gyi tshad kyang / mdo dran pa nyer gzhag las/ lha yi gnas nas ltung ba na/ /sdug bsngal rab tu skye ba ni/ /de yi khyad par sems can dmyal/ /bcu drug char yang mi phod do/ /zhes gsungs pas rnga mo rnge'u stor ba'am/ srin bu bye tshan la bsgres pa'am/ nya skam la bton pa'am/ rgya mtshor gru zhig pa lta bu'i sdug bsngal yod par gsungs/ khams gong ma gnyis na re zhig sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal dngos su med kyang mda' nam mkha' la 'phangs pa dang / bya nam mkha' la 'phur ba dag nam zhig nges par sa la lhung zhing 'bab pa bzhin du shi 'phos nas ngan song du lhung zhing sdug bsngal che mang myong bar 'gyur te/ lha yi 'jig rten dag nas 'phos pa la/ /gal te dge ba'i lhag ma 'ga' med na/ /de nas dbang med dud 'gro yi dwags dang / /dmyal bar gnas pa gang yang rung bar 'gyur/ /zhes dang / lha yul 'dod bde shin tu chen po dang /

/tshangs nyid chags bral bde ba thob nas slar/ /mnar med me yi bud shing gyur pa yi/ /sdug bsngal rgyun mi 'chad pa bsten 'tshal lo/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin no/ /de ltar na bde 'gro gsum du skyes kyang sdug bsngal las ma 'das shing / shi 'phos nas ngan song du skye ba'i skabs yod pa la dgongs nas/ pu to bas de gsum yang ngo bo sdug bsngal zhing / mtha' ngan gsung / de ltar na rigs drug gang du skyes kyang sdug bsngal las ma 'das pas/ /'khor ba de 'dra lags pas lha mi dang / /dmyal ba dud 'gro yi dwags rnams su ni/ /skye ba bzang po ma lags skye ba ni/ /gnod pa du ma'i snod gyur lags mkhyen mdzod/ /ces gsungs so/ /gnyis pa 'khor ba spyi yi nyes pa ni/ rgyas par phye na brjod kyis mi lang yang / des pa 'dod pas phongs dang 'chi ba dang / /na dang rga sogs sdug bsngal du ma yi/ /'byung gnas 'khor ba la ni skyo mdzad cing / /'di yi nyes pa'i shas kyang gsan par mdzod/ /ces gsungs pa ltar sdug bsngal thams cad kyi 'byung gnas yin yang de las rigs bsdus pa 'ga' tsam brjod na/ 'khor ba mtho dman gyi nyes pa dang / nges pa med pa dang / ngoms pa med pa dang / lus yang dang yang du len pa dang / nying mtshams yang dang yang du sbyor ba dang / gcig pu grogs med par 'gro ba'i nyes pa'o/ /dang po ni/ brgya byin 'jig rten mchod 'os gyur nas ni/ /las kyi dbang gis slar yang sa steng lhung / /'khor los sgyur ba nyid du gyur nas kyang / /'khor ba dag tu yang bran nyid du 'gyur/ /zhes dang / gang du lha klu mi'am ci yi mgo rgyan gyi/ /'od kyi tshogs kyis rkang rten dmar ba'i brgya byin yang / /las kyi rlung 'khrugs 'gro ba ngan par 'gro 'gyur ba/ /zhes dang / nyi ma zla ba thob nas rang lus kyi/ /'od kyis 'jig rten mtha' dag snang byas te/ /slar yang mun nag smag tu phyin gyur nas/ /rang gi lag pa brkyangs pa'ang mthong mi 'gyur/

/zhes dang / bde 'gror yang dang yang 'ongs te/ /bde ba mang po spyad spyad nas/ /shi nas ngan song sdug bsngal ni/ /yun ring mi bzad rnams su ltung / /zhes sogs gsungs so/ /nges pa med pa'i nyes pa ni/ /pha ni bu nyid ma ni chung ma nyid/ /skye bo dgra gyur pa dang bshes nyid dang / /bzlog pa nyid du mchi bas de slad du/ /'khor ba dag na nges pa 'ga' ma mchis/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /ngoms pa med pa'i nyes pa ni/ re res rgya mtsho bzhi bas lhag pa yi/ /'o ma 'thungs te da dung so so yi/ /skye bo'i rjes su 'brang ba'i 'khor ba pas/ /de bas ches mang nyid cig btung 'tshal lo/ /zhes dang / khyi dang phag tu gyur pa na/ /mi gtsang ba ni gang zos pa/ /ri yi rgyal po lhun po yi/ /tshad las shin tu lhag par 'gyur/ /srin bur gyur cing rab bkres pas/ /sa lud zos pa gang yin pa/ /'o ma'i rgya mtsho che nang du/ /de yis bkang na shin tu 'gengs/ /ri bo'i ngos la yun ring du/ /lha yi bde ba myong gyur pa/ /lha rdzas mal gyis mi ngoms te/ /shing skam po la me bzhin no/ /zhes dang / kar sha pa ni'i char phab kyang / /'dod pa dag la ngoms pa med/ /gangs can dang ni mnyam pa yi/ /gser gyi ri bo spyod gyur kyang / /nor des gcig kyang mi tshim pas/ /rtogs par byas la legs par dpyod/ /ces pa la sogs pa du ma gsungs pa yin no/ /lus yang yang blang pa'i nyes pa ni/ re res bdag nyid rus pa'i phung po ni/ /lhun po mnyam pa snyed cig 'das gyur te/ /zhes dang / phan tshun dag tu rtsod pa'i phyir/ /mgo bo bcad pa gang yin pa/ /spungs na de ltar mtho ba ni/ /tshangs pa'i 'jig rten las kyang thal/ /mdza' bshes dag dang bral ba yis/ /'khor ba'i nang du gang ngus pa/ /mig gi mchi ma'i thigs pa yi/ /snod du rgya mtsho rung ma yin/ /yang dang yang du dmyal ba ru/ /zangs zhun 'thungs pa gang yin pa/ /rgya mtsho'i nang gi chu la yang / /de yi tshad tsam yod ma yin/

/zhes dang / chu bo bzhis g.yengs keng rus bzhon pa la/ /zhon pa ma tshor 'di yang ngo mtshar che/ /zhes pa la sogs pa gsungs pa ltar ro/ /yang nas yang du nying mtshams sbyor ba ni/ ma yi thug mtha' rgya shug tshig gu tsam/ /ril bur bgrangs kyang sa yis lang mi 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /gcig pur grogs med par 'gro ba'i nyes pa ni/ skye na gcig pur skye 'gyur zhing / /'chi na'ang de nyid gcig 'chi na/ /zhes dang / gson tshe 'di dang de bzhin du/ /gnyen dang bshes pa rnams spangs nas/ /gcig po ga shed 'gro dgos na/ /zhes pa ltar yin no/ /de ltar 'khor ba spyi dang bye brag gi nyes pa bsams pas/ 'khor ba 'di gang du skyes kyang sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig las med par shes nas/ de ltar 'di kun mi rtag bdag med de/ /skyabs med mgon med gnas med de slad du/ /'khor ba chu shing snying po med pa la/ /mi mchog khyod kyi thugs ni 'byung bar mdzod/ /ces gsungs pa ltar 'khor ba la yid 'byung ste/ srid gsum dag la rmi lam du yang mi 'dod cing / /zhes pa'am/ phra men ma'i bu ma la zhen pa log pa'am/ tshal tshig pa'i bya'am/ srin mo'i gling gi tshong pa lta bu'i blo skyes na/ de las thar bar bya ba'i phyir du 'bad dgos te/ dper na mi gces bsad pa'i mi thod de zin na/ /dong du bcug yan lag rnams dam por bcings/ 'phral du sdug pa'i thabs sna tshogs byed cing / mthar gsod pa'i btson de dang 'dra'o/ /de lta bu'i btson de yang thar pa'i thabs 'ba' zhig sems shing / thabs gzhan ma rnyed na/ nams kyang gsod pas btson srung la brdos te/ yan lag bsnad pa dang / ka ca las ba la'ang mi blta bar gad med g.yang med du 'bros pa ltar 'o skol kyang 'khor ba'i btson dong du ni lhung / las dang nyon mongs pa'i 'ching ba dam pos ni bcings/ 'phral dang yun du sdug bsngal dpag med myong zhing myong bar 'gyur bas 'di las thar pa'i thabs 'ba' zhig bsam dgos/

bde dal du thar pa'i thabs ma byung na/ nams kyang sdug bsngal 'byung bas lus srog dang / tshe 'di'i bde ba gang la yang ma chags par nyin mtshan med par 'bros dgos te/ zhi lhas/ gsod pa'i mi gcig lag bcad de/ /gal te thar na cis ma legs/ /mi yi sdug bsngal chung ngu yis/ /dmyal ba bral na cis ma legs/ /zhes dang / 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal bsal thabs kyi sdug bsngal dang dka' spyad kun dga' spro'i sgo nas nyams su blang dgos te/ 'di ni de tsam gnod min zhing / /don chen kyang ni 'grub 'gyur pas/ /'gro ba'i gnod sel sdug bsngal la/ /dge ba 'ba' zhig 'dir bya rigs/ /zhes so/ /yang 'khor ba 'di na bde ba'i skabs med de/ nad pa tshabs chen de zas ci zos rung / grogs su dang 'grogs rung / spyod lam ci byas rung / gnas gang du bsdad rung bde ba med pa bzhin/ 'khor ba gang du skyes kyang nyon mongs pas gzir ba rnams la bde ba med de/ des na/ nad pa de nad bsal ba'i don du sman pas ci zer nyan cing sman dpyad bsten pa bzhin du/ 'o skol kyang nyon mongs pa'i nad bsal ba'i don du ston pas ci gsung sgrub cing nyams su len dgos/ de ltar mi byed na shin tu blun zhing smad pa'i 'os su 'gyur te/ zhi lhas/ tha mal nad kyis 'jigs na yang / /sman pa'i ngag bzhin bya dgos na/ /'dod chags la sogs nyes brgya yi/ /nad kyis rtag btab smos ci dgos/ /de la sman pa thams cad mkhyen/ /zug rngu thams cad 'byin pa yi/ /bka' ltar mi byed sems pa ni/ /shin tu gti mug smad pa'i gnas/ /zhes so/ /yang blang dor la rab tu rmongs pa dmus long 'brog dgon par 'khyams pa dang 'dra ste/ dmus long 'brog dgon pa ngam grog dang / gcan gzan sogs 'jigs pa du ma yod pa der lam 'khyams na/ gar 'gro'i phyogs ni slad/ ci bya'i gtol ni med/ de bzhin du shes rab kyi mig long zhing long khrid kyang med la/ 'khor ba'i 'brog dgon du 'khyams shing 'jigs pa du mas gtses la skyabs mgon dang bral ba rnams ni/

'dod pa bde ba 'dod kyang thob pa sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig thob ste/ mdo rgyan las/ skye bo rmongs pa rang gi bde don brtson/ /rtag tu de ma grub par sdug bsngal 'gyur/ /zhes dang / zhi lhas/ sdug bsngal 'dor 'dod sems yod kyang / /sdug bsngal nyid la mngon par rgyug /bde ba 'dod kyang gti mug pas/ /rang gi bde ba dgra ltar 'joms/ /zhes dang / slob spring las/ 'phags pa'i mgron po dang bral lam rgyus mi shes pa/ /'brog dgon 'khyams na ci ste yun ring gdung mi byed/ /ces so/ /gal te grong khyer du 'khrid nus pa'i mi dang phrad na/ de la glo snying brang gsum gtad la ci zer nyan cing bya ba gzhan thams cad dor te/ de la 'jus nas shi ma shi med par 'gro dgos/ de bzhin du rang re 'khor ba'i 'brog nas thar par 'khrid nus shing / skyob pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen nam/ dkon mchog dang mjal ba rnams glo snying brang gsum de la gtad de/ ci gsung sgrub cing bya ba gzhan thams cad spangs la/ shi ma shi med pa rtse gcig tu skyabs su 'gro zhing gsol ba gdab dgos te/ rgyal mtshan dam pa las/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun ni/ /thar pa 'dod pa rnams kyi skyabs/ /zhes dang / sdud pa las/ nad pa'i tshogs kyis gso phyir sman pa bsten pa ltar/ /g.yel ba med par dge ba'i shes gnyen bsten par bya/ /zhes dang / zhi lhas/ da ni 'jigs pa cher mthong nas/ /khyed la skyabs su mchi lags kyis/ /'jigs pa myur du bsal du gsol/ /zhes so/ /longs spyod kyang ya nga ba dang skyug bro ba'i gnas yin te/ 'phags pa kā t+yā ya nas/ pha sha za zhing ma la 'tshog las ngan dgra bo pang na bzung / /chung mas khyo pho'i rus pa 'cha'/ /'khor ba'i chos la gad mo bro/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas pha ma'i sha dang nying sha nying gis zos pa dang / khyi dang phag tu gyur nas mi gtsang ba zos pa sogs gang mi gtsang zhing skyug bro ba zos pa'ang bsags na 'jig rten du mi shong ba tsam yod de/

srin bur gyur pa'i tshe sa lud zos pa dang / dmyal bar zangs zhun 'thungs pa dang / lcags kyi thu lum 'bar ba zos pa'ang mtha' med pa bzhin no/ /de ltar na 'khor ba 'di skyon gyi rang bzhin du 'dug pas/ de la bsams na snying yod na snying rlung ldang ba'i tshod yin/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal bsams na snying rlung ldang / /de la gad mo mi bro ding ri ba/ /zhes dang / glang thang pa la nye gnas kyis/ /'o skol la glang ri thang pa ngo nag pa zer gyin gda' zhus pas/ khams gsum 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal 'di la bsams na ngo gdong la dkar po 'ongs 'dug ge gsung / 'o na 'khor ba de las thar par byed pa la sdig pa spangs pa tsam gyis chog gam snyam na de tsam gyis mi chog ste/ dper na shing gi rtsa ba ma bton na yal ga bcad kyang slar skye ba dang 'dra bas/ nyon mongs nye nyon rnams dang de dag thams cad kyi rtsa ba bdag 'dzin spang dgos te/ 'khor bar 'jug cing dmyal ba sogs kyi sdug bsngal skyed pas dmyal srung dang 'dra ba'i nyon mongs pa 'di ma spangs na bde ba med de/ 'khor ba'i btson ra'i srung mas dmyal sogs su/ /gsod byed gshed mar gyur pa de dag ni/ /gal te bdag blo chags pa'i drwa ba na/ /gnas na bdag la bde ba ga la yod/ /ces so/ /gnod lan byed pa la'ang khro na/ yin rung min rung gnod pa byed pa'i nyon mongs pa la ci'i phyir mi khro ste/ bdag gi snying la gnas bzhin du/ /dga' mgur bdag la gnod byed pa/ /zhes so/ /tshig ngan tsam smras pa la'ang dgra ru 'dzin na/ dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal skyed pa la ci ste dgra ru mi 'dzin te/ gal te lha dang lha min rnams/ /zhes so/ /zhag re tsam gnod pa skyel ba la 'khon du 'dzin na/ thog ma med pa nas gnod pa skyel ba la ci ste 'khon du mi 'dzin te/ bdag gi nyon mongs dgra bo gang / /zhes so/ /btud na slar phan 'dogs pa'i dgra yang spong na/ btud na slar gnod pa byed pa'i nyon mongs ci ste mi spong ste/

mthun par rim gros bsten byas na/ /zhes so/ /de dag bdag la phan 'dogs na/ /zhes pas gnod byed de dgrar ma nges shing / nges kyang gdul mi dgos par rang bzhin gyis 'chi ste/ dam pa'i zhal nas/ gtor ma brgya rtsa gcig btang pas dgra thams cad 'chi ba'i mthu shes gsung / de zhu 'tshal zhus pas/ lo re la gtor ma re re thongs dang / brgya rtsa them na dgra thams cad 'chi bar ngas khag 'khur gsung / de 'dra de'ang 'dul na/ dgrar nges shing ma btul na mi thul ba'i nyon mongs ci ste mi 'dul te/ rang bzhin 'chi ba'i sdug bsngal gyur pa'i nyon mongs rnams/ /zhes so/ /des na 'di ma spangs na bdag la bde ba nam yang mi 'byung ste/ zhi lhas/ de ltar dus ring rgyun chags dgrar gyur pa/ /gnod pa'i tshogs rab 'phel ba'i rgyu gcig pu/ /bdag gi snying la nges par gnas 'cha' na/ /'khor bar 'jigs med dga' bar ji ltar 'gyur/ /zhes pas 'di spang dgos so/ /spang mi nus pa'ang min te/ nyon mongs rnams ni yul na mi gnas zhes bya'o/ /tha mal gyi dgra bzhin spangs pa slar ldog pa'ang min te/ tha mal dgra bo yul nas phyung yang ni/ /zhes so/ /des na spangs dgos shing spong nus la/ spong sla bas de ma spangs kyi bar la brtson 'grus mi 'dor zhing / de spong ba'i sdug bsngal dga' spro'i sgo nas dang du blang ste/ de ltas ji srid bdag gis dgra 'di mngon sum du/ /nges par ma bcom de srid bdag 'dir brtson mi 'dor/ /zhes dang / de ltar nyon mongs 'joms pa la/ /rtag tu phyir mi ldog par bya/ /zhes dang / don med dgra yis rma srol btod pa yang / /zhes so/ /nyon mongs nye nyon de dag thams cad kyi rtsa ba bdag tu 'dzin pa 'di spang dgos te/ rnam 'grel las/ bdag yod na ni gzhan du shes/ /bdag gzhan cha las 'dzin dang sdang / /'di dag dang ni yongs 'brel las/ /nyes pa thams cad 'byung bar 'gyur/ /zhes dang / spyod 'jug las/

'jig rten dag na 'tshe ba gang yod dang / /'jigs dang sdug bsngal ji snyed yod gyur pa/ /de kun bdag tu 'dzin pa las byung na/ /'dre chen des ko bdag la ci zhig bya/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /de ltar 'khor ba'i rgyu 'bras spang ba dang / thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa thob par bya ba'i phyir chos la 'bad par bya dgos shing de las gal che ba med de/ glo bur mgo 'am gos la me shor na/ /de dag bzlog phyir bgyi ba btang nas kyang / /yang srid med bar bgyi slad 'bad 'tshal te/ /'di las chos mchog dgos pa gzhan ma mchis/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /des na chos ma byas par rang thar pa'ang mi 'gro zhing / gzhan gyis byas pas kyang mi phan pas rang kho nas byed dgos/ bsgrub par bya ba'i chos kyang bslab pa rin po che gsum gyis bsdus pa'i dge ba'i chos tshad med pa bsgrub dgos te/ sdong po bkod pa las/ rigs kyi bu/ dge ba'i rtsa ba gcig la chags par ma byed cig chos kyi sgo gcig dang / spyod pa gcig yongs su rdzogs pas chog par ma 'dzin zhig de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rigs kyi bu/ byang chub sems dpa' ni dge ba'i rtsa ba tshad med pa yongs su bsdu bar bya dgos so/ /zhes dang / bshes spring las kyang / thar pa bdag la rag las 'di la ni/ /gzhan gyis grogs bgyir ci yang ma mchis kyis/ /thos dang tshul khrims bsam gtan ldan pa yis/ /bden pa rnam pa bzhi la 'bad par mdzod/ /lhag pa'i tshul khrims lhag pa'i shes rab dang / /lhag ba'i sems la rtag tu bslab par bgyi/ /zhes so/ /khyad par du gtso bor byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa la 'bad par bya ste/ gang zhig bde bas phongs pa dang / /sdug bsngal mang ldan de dag la/ /bde ba kun gyis tshim pa dang / /sdug bsngal thams cad gcod byed cing / /gti mug kyang ni sel byed pa/ /de dang dge mtshungs ga la yod/ /de 'dra'i bshes kyang ga la yod/ /bsod nams de 'dra ga la yod/ /ces dang /

bdag gi rnyed dang bskur sti dang / /lus dang 'tsho ba med sla zhing / /dge ba gzhan yang nyams sla yi/ /sems ni nam yang nyams mi bya/ /zhes dang / skyes bu gang zhig skad cig tsam/ /byang chub sems ni sgom byed pa/ /de yi bsod nams phung po ni/ /rgyal bas kyang ni bgrang mi spyod/ /ces gsungs shing / khyad par du/ gang zhig bdag dang gzhan rnams ni/ /myur du bskyab par 'dod pa des/ /bdag dang gzhan du brje bya ba/ /gsang ba'i dam pa spyad par bya/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /'o na dgyes rdor ram phyag rgya chen po'am/ stong pa nyid bzang ba ma yin nam snyam na/ rgya gar du dgyes rdor sgom pa'i rnal 'byor pa zhig rgyun du zhugs pa thob pa zhig byung ba la/ jo bo'i zhal nas/ de lta stangs bzang ba yin/ ma legs na 'phyugs te bya ba yin gsungs skad/ pu to bas kyang / de skad gsungs pa la gzhan zhig ma rangs nas/ spyan snga ba la jo bo 'di skad zer zhus bas/ de a cang de bas byang chub kyi sems med na he badz+ra bsgoms pa dmyal bar yang 'gro/ yi dwags su yang 'gro/ dud 'gror yang 'gro gsung ste/ byang chub kyi sems med na de dag gi rgyur yang 'gyur la byang chub kyi sems ni gzhan du mi 'gyur bas so/ /stong pa nyid kyang dmyal ba nas rang sangs rgyas man chad kyi rgyu rkyen yin la/ byang chub kyi sems ni pha'i sa bon ltar sangs rgyas kyi rgyu thun mong ma yin pa yin pas gzhan du 'gyur mi srid la/ bud+dha'i chos thams cad skyed par byed pas sa bon lta bu'o zhes sogs phan yon mang po gsungs pas/ 'di las bzang ba'i chos med/ chos gzhan pa sems rgyud la skyes na gnyen por 'gro/ 'di tshig dran pa tsam gyis gnyen por 'gro/ bde lhan gyis 'gro/ nyan rang du yang mi gol/ byang chub kyi spyod pa rlabs can du 'gro/ des na sngon 'gro'i chos de dag ma bsams par 'di sems snying 'dod pa dang / bskul ba dang /

blang rgyu mi yong pas dang por dal 'byor rnyed par dka' bar go zhing / 'jig par sla bas mi rtag par shes la/ shi nas med de mi 'gro bar skye dgos la/ de yang las kyis skye zhing las ngan pas ngan song du skyes nas de'i sdug bsngal thams cad 'byung zhing / las bzang pos lha mi thob kyang sdug bsngal las ma 'das par shes shing / 'khor ba pa'i sems can thams cad thog ma med pa nas ma rgan drin can yin pa la sdug bsngal gyis nyam thag pa mi bzod pa'i snying rjes kun nas bslangs te byang chub kyi sems 'byung bas/ lam rim 'og ma thams cad 'di'i sngon 'gro yin no/ ༈ /da ni dngos gzhi byang chub kyi sems sbyang ba ston te/ 'dir chos rje pas/ kun rdzob dang don dam pa'i byang chub kyi sems rnam pa gnyis blo sbyong gi dngos gzhir ma zad theg pa chen po'i chos thams cad kyi dngos gzhi yin te/ mdo rgyud bstan bcos man ngag kun las de ltar rgyas par 'byung bas so gsung / de yang rje btsun gyis mngon rtogs rgyan las/ shes pas srid la mi gnas shing / /snying rjes zhi la mi gnas dang / /zhes dang / rgyud bla ma las kyang / bdag sred ma lus shes rab kyis bcad de/ /sems can sred phyir brtse ldan zhi thob min/ /de ltar blo brtse byang chub thabs bsten nas/ /'phags pa 'khor ba'am mya ngan 'da' mi 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs shing / 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis kyang / bdag nyid dang ni 'jig rten 'dis/ /bla med byang chub thob 'dod na/ /zhes sogs rgyas par gong du drangs pa bzhin gsungs so/ /rigs pas kyang grub ste/ bya nam mkha' la 'phur ba la gshog pa gnyis ka dgos pa bzhin mi gnas pa'i myang 'das thob pa la yang stong nyid snying rje gnyis ka dgos so/ /des na byang chub kyi sems gnyis nyams su len pa ni tshegs chung la don che zhing / gzhan ni de las ldog ste/ sha pho sgang pa'i zhal nas/ chos 'di nyams su len pa ni rta bzang po la zhon nas thang bde mo la 'gro ba dang 'dra la/

chos gzhan nyams su len pa ni la chen po dang 'phrang dog po la khur chen po khur nas 'gro ba dang 'dra'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /chos rje pas/ mtshan nyid theg pa'i dbang du byas na de ltar don la gnas/ gsang sngags pa dang bstun na cung kha zin du 'gro gsung / chos 'di nyams su len pa la gang zag ji 'dra zhig dgos na/ glang ri thang pa'i gsung gis 'di nyams su len pa'i gang zag ni rang dman cha bzung nas mtho dman 'bring gsum spyi bor 'khur nus pa zhig dgos gsung / chos rje pas de 'dra zhig cis kyang dgos te/ khye dang rgyal kha gzhan la gtong zhing / gyong dang bub kha rang gis len pas so gsung / 'dir dngos gzhi byang chub kyi sems sbyang ba la don dam dang kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems sbyong ba gnyis las/ don dam byang chub kyi sems sbyang ba ni/ jo bo yab sras kyi bzhed pas/ brtan pa thob nas gsang ba spyad/ /ces thabs kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems la brtan pa thob nas blo dman pa la gsang bya shes rab don dam byang chub kyi sems sbyang zhing bsgom zhes bzhed pas/ sngon gyi mkhas pa gzhan mang pos kyang de bzhin du 'chad mod/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'chad ka ba'i lugs kyis don dam byang chub kyi sems sgom tshul thog mar ston te/ rang gis gnas lugs stong pa nyid kyi don rtogs nas gzhan ma rtogs pa'i sems can rnams la snying rje skye bar bzhed pa'o/ ༈ /'di la mnyam rjes gnyis las/ dang po la sbyor dngos mjug gsum las/ dang po ni/ lha'i khang par yan lag bdun pa bya/ lha dang bla ma la gsol ba gdab/ de nas bsam gtan gyi khang par stan bde ba la skyil mo krung gis 'dug ste/ dbugs phyir 'gro nang 'gro'i khug pa nyi shu rtsa gcig bgrang ngo / /de la thun du bcad nas zhag 'ga' bslab cing nyams myong skyes nges shig bya'o gsung / des lus ngag yid gsum bsam gtan gyi snod du rung bar byas pa'o/ /de nas kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems khyad par can mngon du bya'o/

/dngos gzhi ni/ 'di kun cig car 'jug pa'i lugs yin pas/ dngos gzhi bdag dang gzhan thams cad kyi stong pa dus gcig tu bsgom yang / sbyor ba'i dus na so sor rtog pa'i shes rab kyis rim pas rtsis la gdab ste/ 'di ni zhi gnas kyi rlan las rtogs pa'i myu gu skye ba'i dgos pa yod gsung / de la thog mar gzung ba rang bzhin med par bsgom pa ni/ 'dir don dam byang chub kyi sems bsgom lugs 'di dag shin tu zab pas gong ma'i yig sna dang / chos rje'i gsung zin bris su byas pa las ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin ma gtogs bdag gis snon 'jug ci yang ma byas so/ /chos rnams rmi lam lta bur bsam/ /zhes pas bstan te/ 'di ltar snang ba rang gzhan phyi nang snod bcud 'di thams cad rang gi sems nyid 'khrul ba'i snang ba tsam las ma gtogs pa sems las tha dad pa'i don du grub pa rdul tsam yang gdod ma'am ye nas grub pa med do/ /de ltar rigs pas dpyad na kun rdzob tsam du yang rig ngo na bden pa'i don grub pa mi 'dug ang snyam du bsam/ de nas 'dzin pa rang bzhin med par bsgom pa ni/ ma skyes rig pa'i gshis la dpyad/ /ces pas bstan te/ gzung ba'i yul 'dzin par rlom pa'i sems rig pa 'di yang dus gsum du gnas pas 'das pa 'gags/ ma 'ongs pa ma skyes/ da ltar ba ni skye cha/ 'gag cha/ gnas pa'i cha gsum dang ldan zhing / kha dog med cing dbyibs dang bral la lus kyi cha shas 'di na gnas bya ba'i gnas sa med pas/ dpyad na ngos bzung thams cad dang bral bas ye nas ngos bzung thams cad dang bral 'dug ang snyam du bsam/ ngos bzung dang bral ba'i don yang gshis cir yang ma grub cing spros pa thams cad dang bral ba'i don du gsung ngo / /de nas chos thams cad rang bzhin med par bsgom pa ni/ gnyen po nyid kyang rang sar grol/ /zhes pas bstan te/ de ltar yul sems thams cad stong pa nyid du dpyod pa'i gnyen po'i bya ba byed pa'i sems 'di nyid kyang ma grub cing stong ste/

shes bya thams cad yul sems gnyis su 'dus shing / sems spyi bsdus nas de gnyis rang bzhin med par gong du dpyad nas grub zin pas ci'ang ye nas ma grub par 'dug ang snyam du bsam mo/ /de ltar lta bas spros pa bcad nas/ dngos gzhi'i tshe lta thog tu sems 'jog pa'i tshul gyis bsgom pa ni/ lta bas spros pa bcad zin pa'i mod las/ sems nyid rtog pa dang bral la/ rang gzhan dus gsum ci yang mi 'dzin pa'i ngang la glod cing / yul cir yang ma grub pa la blos cir yang mi 'dzin pa'i ngang la glod la rig pa gsal la mi rtog pa 'di nyid mngon du byas la gsal sing nge bying rgod kyi dbang du ma song bar byas la gzhag go /don de nyid bstan pa ni/ lam gyi ngo bo kun gzhi'i ngang la gzhag /bdun po sems byung rtog pa yin pas spang / /zhes gsungs te gnad kyi don smras pa'o// chos kyi rtsa ba'am gzhi smra bsam brjod du med cing spros pa dang bral ba gzhi la ji ltar gnas pa bzhin du/ lam du yang de ltar bzhag cing nyams su blang bar bya/ rnam shes tshogs bdun po sems byung rtog pa yin pas rtog pa'i shes pa yul yul can rang dga' bar mi gtang bar rtog pa gang skyes la rig pas bltas la chos nyid kyi ngang du glod la/ phyis rtog pa skyes tshad kyang rig pas rig pa la bltas la chos nyid kyi ngang du glod cing grol bar bya'o// 'di ni dngos gzhi'i 'od gsal bgyi ba lags pas/ der drag la yun thung bar bya ste/ thun che rung chung rung thun zhabs ru ma dang bcas te bzang gyes byed pa mchog yin no zhes gsungs pa ltar bya'o/ /gsum pa mjug ni/ dmigs pa btang nas skyil krung ma bshig pa'i gong du gnas lugs de ltar ma rtogs pa'i sems can rnams la snying rje chen po bsgoms te/ gnas lugs phyin ci ma log pa'i don la dgod par bya'o snyam du bsams nas dge ba gzhan don du bsngo bar bya'o/ /de nas skyil mo krung bshig ste/

༈ gnyis pa rjes thob tu ji ltar bslab pa ni/ thun mtshams sgyu ma'i skyes bur bya/ /zhes pas bstan te/ rjes thob tu rang gzhan snod bcud phyi nang sna tshogs su snang yang 'khrul nas med pa'i don snang ba yin pas sgyu ma'i rta glang dang khyad par med snyam du bsams la thams cad la bden zhen spang ngo gsung ste/ 'di ni thun snga phyi'i mtshams su yul snang sgyu ma lta bur lta ba'i don to/ /sgyu ma'i skyes bur bya ba'i don ni rang nyid kyang phung po lnga'i ngo bor snang yang rten 'brel tshogs pa'i snang ba tsam las/ gang gi bdag rtag pa gcig pu bya ba'i ngo bor grub pa med pas/ sgyu ma'i skyes bu'i 'gro 'ong byed cing yul la longs spyod pa lta bur bsams nas dbang po'i yul du gyur tshad thams cad kyang 'phral 'phral du de 'drog nyid la 'di'ang sgyu ma lta bu yin zhe'am/ rmi lam lta bu yin snyam du tha snyad la brten la sbyong ngo / /de ltar bltas pas rjes thob tu mnyam gzhag gi nyams rmi lam lta bu'i blo de dang ma bral bar thun mtshams kyi dge sbyor thams cad kyang lam du gzhug par bya'o/ /bla ma gzhan dag ni 'di'i don phung po lnga/ dbang po drug /spyod lam rnam bzhi thams cad rten 'brel tshogs pa'i snang ba sgyu ma lta bur shes par byas nas bden 'dzin dang chags sdang sogs kyi rjes su mi 'brang bar ma rtogs pa'i 'gro ba la snying rje bsgom zhes gsung / mdor na de ltar rjes kyi spyod lam thams cad du mnyam gzhag gi nyams ma dor bas zung 'jug chen po'i ngang la gnas par bya'o zhes smras pa ni/ de ltar bsgrubs pa thams cad kyang / /dngos 'dzin zhen pas ma bslad par/ /mkha' bzhin stong pa chen por dgyer/ /'chi med bde chen ngang du 'gro/ /zhes don de rnams kyi nyams len phan yon dang bcas par gsungs pa'o/ /'dir chos rje pas/ rtsa ba'i don des byed kyi 'thad pa dang bcas te gsungs pa ni/

rmi lam gyi yul snang sna tshogs pa gnyid kyis bslad pa'i sems snang yin gyi/ sems las gzhan du gyur pa med pa bzhin du/ da ltar gyi yul snang sna tshogs pa 'di yang bag chags kyis bslad pa'i sems snang 'ba' zhig yin gyi/ sems las ma gtogs pa'i phyi rol gyi don cung zad kyang med de/ lang kar gshegs pa'i mdo las/ bag chags kyis ni dkrugs pa'i sems/ /don du snang ba rab tu 'byung / /don yod ma yin sems nyid de/ /phyi rol don mthong log pa yin/ /zhes dang / sa bcu pa las/ kyai rgyal ba'i sras dag khams gsum po 'di ni sems tsam mo/ /zhes sogs rgya cher gsungs shing rigs pas grub ste/ gzhi gcig nyid las tha dad bsags pa'i sems can rnams la dngos po tha dad du snang ba'i phyir sems yin te/ theg bsdus las/ yi dwags dud 'gro mi rnams dang / /lha rnams so so rigs rigs su/ /dngos gcig yid ni tha dad phyir/ /don ma grub par 'dod pa yin/ /zhes so/ /rnal 'byor pas gzhan dang gzhan du bsgyur nus pas kyang sems snang 'ba' zhig yin te/ de nyid las/ byang chub sems dpa' dbang thob dang / /rnal 'byor pa la ji ltar yang / /sa la sogs pa'i dngos po rnams/ /ji ltar mos pa bzhin du snang / /zhes so/ /yang lam 'bras pa'i sgom chen pa zhig la rtsa rlung gi byed pas skom pa'i nyams shig byung ste/ chu 'thung bar 'dod nas chu rar phyin pas kyang chu mi 'dug /chu mig tu phyin pas kyang chu mi 'dug /gtsang por phyin pas kyang chu mi 'dug pas/ the tshom skyes nas chos gos pha ri'i brag dbar zhig tu bzhag nas phyir log ste nyal bsdad/ gnyid sad pa dang skom nyams kyang yal 'dug chu rar sogs na'ang chu 'dug chos gos kyang gtsang po phar kha na 'dug pas len pa la ko ba btang dgos pa byung zer/ de ltar chu yod du snang ba de bden rgyu med/ chu med du snang ba brdzun rgyu med pas na ci snang rang sems su thag gcad do/

/snang ba 'di phyi rol gyi don min na sra zhing 'thas pa sogs su snang ba'ang mi rigs snyam na/ bag chags goms pa'i phyir rigs te/ 'jam dpal rnam rol las/ lha'i bu pang+ma rnam par rol pas 'jam dpal la smras pa/ 'jam dpal phyi rol gyi yul 'di ji ltar blta bar bya/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ phyi rol gyi yul 'di rnams sems rnam par rtog pa'i bag chags brtas pa'i dbang gis snang ba yin no/ /lha'i bus smras pa/ bag chags ji ltar brtas kyang sra zhing 'thas pa 'di ltar snang du ga la rung / 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ de ltar snang du rung ste/ dper na grong khyer wā+ā rā ṇa sīr bram ze mo cig gis/ rang lus stag tu bsgoms pas thams cad kyis stag dngos su mthong nas mi thams cad bros te grong khyer stongs pa byung ngo / /zhes so/ /yang dge slong zhig gis rang lus mi gtsang bar bsgoms pas thams cad kyis keng rus su mthong ba byung ngo / /de ltar yun thung ngus kyang de ltar snang na/ thog ma med pa nas bag chags brtas pas ci ste mi snang ste snang bar rigs so/ /'dzin pa sems kyi gnas lugs gtan la dbab pa ni/ sems kyi ngo bo la dpyad na ci yang grub pa med cing / de nyid gzhi gdod ma nas grub pa'i chos sku yin te/ dkon brtsegs 'od srungs le'u las/ 'od srungs sems ni nang na yang med/ phyi rol na yang med/ gnyis ka na yang med cing ma dmigs so/ /sems ni gzugs med pa/ bstan du med pa/ thogs pa med pa'o/ /sems ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyis kyang ma gzigs/ mi gzigs/ gzigs par mi gyur ro/ /zhes dang / zhi lhas/ yid ni dbang sogs la mi gnas/ gzugs sogs la min bar na'ang min/ /nang na sems min phyi na'ang min/ /gzhan du yang ni rnyed ma yin/ /gang zhig lus min gzhan du min/ /'dres min logs su'ang 'gar med de/ /de ni cung zad min de'i phyir/ /sems kyi rang bzhin mya ngan 'das/ /zhes dang /

brgyad stong pa las/ sems la sems ma mchis te sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal ba'o/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin no/ /de ltar sems kyi gnas lugs gtan la phebs nges pa gcig gal che ste/ zhi ba lhas/ de bas chos kyi don po mchog /sems kyi gsang 'di ma shes na/ /bde thob sdug bsngal gzhom 'dod kyang / /de dag don med gyi nar 'khyam/ /zhes so/ /'di shes na chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs kyang shes te/ gang gis dngos gcig de bzhin nyid mthong ba/ /de yis dngos kun de bzhin nyid du mthong / /zhes dang / sdud pa las/ bdag ci 'dra ba de 'drar sems can thams cad shes/ /sems can thams cad ci 'dra de 'drar chos kun shes/ /skye ba med dang skye ba gnyis kar mi rtog pa/ /'di ni shes rab pha rol phyin mchog spyod pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /'o na gzung 'dzin skye med du shes pa'i blo de grub bam snyam na/ gnyen po de nyid kyi ngo bo la brtags na cir yang grub pa med de/ zhi ba lhas/ mya ngan 'das dang ma 'das pa'ang / /de nyid du ni khyad par med/ /ces dang / thams cad nam mkha' 'dra bar ni/ /bdag 'dras yongs su gzung bar gyis/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /de ltar chos thams cad stong par rtogs na yang dag pa'i don rtogs pa yin te/ sdud pa las/ chos kun skye med stong pa'i tshul du rab shes pa/ /'di ni shes rab pha rol phyin mchog spyod pa yin/ /zhes so/ /de ltar gnas lugs cir yang ma grub pa de mngon du byed pa la goms 'dris byed dgos pas ji ltar sgom na/ gang du'ang ma grub pa la cir yang mi 'dzin pa thog tu 'bab pas de'i bsgom tshul bstan pa'i phyir/ lam gyi ngo bo kun gzhi'i ngang la gzhag /ces gsungs te/ spyir kun gzhi'i ngos 'dzin shin tu dka' na yang / da res kyi 'di sems ma bcos pa la kun gzhir byas pa de yin zhing de'i ngang la 'jog pa tsam las bsgom rgyu ci yang med de/ chos nyid spros dang bral ba la/

/shes pa'ang spros dang bral bar gzhag /ces so// lung 'di dang mthun par sems kun gzhi'i ngang la 'jog tshul yang / lta thog tu sems 'jog pa zhig dgos kyang gong ma'i gsung dang chos rje ba'i gsung gnyis ka las/ cir yang mi 'dzin mi rtog par gzhag ces 'byung ba kho na bzhin bshad pa yin no// de nyid bsgom pa'i mchog yin te/ mdo sde rgyan las/ bsgom par rnam par mi lta ba/ /bsgom pa'i dam par 'dod pa ste/ /zhes dang / sdud pa las/ 'du shes tshul rol yin zhes 'dren pas yongs su bsgrags/ /'du shes rnam par bshig nas spong ba pha rol 'gro/ /zhes dang / yum las/ yid la mi byed pa ni sangs rgyas dang / chos dang dge 'dun rjes su dran pa yin no zhes pas/ ci yang mi bsgom/ cir yang mi rtog ci yang yid la mi byed pa'i ngang la sa le hrig ge rjen ne bzhag go /de'i ngang la ma yengs pa gal che ste/ yum las/ sems g.yengs pas ni bdag gi don yang mi 'grub na gzhan gyi don lta ci smos zhes dang / sems ma yengs pa ni dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi lam yin no/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /sems ma yengs par byed pa la sgo gsum dben pa gal che ste/ lus dang sems ni dben pa yis/ /rnam par g.yeng ba mi 'byung ngo / /zhes so/ /'o na rnam rtog thams cad spang dgos sam zhe na/ mi rtog pa bsgom pa la rtog pa gzhan spang dgos kyang sems yul la g.yo ba bsrung ba las gal che ba med cing / de'i don du dran shes bzhin tsam bsten dgos te/ sems bsrung 'dod pa rnams kyis ni/ /dran pa dang ni shes bzhin dag /srog la bab kyang srungs shig ces/ /bdag ni de ltar thal mo sbyor/ /ces gsungs pas so/ /de ltar bsgom med la yengs med du bzhag nas sgom pa'i tshe ting nge 'dzin gyi skyon sgrib pa lnga byung na/ de'i gnyen por spong ba'i 'du byed brgyad bsgom pa'am/ lnga po de yang phal cher bying rgod gnyis su 'dus pas/

bying na lus bcun te skyod 'gul bya/ ngag gi skad gsang mthon pos gsol ba 'debs pa la sogs dang / yid kyis drag tu bsgrims shing gzengs bstod pa dang / sangs rgyas dang byang sems sogs kyi yon tan sems pa sogs kyis bsal zhing / rgod na lus dal/ ngag bsdam/ yid glod pa dang / skyo ba bskyed pa sogs kyis bsal ba'am/ gnyi ga la yang ngos bzung zhing blta ba nyid gnyen po'i mchog yin la/ gzhan yang kha zas sogs kyis kyang bcos par bya ste/ zhum pa'i sems ni rab bzung ste/ /rgod pa yang ni zhi bar bya/ /zhes so/ bying rgod med na rang sor gzhag ste/ mnyam par gyur na btang snyoms gzhag /ces so/ /de ltar 'jog pa la sgrim glod gnyis las med de/ sa ra has/ khrims kyis bsgrims la lhod kyis glod/ /sems kyi gzhag sa de na gda'/ /zhes gsungs te/ de'ang ma skyes pa skye ba la glod pa dang / skyes pa bogs dbyung pa la bsgrim pa gal che'o/ /de ltar bzhag pas sems dmigs pa la rtse gcig tu ting nge gnas na zhi gnas yin te/ zhi lhag ngos 'dzin 'di dag zin bris las ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin bris te cung zad dpyad du yod do// dkon mchog sprin las/ zhi gnas ni sems rtse gcig pa'o/ /zhes so/ /de ltar zhi gnas kyis sems zin pa'i mthus shes rab kyis sems kyi gnas lugs rtogs sam/ spyir chos kyi gnas lugs rtogs na lhag mthong yin te/ mdo snga ma las lhag mthong gang zhe na/ yang dag par so sor rtog pa'o/ /zhes sems gsal stong du rtogs pa'am/ don dam spros bral rtogs pa'i ngang la rtse gcig tu gnas pa'am/ cir snang sgyu ma lta bur rtogs pa'i ngang la rtse gcig tu gnas na zhi lhag zung 'brel yin te/ zung du 'brel pa'i lam ni de/ /sdom pa yin par shes par bya/ /zhes so/ /de la gus sbyor dang rgyun sbyor gal che ste/ de la rtag tu bya ba dang / /gus par byas te sbyar bar bya/

/zhes so/ /de ltar byas na nyon mongs pa rtsad nas 'joms te/ zhi gnas rab tu ldan pa'i lhag mthong gis/ /nyon mongs rnam par 'joms par shes bya ste/ /zhes so/ /yang de ltar byas na nyams rtogs la sogs yon tan 'bad med du skye zhing mchog gi dngos grub kyang myur du 'thob ste/ mdo sde dgongs 'grel las/ theg pa che chung gi yon tan thams cad zhi lhag gi 'bras bur gsungs shing / sdud pa las/ shes rab pha rol phyin 'di su yi lag thob pa/ /ring por mi thogs rgyal po'i byang chub reg par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / jo bos/ de ltar de nyid goms byas na/ /rim gyis drod sogs thob byas nas/ /rab dga' la sogs thob 'gyur te/ /sangs rgyas byang chub thag mi ring / /zhes gsungs pas so/ /de ltar mnyam gzhag gi nyams kyi rjes su 'brangs nas rjes thob tu snod bcud sogs ci snang yang bden med sgyu ma lta bur bsgom pa yin pa las mnyam gzhag gi nyams bzang na ched kyis ma bsgoms kyang snang ba sgyu ma lta bur bun long 'gro ba zhig rang shugs kyis 'ong gsung / des na dran 'dzin kho na gal che bas/ snang ba thams cad snang yang bden med sgyu ma rmi lam lta bu yin snyam du bsgom mo/ /de'ang ma yin pa la yin par bsgom pa min/ yin pa la yin par bsgom pa yin pas gsal btab cing bsgom par bya ste/ dkon brtsegs las/ sgyu ma mkhan bzang pos bcom ldan 'das la bgom pa'i phyir/ sgyu ma ji ltar bstan tshul rgya cher gsungs pa dang / skabs 'dir sgyu ma mkhan bzang pos sangs rgyas la dad pa'i ting nge 'dzin thob ste/ de las langs nas byang chub tu sems bskyed cing gang la bslabs na bla na med pa'i byang chub thob par 'gyur ba lags zhes sogs zhus pas/ chos bzhi la bslabs na thob par 'gyur te/ byang chub kyi sems mi 'dor ba dang / sems can blos mi spong ba dang / dge ba'i rtsa bas mi ngoms pa dang / chos bsrung pa'i phyir rab tu brtson pa'o/

/zhes sogs gsungs pas bzang pos mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob ste/ dus 'di tsam na zhing 'di zhes bya bar sangs rgyas mtshan 'di zhes bya bar 'gyur zhes lung bstan to// ting nge 'dzin rgyal po las/ sgyu ma byed pa dag gis gzugs sprul te/ /rta dang glang po shing rta sna tshogs byas/ /de la ji bzhin snang ba gang yang med/ /chos rnams thams cad de 'drar shes par gyis/ /zhes dang / ji ltar bu mo gzhon nu'i rmi lam na/ /bu pho byung zhing shi ba de mthong nas/ /skyes na dga' zhing shi na mi dga' ltar/ /chos rnams thams cad de 'drar shes par gyis/ /zhes gsungs te/ de lta bu sogs kyis gsal btab cing bsgom par bya'o/ /de ltar chos rnams snang la rang bzhin med par rtogs shing bsgoms na skye ba mang po nas theg pa chen po la zhugs shing sangs rgyas mang po la bya ba byas pa yin te/ sdud pa las/ gang zhig chos 'di sprul dang sgyu ma 'drar thos nas/ /som nyi med par slob la phyir zhing sbyor byed pa/ /sems can de ni ring nas theg chen zhugs rig bya/ /sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig mang la lhag byas yin/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /gang shar ngos 'dzin gyi lta ba/ gsal stong blo bral gyi sgom pa/ thug phrad lam khyer gyi spyod pas don dam bya chub kyi sems nyams su blang ngo / /de ltar don dam byang chub kyi sems bsgom tshul ji skad bstan pa 'di dag chos rje pa nyid kyi gsung sgros ji lta ba bzhin yin zhes zin bris chen mo las 'byung ngo / ༈ /gnyis pa kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems bdag gzhan brje ba bsgom pa ni/ spyan snga ba'i zhal nas/ bla ma gser gling pa'i lugs kyis thog mar bdag gzhan mnyam pa bsgom/ de nas rje ba bsgom pa yin gsung ste/ de ni bla ma byams pa'i rnal 'byor pa'i lugs yin gsung / pu to ba'i zhal nas/ ngas rwa sgreng gi shug pa'i gseb kyi dge bsnyen rgan po de las thos tsa na/

bla ma gser gling pa'i lugs kyis dang po nyid nas bdag gzhan brje ba bsgom pa gcig tu thos gsung skad/ da res 'dir yang pu to ba'i gdams pa ston pa yin no/ /'dir rje btsun gong ma rnams kyi gsung sgros las/ mdza' bo'i bu mo'i gtam rgyud sogs/ /man ngag 'di yi gleng gzhi yin/ /zhes gsungs pas/ de ni khyim bdag mdza' bo zhes pa gcig gi bu skyes tshad shi bas/ thengs cig bu gcig skyes pa sos su re nas ming bu mor btags so/ /khyim bdag rgya mtshor phyin pas shi'o/ /bu cher skyes nas ma la rigs gang yin dris pas/ drang por brjod na rgya mtshor song dogs nas 'bru 'tshong gi rigs yin byas pas/ des 'bru btsongs pas nyin re la kar+ṣa pa ṇi bzhi bzhi rnyed cing / des ma la zhabs tog byas pas/ 'bru 'tshong rnams kyis bkag go /yang ma la rigs gang yin dris pas spos 'tshong gi rigs yin byas pas/ des spos btsongs pas nyin re la kar+ṣa pa ṇi brgyad brgyad rnyed cing / des ma la zhabs tog byas pas/ spos 'tshong rnams kyis bkag go /yang rigs gang yin dris pas gos 'tshong gi rigs yin byas pas/ des gos btsongs pas nyin re la kar+ṣa pa ṇi bcu drug bcu drug rnyed cing / des ma la bsnyen bkur byas pas/ gos 'tshong rnams kyis bkag go /yang rigs gang yin dris pas/ rin po che 'tshong ba'i rigs yin byas pas/ des rin po che btsongs pas kar+ṣa pa ṇi so gnyis re rnyed de/ des ma la bsnyen bkur byas pas/ rin po che 'tshong pa rnams kyis khyod nor bu 'don pa'i rigs yin pas/ khyod rang gi rigs kyi las gyi+is zer ro/ /der khos nga nor bu gdon du 'gro byas pas/ ma na re/ khyod kyi pha yang phyin pas shi/ khyod kyang 'chir yong ma 'gro zer nas song dogs nas/ nub mo sgo 'gag la mas nyal bas/ khos ma gnyid du song ba'i mgo la 'goms phyin pas rgya mtsho la gru zhig ste phal cher shi/ khos shing leb zhig la 'jus pas mtsho'i gling zhig la thon te/

de na rin po che'i khang pa cig 'dug pas/ de'i nang nas bud med mdzes ma bzhi byung nas/ khang par bos nas lha'i longs spyod kyi zhabs tog dpag med byas so/ /yang de las gzhan du phyin pas rin po che'i khang pa sngar bas ches lhag pa'i nang nas bud med brgyad byung nas khang par bos nas/ lha'i longs spyod kyi zhabs tog dpag tu med pa byas so/ /yang de las gzhan du phyin pas mkhar sngar bas che ba zhig gi nang nas bud med mdzes ma bcu drug byung nas khang par bos te sngar bas ldab 'gyur gyis lha'i longs spyod kyi zhabs tog byas so/ /yang de las gzhan du phyin pa dang mkhar sngar bas che ba zhig gi nas bud med mdzes ma so gnyis byung ste/ khang par bos te sngar bas ldab 'gyur gyi lha yi longs spyod kyi zhabs tog dpag tu med pa byas so/ /yang gzhan zhig tu phyin pas lcags kyi khang pa zhig 'dug der phyin pas mi gcig gi mgo la lcags kyi 'khor lo bskor nas klad pa'i dkyil 'bigs kyin 'dug 'dis ci byas pa yin dris pas ma'i mgo la 'goms pa'i rnam smin yin zer ro/ /'o na nga yang las kyis 'dir khrid pa yin nam snyam pa dang / de ma thag bcings pa grol bar 'gyur ro/ /grol ba bcing bar 'gyur ro zer nas 'khor lo mgo thog tu byung nas bskor bas bzod thabs med pa'i sdug bsngal byung ngo / /de'i don gyis rang dang 'dra ba'i sems can rnams la snying rje drag po skyes te/ de dag gi sdug bsngal bdag la smin par gyur cig snyam du dgongs pa dang / de ma thag 'khor lo nam mkha' la 'phags te sdug bsngal las grol lo/ /de yang thub pa nyid yin no/ /yang thub pa 'di nyid shing rta 'dren pa'i dmyal bar skyes pa'i tshe/ khong dang dmyal ba pa gzhan zhig gis a glang gi shing rta lcags kyi sa gzhi me rab tu 'bar ba'i thang la drangs pa dang / khong gnyis stobs chung ste ma drongs pas dmyal srungs rnams kyis mtshon cha rab tu 'bar bas bsnun cing 'tshog pas shin tu sdug bsngal ba la/

khong gi bsam pa la gnyis kas drangs kyang mi 'drongs pas nam yang sdug bsngal ba mtshungs par 'dug pas/ bdag gcig pus drangs te sdug bsngal bar byas la/ 'di bder gzhug dgos dgongs te/ dmyal srungs rnams la 'di'i thag pa yang bdag gi gnya' ba la thogs shig bdag gcig pus drang par bya'o byas pas dmyal srungs na re/ khyod snying rje che ba zhig yod zer nas lcags kyi tho ba mgo la brgyabs pas khong pa tshe 'phos te lhar skyes so/ /de nas gnas gsum la brtags pas dmyal ba nas lhar skye ba'i rgyu grogs la mnyam pa med pa'i snying rje dang phan sems skyes pa de yin par rtogs so/ /'di thub pa'i gzhan phan gyi thugs kyi thog ma yin zhes gsungs so/ /lung dri ma med par grags pa'i mdo la brten zhes pa'i don ni gong du bshad zin cing / rigs pa spyod 'jug gi rjes su 'brang zhes pa ni/ gong du rigs pa bo dhi'i+i sa la brten ces bshad mod/ zin bris las ni 'di ltar/ de nyid las/ bdag phyir gzhan la gnod byas na/ /dmyal la sogs par ltung bar 'gyur/ /gzhan phyir bdag la gnod byas na/ /phun sum tshogs pa thams cad 'thob/ /bdag nyid mtho bar 'dod pa de/ /ngan 'gro ngan dang glen par 'gyur/ /de nyid gzhan la spo byas na/ /bde 'gror rim gro thob par 'gyur/ /bdag gi don du gzhan bkol na/ /bran la sogs pa myong bar 'gyur/ /gzhan gyi don du bdag spyad na/ /rje dpon nyid sogs thob par 'gyur/ /'jig rten bde ba ji snyed pa/ /de kun gzhan bde 'dod las byung / /'jig rten sdug bsngal ji snyed pa/ /de kun bdag bde 'dod las byung / /mang du bshad lta ci zhig dgos/ /byis pa rang don byed pa dang / /thub pa gzhan gyi don mdzad pa/ /'di gnyis kyi ni khyad par ltos/ /bdag bde gzhan gyi sdug bsngal dag /yang dag brje bar ma byas na/ /sangs rgyas nyid du mi 'grub cing / /'khor ba na yang bde ba med/

/ces sogs rigs pa mang po gsungs ba'i rjes su 'brangs nas bdag gzhan brje ba bsgom pa yin gsungs te/ don 'di nyid blo sbyong gsol 'debs su yang / rang bde 'dod las nyes pa kun 'byung zhing / /gzhan phan sems las yon tan kun 'byung phyir/ /gzhan skyon bdag la len cing bdag nyid kyi/ /bde dge gzhan la gtong bar byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes gsungs so/ /'dir zin bris chen mo las/ sngon 'gro byams snying rje bsgom zhes pa zhig bskangs nas gsungs te/ 'di'i 'thad pa yang sngon 'gro byams snying rje bsgom pa 'di med na/ dngos gzhi bdag gzhan brje ba yang kha tsam tshig tsam du 'gro bas/ sngon 'gro byams snying rje bsgom pa la nan tan cher bya zhes gsungs da lta'i blo sbyong gi 'khrid 'bogs tshul la ni 'di kho na bzhin rigs par snang ngo / /'on kyang gzhung rtsa ba'i dgongs pa ni/ dang po sngon 'gro dag la bslab ces pa'i skabs su/ bla ma tshad ldan gyi drung du skyes bu gsum ga'i lam la blo sbyong tshad du longs par byas nas smon 'jug gi sems bskyed pa zhig gis dkyus nas 'byung ba bzhin byams snying rje sngar skyes zin gsal 'debs pa tsam gyis chog par dgongs so// pa ni chos rje ba'i dgongs par snang ste/ don 'di la dgongs nas gsol 'debs su yang / thog med dus nas gnyen gyur 'gro ba rnams/ /sdug bsngal rgya mtshor bying ba mthong gyur nas/ bu sdug chu yis khyer ba'i ma bzhin du/ /bcos min snying rje skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes gsungs par snang ngo / /des na 'dir sngon 'gro byams snying rje bsgom pa la gsum ste/ skye sla ba la dmigs te bsgom/ skye dka' ba la/ thams cad la dmigs te bsgom pa'o/ /dang po la drin che ba dang / sdug bsngal che ba dang / sdig pa che ba la dmigs te bsgom pa gsum gyi dang po ni/ tshe 'dir drin che shos ma yin pas/ de la thog mar bsgom pa ni/

ma 'dis bdag la byams pa'i mig gis bltas/ brtse ba'i sems kyis bzung ste 'phral dang yun du phan pa'i phyogs rnams bsgrubs pa dang / gnod pa dang sdug bsngal rnams las ci nus kyis bskyabs pa dang / bdag la sdug bsngal byung dus mi bzod pa'i sgo gsum gyi rnam 'gyur dang / bdag gi ched du sdig sdug dang du blangs pa rnams bsams nas snying rje drag tu bsgom/ de'i dus du bla ma dkon mchog la gsol ba 'debs pa dang / skyabs 'gro byed cing bsgoms na 'chun che zhing skye sla bar 'dug pas de bzhin bya/ skyabs gsol byed pa'i dus su rang btang snyoms su gzhag ma dmigs yul du byas la de'i sdig sdug rnams bsams te/ skyabs gsol snying gi dkyil rus pa'i gting nas bya/ gzhan la mi gnod na skad gsang mthon po bya/ snying rje skyes na nyams byung rgyal du bskyang zhing sna mi bskyil/ de ltar drag la yun ring ba bsgoms pas/ snying rje skyes te ma de'i sdig sdug bsal ba dang / bde dge bskyed par 'dod kyang de'i nus pa bdag la med cing / bla ma dkon mchog la yod pas ma lag zha ma'i bu chus khyer na/ gzhan la ra mda' sbron pa bzhin du/ bla ma dkon mchog la skyabs 'gro dang gsol 'debs drag po bya'o/ /mas mtshon te pha la sogs pa gang snying nye ba dang drin che ba rnams la de ltar bsgom/ gnyis pa sdug bsngal che ba la bsgom pa ni/ dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro rnams kyi sdug bsngal kun bsams te/ 'di rnams ni bdag tsha bas cung zad gdungs pa'ang ma bzod nas bsil ba'i thabs byed pa dang / tha na bdag gi kha tshig gis dogs nas tshod ma la phus 'debs pa dang / bdag 'khyags kyis dogs nas lus kyi drod kyis bsro ba dang / bdag bkres skom gyis dogs nas rang gis spyod mi nus pa'i longs spyod rnams phangs pa med par ster ba dang / nu zhos yang yang bskyangs pa dang / bdag la tha na bza' btung gi tshul tshun chod legs par slob cing /

bdag na yis dogs/ shi yis dogs nas dka' ba dpag med spyod pa'i ma rnams yin na/ 'di dag tsha grang bkres skom glen lkugs sogs kyis gzir ba'i gnas skabs 'di 'drar gyur pa re snying rje snyam du drag tu bsgom zhing / snying rje ma skyes pa skyed pa dang / skyes na de dag sdug bsngal dang bral ba dang/ bde ba la 'god pa'i don du sngar bzhin gsol ba gdab bo/ /yang rnam pa gsal ba'i dgra dang / nad gdon dang / khral bu lon sogs kyis nyam thag pa'i mi sogs sdug bsngal gang che ba la'ang de ltar bsgom mo/ /gsum pa sdig pa che ba la bsgom pa ni/ kha drag btsan phyug 'dzom zhing / 'khor g.yog mang la sdig pa rlabs chen byed pa 'di rnams ngan song bas kyang ches cher snying rje bar 'dug pas/ 'di dag la snying rje drag po skye thang ba la mi skye ba de/ brtags na rang la'ang tshe 'di'i phun tshogs thob 'dod blo phugs na yod pa'i rtags su gda' gsung / 'di rnams rang gzhan la gang phan byas pas chog pa la/ tshe 'di'i bya ba cung zad re'i phyir 'di tsam pa'i sdig pa byed byed nas dngos su rang gzhan gnyis phung byed cing / phugs su rang gi 'dun ma gtan brlag la gtong ba 'di rnams sems so na gnas pas dug 'thungs na ci zer/ des dper yang mi bzod na 'di lta bu'i las byed pa re snying rje snyam du drag tu bsgom zhing / yang sngar ltar bya'o/ /gzhan yang gang sdig pa che che rnams la'ang de ltar bsgom mo/ /gnyis pa skye dka' ba la bsgom pa ni/ bdag gis phan btags pa'i lan du gnod pa byed pa lta bu la bsgom ste/ 'dis thog ma med pa nas sdug bsngal dpag med myong zhing / da dung yang gnod pa la sogs pa'i las ngan bsags pas sdug bsngal dpag med myong bar 'gyur la/ 'di dag gis kyang bdag gi pha ma yang yang byas shing phan yang yang btags pa'i drin can yin na/ 'di ltar gyur pa re snying rje snyam du sngar bzhin bsgom mo/

/yang gnod byed 'dis sngar phan btags par ma zad da ltar yang 'di la brten nas bzod pa 'byung bas/ pha ma'am mkhan slob pas kyang drin che bas mchod par 'os shing de la dga' bar bya ste/ de nyid bzod pa'i rgyu yin pas/ /dam pa'i chos bzhin mchod par 'os/ /byang chub spyod pa'i grogs gyur pa/ /bdag gi dgra la dga' bar bya/ /zhes so/ /de ltar drin can 'dis sdug bsngal mang po myangs shing myong bar 'gyur bar 'dug pas re snying rje snyam du sngar bzhin no/ yang / bdag gis sngon chad sems can la/ /'di 'dra ba yi gnod pa byas/ /zhes sogs rgyas par gsungs pa ltar bdag gis sems can kun dang khyad par 'di la sngon gnod pa mang po byas pa'i lan chags sam/ rnam smin ngan song gi sdug bsngal mang po myong 'gyur yod pa la 'dis lan chags snyog tu byung bas go bcad/ phyin chad lan chags kyi khur med pa a re dga'/ sku drin che/ 'dis ni bdag la phan 'ba' zhig btags 'dug ste/ bdag gi las ngan gyis skul nas/ 'dis bdag la gnod pa'i las byas par yun ring por 'dis sdug bsngal myong zhing myong bar 'dug pas re snying rje snyam du drag tu bsgom mo/ /gsum pa thams cad la bsgom pa ni/ sems can thams cad bdag la phan 'dogs 'dogs pa'i nye du rnams yin la/ de rnams yal bar 'dor bar mi rigs te/ slob spring las/ nye du 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho'i khongs su chud gyur pa/ /klong gi nang du ltung ba lta bur snang bzhin du/ /skye shi 'phos pas ngo ma shes pa de bor nas/ /gal te gcig thar byed na de las khrel bor med/ /byis pa pang na btsa' ba ci yang mi nus pa/ /gang gi nu zho byams pa'i shugs kyis gzags 'thungs pa/ /ngal ba mang bsten byams par byas pa de dag 'dir/ /shin tu ma rabs zhig na'ang spong bar su zhig spro/ /gang gi khong na 'di skabs rnyed nas gnas gnas shing / /gang gi rtse bag sems kyis zon byas 'di blangs pa/

/nyon mongs de dag sdug bsngal skyabs med 'di bor nas/ /'gro ba ma rabs zhig na'ang spong bar su zhig spro/ /zhes dang / byas pa shes shing byas pa gzo/ /byas pa chud zos mi byed pa'i/ /mi la dpal mgon nye bar gnas/ /zhes pas sems can thams cad kyi byas pa shes dgos/ 'o na de dag gi byas par rang ji tsam yod na/ sems can thams cad drin can 'ba' zhig yin te/ slob spring las/ gang gi ltor ma nyal ba'i sems can de yod min/ /'gro ba gnyen ma gyur pa'i sems can de gang med/ /ces so/ /de'ang lan cig ma yin te/ bshes spring las/ ma yi thug mtha' rgya shug tshig gu tsam/ /ril bur bgrangs kyang sa yis lang mi 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /de ltar ma byas res kyis phan dpag med btags te/ gang gis bdag gi ma byas shing / /ma yi nu zho 'thungs pa tsam/ /rgya mtsho bzhi yi chu la'ang med/ /gang gis bdag gi pha byas shing / /rta dang glang po byin pa yang / /tshangs pa'i 'jig rten las kyang thal/ /zhes pas/ drin can de rnams thog ma med pa nas gnas 'di ru ma 'khyams bya ba med de/ slob spring las/ yul phyogs gang du gnas ma bcas pa'i gnas de med/ /ces so/ /lus 'di ma blangs bya ba dang / /sdug bsngal 'di ma myong bya ba med/ de'ang lan cig lan gnyis ma yin te/ slob spring las/ 'khor bar lan brgya ma song 'gro ba gang zhig yod/ /sngon chad lan mang ma myong sdug bsngal de yang min/ /zhes gsungs pas mnar med du skyes pa'i grangs kyang bgrang gis mi lang / las 'di ma byas bya ba med de pha ma bsad pa'i grangs kyang mi chod/ zas 'di ma zos/ gos 'di ma gyon bya ba med de mi gtsang ba zos 'thungs byas pa dang / lcags kyi gos 'bar ba gyon pa bsags kyang 'jig rten du mi shong ba tsam yod kyang des ngoms pa dang sun pa med de/ slob spring las/ 'gro ba gang gis tshim gyur 'dod pa de dag med/ /ces so/ /sngar dag song zin te/ de yang lam mi sgrub pa rnams la sngar bas kyang ches mang ba'i lus blang dgos te/

'on kyang / 'khor ba pa la chags bral med/ /ces gsungs so/ /yang bslab btus las/ nyon mongs kyis smyo gti mug mdongs/ /g.yang sa mang po'i lam du ni/ /gom pa re res brdeg 'cha' ba/ /bdag dang gzhan rtag mya ngan gzhi/ /'gro ba rnams ni sdug bsngal mtshungs/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin du rang gi tshe 'di'i ma lta bu de shes pa gdon gyis brlams pas ni smyo bar gyur/ mig kyang long / long khrid kyang med/ sa logs kyang mi bde/ de'i dbang gis gom pa re bor ba na brdeg 'cha' zhing 'ong / de nas kyang g.yang sa 'jigs su rung bar ltung bar 'dug de la snying rje bcos ma ma yin pa zhig skye ba yin/ de bzhin du sems can thams cad ma ni yin/ nyon mongs pa'i gdon gyis btab ste thog ma med pa nas smyos pa bzhin du gyur/ gti mug gis shes rab kyi mig kyang long / dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi long 'khrid kyang med/ 'khor ba'i bkan bub mang pos lam yang mi bde/ de nas ngan song rnam pa gsum gyi g.yang sar 'og nas 'og tu khrogs kyis ltung ba rnams la dmigs kyin yang snying rje bsgom mo/ /'di skye ba'ang sla zhing bsod nams kyang che ste/ rin chen phreng ba las/ gang phyir sems can tshad med par/ /phan 'dod de ni de 'dra'o/ /zhes so/ /gzhan yang byams snying rje bsgoms pa 'di shin tu gal che ba'i shes byed kyi lung rnams dang / bsod nams che tshul dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen glang thang pas skye ba ril gyis byams snying rje 'ba' zhig bsgom pa'i dam bca' mdzad tshul dang / dge bshes ston pa'ang byams snying rje bsgom pa la dgyes tshul dang / byams snying rje bcos min zhig yod na bdag gzhan brje ba'am/ lus srog la'ang mi lta bar gzhan don la 'jug tshul ston pa'i sngon gyi skyes rabs gsum dang bcas pa zin bris chen mo las 'byung bas der shes par bya'o/ /der 'byung ba'i skyes bu chen po'i rnam rtog brgyad ni/

bdag gis nam zhig sems can gyi sdug bsngal sel nus snyam pa dang / nam zhig dbul bas nyen pa'i sems can rnams 'byor pa chen po la 'jog nus snyam pa dang / nam zhig sha khrag dang bcas pa'i lus kyis sems can gyi don byed nus snyam pa dang / nam zhig dmyal bar yun ring du gnas nas kyang sems can la phan 'dogs nus snyam pa dang / nam zhig 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i 'byor ba chen pos sems can rnams kyi bsam pa rdzogs par byed nus snyam pa dang / nam zhig sangs rgyas su gyur nas sems can rnams kyi sdug bsngal nges par 'byin nus snyam pa dang / sems can la mi phan pa'i skye ba dang / don dam pa'i ro la gcig tu spyod pa dang / skye bo thams cad sim par mi byed pa'i tshig dang / gzhan la mi phan pa'i 'tsho ba dang / lus dang / shes rab dang / nor dang / dbang phyug dang ldan pa dang / gzhan la gnod pa byed pa la dga' bar tshe rabs thams cad du ma gyur cig snyam pa dang / sems can rnams kyi sdig pa'i 'bras bu bdag la smin cing / bdag gi dge ba'i 'bras bu de dag la smin par gyur cig snyam pa rnams so/ /'di rnams ngo bo rnam rtog yin yang shin tu ngo mtshar can yin pas skyes bu chen po rnams kyang sgom par gsungs na/ 'o skol rnams lta ci smos pas 'bad nas bsgom par bya'o/ /de dag gis ni sngon 'gro byams snying rje bsgom pa bstan to/ /gnyis pa kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems bdag gzhan brje ba bsgom pa dngos ni/ slob dpon zhi ba lhas gsungs shing shin tu gal yang che ste/ gang zhig bdag dang gzhan rnams ni/ /myur du bskyab par 'dod pa des/ /bdag dang gzhan du brje bya ba/ /gsang ba'i dam pa spyad par bya/ /bdag bde gzhan gyi sdug bsngal dag /yang dag brje bar ma byas na/ /sangs rgyas nyid du mi 'grub cing / /'khor ba na yang bde ba med/ /de ltas bdag gnod zhi ba dang / /gzhan gyi sdug bsngal zhi bya'i phyir/

/bdag nyid gzhan la gtang ba dang / /gzhan rnams bdag bzhin gzung bar bya/ /bdag nyid skyon bcas gzhan la yang / /yon tan rgya mtshor shes byas nas/ /bdag 'dzin yongs su dor ba dang / /gzhan blang ba ni bsgom par bya/ /zhes dang / jo bo gser gling pas/ bdag ni las ngan gyi rtsa ba ste/ /rgyangs kyis bskyur pa'i chos shig yin/ /gzhan ni byang chub kyi 'byung khungs te/ /cangs kyis blang ba'i chos shig yin/ /zhes gsung ngo / /yang spyod 'jug las/ sems can rnams kyi klad nad tsam/ /bsal lo snyam du bsams na yang / /phan 'dogs bsam pa dang ldan te/ /bsod nams dpag med ldan 'gyur na/ /sems can re re'i mi bde ba/ /dpag tu med pa bsal 'dod cing / /re re'ang yon tan dpag med du/ /bsgrub par 'dod pa smos ci dgos/ /pha 'am yang na ma yang rung / /su la 'di 'dra'i phan sems yod/ /lha dang drang srong rnams kyang rung / /tshangs pa la yang 'di yod dam/ /sems can de dag nyid pa'ang sngon/ /rang gi don du'ang 'di dra'i sems/ /rmi lam du yang ma rmis na/ /gzhan gyi don du ga la skye/ /gzhan dag rang gi don du yang / /mi 'byung sems can don sems gang / /sems kyi rin chen khyad par 'di/ /snga na med pa'i rmad cig 'khrungs/ /gang zhig bde bas phongs pa dang / /sdug bsngal mang ldan de dag la/ /bde ba kun gyis tshim pa dang / /sdug bsngal thams cad gcod byed cing / /gti mug kyang ni sel byed pa/ /de dang dge mtshungs ga la yod/ /de 'dra'i bshes kyang ga la yod/ /bsod nams de 'dra ga la yod/ /ces so/ /des na sems rin po che 'di 'dra rgyud la skyes pa de phyag gi gnas su dgongs nas/ gang la sems kyi dam pa rin chen de/ /skyes pa de yi sku la phyag 'tshal zhing / /zhes sogs gsung so/ /des na 'di ji ltar bsgom pa'i tshul ni gal che ba'i nang nas kyang shin tu gal che ba yin zhing / ji tsam rgyas pa de tsam du phan che zhing don che bar snang bas na bstan bshad gnyis kyi sgo nas bshad par bya'o/

/de la dang po ngag don gzung bde ba'i phyir rje btsun gong ma'i gsung la brten nas mdor bstan pa ni/ 'di la mnyam rjes gnyis las/ mnyam gzhag tu nyams su blang ba'i tshul ni/ gtong len gnyis po spel mar sbyang / /zhes pa ste stan bde ba la bsdad/ thog mar/ rang gi rtsa ba'i ma gsal bar dmigs te/ de la byams snying rje bsgom pa ni/ ma 'dis bdag la thog ma kho nar dal 'byor gyi lus byin nas chud ma zos par bskyangs pas/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang mjal nas bde ba'i sna kha nas bzung du byung bas shin tu drin che/ tshe 'dir yang lto na gnas pa dang / btsas pa'i gnas skabs thams cad bsam sbyor thams cad kyi nus pas gces par bskyangs pas phan chen po btags/ de tsam du ma zad 'khor ba thog ma med pa'i dus nas kyang pha ma nye du 'brel ba rgya shug gi tshig gu bas kyang grangs mang ba tsam du gyur nas/ byams pa'i mig gis lta lta ba/ brtse ba'i sems kyis 'dzin 'dzin pa/ gnod pa dang mi phan pa thams cad las skyob skyob pa/ phan pa dang bde ba thams cad kyis phan 'dogs ba'i drin can rang du 'dug pa ang snyam du bsams shing / mig nas mchi ma 'brul ba'am/ lus la ba spu ldang ba tsam gyi shes pa nye dungs pa bskyed de/ yid du 'ong la gces par 'dzin cing bde ba dang phrad par 'dod pa'i byams pa sgom mo/ /de nas sdug bsngal dang phral bar 'dod pa'i snying rje bsgom pa ni/ de ltar shin tu drin che ba'i ma 'di thog ma med pa nas bdag gi don byed byed nas/ nyon mongs pa dang las ngan thams cad bsags te/ spyir 'khor ba mtha' med dang / khyad par ngan song gsum du 'khyams nas sdug bsngal mi bzad pa mtha' yas pa myong dgos pa 'di snying re rje snyam du mi bzod pa'i bsam pa rtse yam pa bskyed la/ da ni ngas kyang ma 'di la drin lan gzhal ba'i phyir phan pa dang bde ba thams cad kyis phan gdags par bya/ gnod pa dang mi phan pa thams cad las bskyab par bya snyam du bsam/

'o na ma rgan la gang gis gnod na sdug bsngal dang kun 'byung gnyis kyis gnod/ de yang sdug bsngal gyis dngos su gnod/ kun 'byung gis brgyud nas gnod pas de gnyis ngas blang bar bya snyam du bsams la/ ma rgan gyi rgyud la yod pa'i sdug bsngal kun 'byung / nyon mongs shes bya'i sgrib pa bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad skyi gris bzhar ba bzhin du/ ma rgan gyi rgyud las sangs kyis blangs pas rang gi snying gi nang du byung bar bsgom zhing byung na dga' ba'i 'dun pa drag tu bya'o/ /de ni byang chub kyi sems blang ba sgom pa yin no/ /yang ma la gang gis phan na bde ba dang dge bas phan pas ma rgan gyi phan bde thams cad ngas bsgrub par bya'o snyam du bsams la rang gi lus longs spyod bde dge thams cad ma rgan drin can la ltos pa med par dbul/ de ltar phul bas ma rgan 'phral la bde zhing / chos sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen thams cad 'dzom nas rim gyis sangs rgyas par bsam zhing de ltar gyur na dga' ba'i 'dun pa drag tu bya'o/ /de yang spyod 'jug las/ sems can rnams don bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /yid bzhin gyi ni lus su bsgyur/ /zhes gsungs ba'i don lags pas/ rang gi lus longs spyod dge ba rnams yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che dang 'dra bar bsams la/ de rnams las ma rgan gyi chos kyi mthun rkyen zas gos/ gnas khang g.yog 'khor bla ma bsten pa sogs byang chub sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen thams cad tshang la rdzogs par byung nas/ de la brten nas ma rgan rim gyis tshogs rdzogs/ sgrib pa byang nas sangs rgyas par bsam ste/ de ni byang chub kyi sems gtong ba sgom pa yin no/ /de ltar byams snying rje sngon du song bas/ gtong len gnyis po res mos su spel zhing nyams su blangs ba'i sgo nas rlan phebs par bya/ de ltar sbyangs pas ma rgan gyi sdug bsngal spong zhing bde ba bsgrub pa la rang gi phyogs nas rtsis mi 'debs par dngos su brje nus par song ba na tshad du longs pa yin no/

/de nas thun gnyis par spo ba la/ sems can thams cad la byams pa dang snying rje sngon du 'gro bas 'di ltar bsam ste/ ngas sems bskyed pa'i dus su lus longs spyod dge ba rnams sems can la btang zin pa yin/ sems can thams cad kyi don bdag gcig pus sgrub par khas blangs khur khyer ba yin pas da ni bdag gis de ltar dngos su sgrub par bya dgos snyam du bsams la/ sems can rnams la gtong len gnyis snga ma bzhin du spel zhing sbyong ngo / /sems can gyi sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras blangs nas thams cad kyi tshab mar dmyal ba'i khang bar mos bar bya'o/ /'di'i skabs su gtong ba na sems can re res kyang lus longs spyod dge ba cha tshang re thob par bsam mo/ /de ltar sems can thams cad la blos lings kyis ltos pa med par btang la sems can su 'dod pa khyer cig bdag gi lus longs spyod dge ba'i cha shas gang 'dod pa khyer cig de dag la khyed rang ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin gyis shig ces rang rtsi sman gyi sdong po bzhin du sems can kun gyi nye bar mkho ba'i gsos chen por bsams la dga' gdung thams cad spangs te/ blo sbyong zhing ngag tu'ang gdon par bya'o/ /de ltar lhug par btang ba des sems can rnams kyi 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i bde ba thams cad kyi rgyur bdag po gcig pu gyur cig sdug bsngal thams cad sel bar gyur cig sems can rnams kyi lam dang 'bras bu'i yon tan thams can bdag la brten nas 'byung bar gyur cig snyam du blo sbyong zhing ngag tu yang gdon par bya'o/ /de ltar blo sbyong ba'i skabs skabs su sangs rgyas la yang sems can gyi don las med pas/ sa bcu'i dbang phyug chen po'i thugs dam da lta nyid nas nyams su blang du yod pa 'di nga re dga' snyam du bsam/ yang nyan rang dang sa la gnas pa'i byang sems 'phags pa rnams kyi rgyud la yod pa'i shes bya'i sgrib pa rnams blang zhing rang gi gsum po btang bas tshogs rdzogs par bsam mo/

/'phags pa'i gang zag 'di kun sems can spyi'i nang du bsdus kyang chog 'di ltar so sor byas kyang chog gang bde ba yin gsung / de gnyis rlung la bskyon par bya/ /zhes pa ni gtong len gnyis po rlung phyir 'gro nang 'gro la brten te sbyong / 'di ni 'di nyid la sems gzung sla ba dang / blo 'byongs skyen pa dang / rnam rtog mang po gzhun pa'i ched du mdzad do/ /gnyis pa rjes nas ji ltar bslab pa ni/ /yul gsum dug gsum dge rtsa gsum/ /zhes pas bstan te/ rjes nas spyod yul yongs su dag pa'i sgo nas blo sbyang ba'o/ /gzugs la sogs pa'i yul yid du 'ong mi 'ong tha mal pa gsum la brten nas chags sdang rmongs gsum skyes pa na 'di ltar blo sbyang ste/ bdag da lta 'dod chags la spyod pa bzhin 'jig rten gyi khams na yang 'dod chags kyi dbang du song ba dpag tu med pa yod pa snying re rje snyam du bsams la/ de thams cad blos 'ubs bsdus rang gi snying gi nang du blangs nas sems can thams cad 'dod chags med pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba dang ldan par gyur cig snyam du bsam/ de bzhin du dug lnga la sbyar la nyams su blang ngo / /man gang snying po mdor bsdus pa/ /spyod lam kun tu tshig gis sbyang / /zhes pa ni blo sbyong tshig tsam du sbyong ba ste/ sems can kun gyi sdug bsngal bdag la smin/ /bdag gi dge bas de kun bde thob shog /ces bka' bstan bcos nas 'byung ba'i tshig gam/ yang na sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas pa thams cad bdag la smin nas/ bdag thul gyis brlag par gyur cig bdag gi bde ba thams cad khyed la smin nas/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan par gyur cig ces mi med pa'i dus ngag tu yang gdon no/ /rus pa'i gting nas skyes pa'i bsam pas a tsa ma nga'i ma rgan rnams/ nga'i jo bo sems can 'di rnams kho na snying re rje zhes ngag gi rnam 'gyur bya'o/

/de ltar spyod lam rnam bzhi la tshig gis sbyong ba 'di ni mdo nas byams pa tshig tsam du bsgom par gsungs pa'i lag len yin no/ /de dag ni mdor bstan pa yin no/ /de nyid rje btsun spyan ras gzigs kyi rnam 'phrul sangs rgyas sgom pa'i gsung la brten nas rgyas par bshad pa ni/ sngon 'gro rten gyi chos bstan nas/ dngos gzhi rang gang sgom na/ dngos gzhi gtong len spel mar sbyang zhes te/ len pa med na brje bar mi 'gro/ gtong ba med par tshogs mi rdzogs pas gtong len gnyis yin no/ /bdag dang gzhan du brje bya ba/ /gsang ba'i dam pa spyad par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don yin no/ /de'ang gong du bstan pa ltar sngon du bdag med gnyis bsgoms nas de nas 'di bsgom pa'i lugs kyang yod pa las/ 'dir bla ma gser gling pa'i lugs kyis bdag 'dzin dang bcas pa'i dus nas bsgom pa yin/ gtong len gnyis kyang sngon du len pa bsgom/ /de'i dmigs pa'i yul yang kha cig gyad stobs po che thub na thams cad thub pa'i dpes mi dga' 'am mi sdug pa la bsgom zer ba yang yod/ slob dpon ka ma la shī las tha mal pa nas bsgom zer ba yod kyang / jo bo skye sla bas rtsa ba'i ma nas bsgom par bzhed/ kun slong gi bsam pa tshad med pa'i bsam pa yang / slob dpon ka ma la shī la thang mnyam pa'i chu drang sla ba ltar btang snyoms nas sems pa yang yod/ dpal bskal pa bzang po'i rdo rje la sogs pa rtsa ba yin pas snying rje nas sgom pa yang yod/ jo bo byams pa nas sgom par bzhed/ de yang 'di ltar bsam par bya ste/ thog ma nyid du rang gi rtsa ba'i ma gang yin pa de ma shi bar yod na/ gang na yod ba'i sa der gsal bar yod pas der dmigs/ shi nas med na mdun du dmigs la/ ma de'i skye ba 'di dang gzhan gyi drin dran pa sngon du 'gro bas snying du sdug cing yid du 'ong ba dang gces par 'dzin pa'i bsam pa bskyed nas ma rgan 'di bde ba dang ldan na ci ma rung /

bdag gis bde ba la 'god par bya/ phan pa dang bde ba thams cad bdag gis bsgrub bar bya'o snyam du bsam pa thag pa nas byams pa'i sems gsal sing ba bsgom par bya/ 'dod pa bde ba 'dod kyang ngo bo sdug bsngal las ma 'das pas/ ma rgan 'di sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas pa thams cad dang bral na ci ma rung / bdag gis sdug bsngal thams cad las bsgral bar bya snyam du bsam pa thag pa nas snying rje bsgom par bya'o/ /de yang ma mi drin na zhang po la sogs pa gang drin che ba nas bsgom zhes rnal 'byor pa chen pos gsung skad/ sne'u zur pas dge bshes mnga' ris pa a ne la dmigs nas sems su bcug pa lta bu'o/ /bsam pa des kun nas bslangs nas ma'i rgyud la yod pa'i sdug bsngal dang kun 'byung len pa ste/ 'bras bu sdug bsngal zhes pa skye rga na 'chi'i sdug bsngal nas grang ba dang / btso sreg dang / glen zhing gti mug pa dang / bkres skom la sogs ba'i sdug bsngal brgyad dam gsum gyi bar gyis bsdus pa 'tshang rgya ba'i gegs su gyur pa thams cad ma'i rgyud la skyi gris bzhar ba bzhin sangs kyis blangs nas rang gi snying gi dkyil du len/ blangs nas kyang rang la mi 'byung bar byed pa'am/ de blangs nas rtsar 'jog pa lta bu ma yin te/ snying gi nang du len pa yin gyi/ yan lag gzhan la 'jog pa tsam yang ma yin/ de blangs pas rang la phan du re ba la sogs pa'i ltos pa gang yang med par len pa'o/ /de'i rgyu kun 'byung las dang nyon mongs pa gnyis las/ las kyi kun 'byung mi dge ba bcu/ mtshams med pa lnga/ de dang nye ba lnga/ khas blangs kyi sdom pa gsum dang 'gal ba/ dmyal bar mda' phangs pa bzhin 'gro ba'i rgyu bzhi la sogs pa dang / nyon mongs pa'i kun 'byung dug gsum mam/ drug rtsa ba/ nyi shu nye ba'i nyon mong pa'am/ nyon mongs pa brgyad khri bzhi stong ngam/ sbubs bye ba mtha' yas pa gsungs pa'am/ mthong spang dang sgom spang ste rdo rje lta bu'i spang bya man chad len pa'o/

/de ltar sdug bsngal dang kun 'byung ste spang bya ma lus pa sgrib pa gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa dang bral nas sangs rgyas par sems pa'o/ /de nas pha dang spun zla la sogs pa nas nye 'brel yul mi khyim mtshes nas stong gsum gyi bar sems pa'o/ /sa mtshams lkog chos nas 'byung ba bzhin no/ /de nas/ go yul yungs kar bgrangs pas bskyed/ ces pa ltar stong gsum yungs kar gyis bkang nas shar phyogs kyi stong gsum re rer yungs kar re re bzhag pas yungs kar zad kyang shar phyogs la 'bri ba med pa ltar phyogs bcu kun la sbyar te/ nam mkha'i mthas khyab kyi sems can la bsgom pa'o/ /de nas ngan song gi yang dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal me las gyur pa dang / mtshon cha las gyur pa dang / nad las gyur pa dang / sems can las gyur pa dang / chu bur can nas pad+ma ltar cher gas pa'i bar dang / rgyu kun 'byung zhe sdang la sogs pa'i nyon mongs dang / mi dge ba cher spyad pa thams cad len/ yi dwags kyi yang bkres skom la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal dang / 'dod chags la sogs pa'i nyon mongs pa dang / mi dge ba 'bring du spyad pa thams cad len/ dud 'gro'i gcig gis gcig za ba la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal dang / gti mug la sogs pa'i nyon mongs pa dang / mi dge ba chung ngu spyad pa thams cad len/ mtho ris kyi yang mi'i skye rga na 'chi la sogs pa/ 'dod lha'i 'chi ltas la sogs/ khams gong ma gnyis kyi 'chi 'pho dang ltung ba la sogs pa thams cad len/ res sems can gyi khams dang / res re re dang / de'i yang sems can re re nas len/ de med na kha la yam las don thog tu mi skyol/ res nam mkha'i mthas khyab kyi sems can ma lus pa la dus gcig la len/ de med na blo'i 'bral mi yong / res dmyal ba lta bu sems can re re'i rtsar rang gi lus re re bsams nas len/ res lus 'di gcig pu la thams cad kyi len/ res rags rim nas len/

res gang gnad pa'i len/ res 'di kun la spyad mi dgos snyam pa mi gnad pa'i len/ res dmyal ba'i blangs sangs rgyas par bsam pa nas/ byang chub sems dpa'i sa nas blangs sangs rgyas pa'i bar du sems/ res dmyal ba'i blangs yi dwags su drangs/ de nas drangs dud 'gro/ de nas mi/ de nas 'dod lha ris drug de nas gzugs khams gnas gzhan bcu bdun/ de nas gzugs med mu bzhi/ de nas nyan rang byang sems sa bcu'i bar du rim pas len/ res nyon mongs pa rnams phye nas len/ res las rnams/ res sdug bsngal rnams phye nas len/ res mi rtag pa nas dngos 'dzin gyi bar lam rim gyi mi mthun pa'i phyogs rnams len/ res ser sna sogs phyin drug gi mi mthun pa'i phyogs rnams len/ res gtsang bar 'dzin pa sogs byang chub kyi phyogs kyi mi mthun pa'i phyogs rnams len/ res sa bcu'i mi mthun pa'i phyogs rnams len/ res ngan rtog sna tshogs nas mthong spang sgom spang gi bar gyi nyon sgrib thams cad len/ res rtog pa dgu bzhi sum cu rtsa drug nas rtog pa phra mo'i bar shes bya'i sgrib pa thams cad len/ de ltar sems tshul sna tshogs kyis bsams pas mi skyo/ nges shing don thog tu skyal/ blo 'byongs skyen/ shes bya la sbyangs pa che/ zhor la chos gzhan gyi grangs yan tshad tshang / sdig pa mang po 'dag tshogs mang po bsogs skyen pa la sogs pa 'byung ba'o/ /de yang dgra dang tha mal du byas pa la mi skye bas ma drin can du byas nas sems pa'o/ /de yang ma min pa la yin par sems pa min te/ thog ma med pa nas kyi ma drin can yin pas yin pa la yin par sems pa'o/ /de rnams kyang byams snying rje gsal sing ba res kun nas bslang zhing len pa'o/ /'phags pa nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas la de gnyis blang rgyu cang yod dam snyam na/ yod de ltos pa dang bcas pa thams cad sdug bsngal yin la/ khong 'khor ba la 'jigs pa dang bcas pa dang /
