rang gis ni lto dang gos dang nyal sa tsam yang mi rnyed/ 'khor ba ni mi gcig kyang med pa'i byan pa'i mdze pho de gnyis lta bu byung tsa na nya ldog dogs yod pas chos de tsa na dgos zer ba gda'/ gzhan yang lhog rgod dam/ pho log gam/ nor phrog pa dang / mthun rkyen ma 'dzom pa dang / gtam ngan dang brnyas pa la sogs pa ci byung yang 'jig rten gyi khams na 'di kho na 'dra ba dpag tu med pa zhig yod pas de rnams snying re rje snyam du bsams la/ de dag gi mi 'dod pa thams cad bdag la smin la sems can gyis 'di 'dra ba'i sdug bsngal myong bar ma gyur cig snyam du bsam/ rang gi lus longs spyod dge rtsa thams cad gzhan la btang nas sems can thams cad bde skyid snyan gsum dang ldan par bsam/ rang la tshe 'di la yang ji 'dra yong mi shes te/ las ci 'dra bsags mi shes pas sdug bsngal ri rdib pa tsam byung yang ji snyam du yang mi byed pa sdug na sdug theg cing chos mi 'chor ba/ skyid na skyid theg nas chos mi 'chor ba zhig dgos/ 'di med na dbyar re dgun re'i bran zla re re gnyis gnyis po rang yang mthun pa med/ dge slong yin na lag bde mi rnyed/ dge tshul yin na slob dpon mi rnyed/ de cis lan na 'di med pas lan/ rang kho na mtho dga' dang bzang dga' rgyal rgyu byung re 'dod pas lan pa yin gsung / der ma song bran zla rnyed tsam pa'i bzod pa re bskyed dang / tshe 'di rang la yang 'dod mkhan med pa 'di las nyes pa che ba mi gda' ba gzigs dang / bdag tu 'dzin pa 'di la ko long zhig gsol ma nus na rta sga sngas su bcug na bde mi srid zer ba ltar song nas ji ltar byas kyang bde ba med/ gang ltar byas kyang ma btub pa 'di med pas lan/ da lta ma bsgoms na ma 'ongs pa na yang mi yong / 'di la thos pa che ba dang sgom bzang ba dang / sngags kyi nus pa thob pa la sogs pa mi dgos/ ka kha ngo mi shes pas kyang btub/

'di nyid dran pa'i dus nyid nas lhod song nas bde ba rgyas nas yong / nyon mongs pa'i gnyen por 'gro bas chos thams cad la bde bar 'go ba'i ting nge 'dzin zhes pa'am/ dgra'am 'on te gnyen yang rung / /nyon mongs skye ba'i yul rnams la/ /dge bshes yin par sus mthong ba'i/ /mi de gang na gnas kyang bde/ /zhes jo bos bde ba'i glu las gsungs pa'am/ gang na gnas kyang gzhal yas khang / /su dang 'grogs kyang yi dam lha/ /sems ni ye nas chos kyi dbyings/ /bla mas gsal bar byed pa tsam/ /zhes pa de yang gdod cig na yong / 'di med na rig pa dang yon tan ci bslabs kyang phung 'dun dang dug g.yos su cha/ de yang mid pa gcu hril gyis byung ba'i dus de nyid du dol chod du sbyang dgos/ en gcig bzhag pas mi yong / /'di byung na mi gcig pu la chos gcig pu/ chos gcig pu la go chod po bya ba de byung ba yin/ de yang de tshod du khral ma tsam du byas pas mi yong / snying la zur dod/ a ma'i bu rgod du skyes nas khyod shi snyam pa'i nyon mongs pa la 'bur 'joms byed pa gcig dgos/ su dang 'grogs kyang 'pham len/ khye gzhan la gtong / 'jig rten gyi chos 'dod shos gzhan la gtong / mi 'dod shos rang la len na rin po che gser gling du phyin tsa na khyi la brdeg pa'i rdo mi rnyed pa bzhin du/ 'dom thug gang byung yang sangs rgyas kyi rgyur cha bas 'phral du gang thug sgom du song ba yin/ 'di med na thos pa che ba dang sgom bzang ba la sogs pa thams cad nga'i chas su song / nga'i mkhar bu brtsigs nas nga la sdang zhes pa la sogs pa dang / nga las mkhas pa med pa la sogs par 'gro/ de tsa na li sgom gzhon nu grags gsung ba'i nga dang la gnyis kyis sdug tu bcug gsung pa bzhin du 'gro/ de tsa na chos thams cad 'gran dos su song nas rang kho na mtho ba zhig 'dod pas lam du mi 'gro ba'i steng du 'di rang nas sdug

thams cad la gzhu mchog phab nas 'pham blangs na 'di rang nas je bder cha/ de yang ring por mi thogs dran pa'i dus nyid nas yong gsung / bzhi pa rkyen ngan lam du blang ba la gsum ste/ sdug bsngal dang / dus ngan dang / ma 'dzom pa lam du blang ba'o/ /de la sdug bsngal lam du blang ba ni/ gnyis pos tshang na thams cad blang / /zhes bya ba ste/ sdug bsngal dang kun 'byung gnyis kyis nyam thag na 'di lta bu'i skabs su chos gang nas 'ong zhes dang / 'khun zhing yi mug cing sdod pa ma yin te/ de'i steng du sems can gzhan gyi yang len pa'o/ /de yang rang la sdug bsngal yang rgas pas sbyor mi bzod pa dang / dgra 'dre nad kyis mnar ba dang / nor dang nye du'i phung gyod la sogs pa brjod kyis mi long ba zhig yod/ zhang btsun mchims pa spun gnyis gtsang du slob gnyer la phyin pas gnyis ka lhog pas zhag las bar du ma zhugs par shi ba dang / spun zla gcig yar klungs su lus pa de lta bu'i sdug bsngal dang / rang rgyud la zhe sdang drag po skyes pa la sogs pa nyon mongs pas gzir ba'i tshe rang gi nyams las dpags nas de lta bu dang ldan pa'i sems can la byams snying rje bsams nas bdag la de dag gi sdug bsngal dang kun 'byung ma lus pa len pa'o/ /'di la thos pa che ba la sogs pa mi dgos/ gang dgos na snying stobs phun sum tshogs pa zhig dgos/ de yang da lta byas na btub pa yin/ rgyug thag ring po'i phyal lta bus mi yong / dkar na zho dang dmar na khrag byas pa zhig dgos/ ming 'phags par btags/ dge sbyor sdud pa tshar re yang med pa de mu stegs pa bas kyang thu ba yin/ gnyis pa dus ngan lam du blang ba ni/ snyigs ma lnga po bdo ba 'di/ /byang chub lam du bsgyur ba yin/ /zhes bya ba ni/ da lta lnga brgya tha ma'i sems can/ dus/ tshe/ nyon mongs pa/ lta ba'i snyigs mar gyur pa'i dus 'dir mi 'dod pa sha stag 'byung ba la de thams cad byang chub kyi lam du sgyur ba'i chos blo sbyong 'di yin pas/

gang na ma btub pa rgyu mtshan du byas nas byang chub kyi lam du bsgyur ba'o/ /de yang / bdag gzhan la byang chub kyi sems ma skyes pa skye ba dang skyes pa gong nas gong du 'phel bar bya ba'i phyir/ kun gyis rang sa'i rgyu kun bsten/ /zhes pa ltar bla ma chos 'di lta bu ston pa bsten/ grogs po 'di sgom pa dang 'grogs/ chos 'di pa bstan pa nyan/ de'i gegs sgrib pa sbyang / mthun rkyen tshogs bsag gsol ba gdab/ chos skyong la phrin las zhu/ 'di rgyud la skyes ma skyes kyi nyes pa bsam/ rnam rtog ngo shes pas gnod pa med pa rkun ma ngo shes pa'i nyams zer ba bzhin du rang la nyon mongs pa ram ram byung tsa na nyon mongs pa dang de'i rtsa ba bdag 'dzin de dgrar ngo shes na zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /'di lan cig dran pa dang / mos pa lan cig byung ba dang / lan cig spro ba skyes pas kyang gnyen por 'gro/ lo brgyar 'grogs kyang bsgom rgyu 'di las ye med/ snying phyung yang dmar po ldir ldir po gcig las med gsung / gsum pa ma 'dzom pa lam du blang ba ni/ rgyu yi gtso bo rnam gsum blang / /zhes pa'o/ /de ltar shes par bya ba sogs gsum gyis dngos gzhi song nas/ da rjes ni/ yid bde 'ba' zhig rgyun tu bsten/ /zhes te 'di'i don yang bshad zin to/ /gnyis pa blo sbyong mi nyams ba'i thabs la gsum ste/ gzhan la brten pa dang / rang la brten pa dang / gnyis ka la brten pa'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ yul dang / bsam pa dang / sbyor ba la brten pa'o/ /dang po yul la brten pa ni/ bkol ba rnams la rtag tu sbyong / /zhes pa ste/ spyir yod pa snyam byed kyang rang gi 'gran zla sogs la ma byung na nyams nas 'gro bas rtag tu bkol nas sgom par bya zhes dgongs te gong du bshad zin to/ /bsam pa la brten pa ni/ gzhan phyogs gang yang mi bsam mo/ /zhes dang / sbyor ba la brten pa ni/ yan lag nyams pa brjod mi bya/

/zhes so/ /gnyis pa rang la brten pa la gnyis te/ bsam pa la brten pa dang / sbyor ba la brten pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rgyu mtshan thams cad gzhom par bya/ /zhes pa ste/ gang zag 'dis nga la mi rigs pa 'di lta bu byas snyam pa la sogs pa'i rgyu mtshan mi legs pa sems pa thams cad blo sbyong nyams par byed pas spang bar bya'o/ /gnyis pa sbyor ba la brten pa ni/ gnyis po gang byung bzod par bya/ /zhes so/ /gnyis ka la brten pa ni/ nyams su blang ba sla bar bslab/ /log gnon thams cad gcig gis bya/ /zhes te/ 'di lta bu nyams su blang bar mi nus par 'dug snyam na 'dor bar 'gyur bas/ de'i gnyen po lus ngag gi dka' ba sna gcig kyang mi dgos/ sbyong ba thams cad bsam pas sbyangs pas chog nangs ma gcig gi lto yang bcag mi dgos pas sla'o/ /chos gzhan la sgrub pa'i gnas dang grogs la sogs pa du ma dgos/ 'dir blo sbyong ba la ni skyid sdug la sogs pa gang la yang mi ltos te bsam pas sbyangs pas chog pa dang / skyid sdug dang 'dzoms ma 'dzoms la sogs pa'i rkyen gang byung ba de nyid mthun rkyen du byas nas nyams su blangs pas chog pas nyams su blang ba shin tu sla bar bslab bo/ /'di sbyong snying mi 'dod pa dang / sbyangs kyang mi skye ba dang / skyed med pa la sogs rgyu mtshan gang gis log kyang snga ma ltar gtong len bsgoms te log gnon byed pa'o/ /gsum pa blo sbyong 'phel ba'i rkyen la gsum ste/ sgo gsum gyi bya ba dang / ma nyams pa'i spyod pa dang / phyogs med kun khyab tu sbyong ba ste rim pa bzhin/ 'bral med gsum dang ldan par bya/ /zhes dang / nyams pa med pa rnam gsum bsgom/ /zhes dang / yul la phyogs med ces so/ /gnyis pa 'byongs pa'i tshad la gsum ste/ tshad dngos dang / de'i rtags dang / dpang po'o/ /dang po ni/ byang ba'i tshad ni log pa yin/ /zhes pa ste/ las dang po pa mos pa sbyong ba'i dus yin pas/

mos pa 'byongs pa'i tshad ni/ phyi nang snod bcud rang gzhan gyi rten la chags zhen btang zhing log tsa na 'byongs pa yin te/ zhen pa'i zug rngu dam gyur na/ /bzang ngo snyam yang nor bar bzhed/ /ces dang / 'khor bar chags pa'i yid dang ldan rnams rtag tu 'khor/ /zhes dang / rgyal ba rnams kyi byang chub chags med 'gyur la reg /ces gsungs pas gang la yang ma zhen par slob pa gal che/ sangs rgyas kyis chos gsungs pa thams cad kyang chags zhen zlog pa'i thabs su gsungs pa yin/ jo bos lam rim gsungs pa thams cad kyang zhen pa spang ba'i rim par gsungs pa yin te/ 'chi ba bsams pas tshe 'di la zhen pa bzlog pa nas bdag med gnyis bsgoms pas dngos po dang mtshan mar zhen pa bzlog pa'i bar ro/ /de bas nyan rang gi thar pa tsam sgrub pa la yang / thams cad btang bas mya ngan 'da'/ /bdag blo myang ngan 'das pa bsgrub/ /ces zhen chags med pa zhig dgos par gsungs pa yin/ chags zhen mtha' dag spangs pa sangs rgyas nyag gcig yin/ bslab pa gsum/ tshogs gnyis/ pha rol phyin pa drug lam lnga sa bcu gsungs pa thams cad kyang zhen pa spong ba'i thabs yin/ tshe 'di la zhen pa'i sgo gnyis yod de/ lus dang / lus las gzhan pa'o/ /dang po lus la chags pa ni/ bdag lus gang la chags pa yis/ /'jigs gnas chung la'ang 'jigs skye ba/ /zhes pa la sogs pa nyes pa mang du gsungs la/ lus las gzhan pa la chags pa ni/ rdzas yo byad dang / gnyen 'brel la sogs pa la chags pa ste/ nor la chags pas g.yengs par gyur rnams la/ /srid pa'i sdug bsngal las grol skabs med do/ /zhes pa la sogs pa gsungs pa'i nyes pa dran par byas la zhen pa ldog de nas phyi ma'i lus la chags pa la yang sgo gnyis yod de/ lus bye brag can la sred pa phyi mar lus bzang po zhig thob par 'dod pa dang / shi nas lus med par shes tsa na g.yang du lhung ba snyam byed nas lus shig thob na gang thob kyang rung snyam nas lus phye brag med pa la sred pa 'byung ba'o/

/de yang dbugs 'gro tsa na gang du skye ba'i lus shig byung pa snyam byed pa las de las shes pa'o/ /nyan thos sde pa kha cig bar ma do mi 'dod pa yang yod/ bar do 'dod pas kyang der las gsog par mi 'dod/ dang po'i bar do'i lus blangs pa de las gzhan du 'gyur bar 'dod la/ theg chen pas bar dor las gsog par 'dod/ der shul na gnas pa'i dge sdig gi lad mo byed cing sngar ma shi tsa na'i snang ba wal le yod par 'dod/ shul na 'dug pa ngus tsa na shi snyam pa'i 'du shes skye/ zhag bdun phrag bdun du bar do na gnas/ zhag bdun bdun na lus mi 'dra ba re re len pa 'dod/ ma'i mngal du 'jug pa'i dus na yang snang ba bzang ba la khang bzang / ngan pa la 'jag spyil du 'jug pa'i snang ba 'byung / bar do'i lus kyang kho rang nang dang lha'i mig dag pa gnyis kyis mthong / gzhan gyis mi mthong gsung / dbang po lnga ka tshang / rtsig pa la sogs pa la mi thogs/ zas su dri za/ ma'i mngal la thogs nas/ de'i gzugs de nyid kyang pho mo'i gzugs tha dad du yong / mo yin na pha la chags/ ma la phrag dog pho yin na de las ldog pa'o/ /zhen pas mtshams sbyar nas pha ma'i sa bon gyi rgyas gtum pa bzhin song nas dar cig brgyal nas 'gro/ de nas ming gzugs kyi myu gu 'grub bo/ /bar do mi 'dod pas phyi ma'i lus la chags pas mtshams sbyor bar 'dod pa yin/ gzugs med du skye na rang gi snying gi phyogs gcig tu ming bzhi la bdag tu bzung bas mtshams sbyor/ sngags nas bar do'i sems can rdo rje'i gdan la thogs par bshad/ 'khor ba 'grub pa thams cad zhen pas byed pas bar dor yang ma zhen pa gal che'o/ /de la'ang 'chi khar ma zhen pa zhig dgos/ de la da lta gang la yang ma zhen par blo sbyong dgos gsung / de ltar ma zhen par bslabs pas sngags pa kun la bar dor rig 'dzin gyi gnas su phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub thob nas lus de 'gro ba rigs drug gang du yang ma gtogs pa'i 'ja' lus lta bu gcig tu kho rang gi snang ba la 'byung bar 'dod pa'o/

/de bas na sems can gyi lus thams cad las dang chags pa'i rtsa ba las byung / byang chub sems dpa' sa thob pa yan chad kyi skye ba nyon mongs pa'i dod snying rjes byas/ las kyi dod smon lam gyis byas nas/ sems can gyi don du skye ba len pa'o/ /gnyis pa 'byongs pa'i rtags ni/ 'byongs rtags chen po lnga ldan yin/ /zhes pa ste/ blo 'di lta bu 'byongs tsa na byang chub sems dpa' chen po dang / nyes pa phran tshegs la'ang 'dzem pas 'dul ba 'dzin pa chen po dang / gzhan dang 'dom thug byung ba'i tshe bzod pa ri bzhin brtan pas dka' thub pa chen po dang / lus ngag gi dge sbyor la bltas na rtag tu dad pa dang / brtson 'grus dang ldan pas dge sbyor ba chen po dang / bka' bstan bcos thams cad kyi brjod par bya ba'i don gyi gtso bo la rang gi sems 'byongs pas rnal 'byor pa chen po zhig yong pa'o/ /de'ang bslab legs shig dgos/ khar sang dang na ning yang de las med kyis mi yong / snga thun pas phyi thun/ thun stod pas thun smad skyed tshol dgos/ de yang thos pa dang dran pas kyang en re yong ste/ 'bras bu de tsam mi 'byung bas 'di la dus gcig tu chig dril du 'bungs pa zhig dgos/ de yang ma 'ongs pa la rtag tu go cha bgo ba bya ba yin pas sems can gyi sdig sdug rang la len pa dang / rang gi dge ba de gzhan la gtong bar go cha gyon pa yin te/ de rang bas kyang mi dang mi ma yin pa'i gnod pa ci byung ba na phyis 'dom thug la sogs pa ci byung yang bzod par bya snyam pa dang / khas blangs pa'i sdom khrims dang skad cig kyang mi 'gal bar bya snyam pa dang / ngan smras phrag dog skur 'debs la sogs pa ci byung yang bzod par bya snyam du go bgos na phyis 'dom thug la sogs pa ci byung yang 'phrang thub pa zhig yong ba yin/ de bas kyang chos dang 'gal ba'i 'phrang byung tshad la chos dang mi 'gal bar bya snyam du go cha gyon pa'o/

/gang la gnod pa byas kyang bde 'brel ba/ /bde ba'i 'byung gnas de la skyabs su mchi/ /zhes dang / dgra 'am 'on te mdza' yang rung / /nyon mongs skye ba'i yul rnams la/ /dge bshes yin par sus mthong ba/ /de ni gang na gnas kyang bde/ /zhes dang / kha zer 'phyar kha gtong ba dang / /smad cing phrag dog byed pa rnams/ /dpa' bo khyod kyis zil du brlag /ces dang / phan btags lan du gnod byas kyang / /yang lan snying rje chen po bsgom/ /'dzam bu'i gling gi skyes mchog ni/ /nyes pa'i lan yang legs par ldon/ /zhes dang / gang dag bdag la kha zer ram/ /gzhan dag gnod pa byed pa 'am/ /de bzhin 'phyar kha gtong ba'ang rung / /thams cad byang chub skal ldan gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar blo sbyong ba'o/ /'di yod na gzhan gang med kyang 'tshang rgya/ tshe mjug 'di rang la rgyud khyad par can du 'gro ba yin gsung / /don byung ba med kyang tshig 'di dran pas de'i mod la zhi bar 'gyur ba yin/ myur du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'dod pas byang chub kyi sems rin po che la bslab ces pa'i gtam rgyud gsung ba rnams kyang 'di la gsung ba yin gsung / ci tsam pa'i skye shi mtha' mi mngon pa zhig byas pa la 'di lta bu'i chos sgom ye ma myong ba yin snyam du bsam/ sha ra bas nga 'dzom pa dang bla mas thugs la 'dogs na bya/ mi gtsigs su byed na bya/ de dag med na mi bya snyam na chos bor zin pa yin gsung / sdings pa shed rgol 'byung tsa na chos gtong na/ chos byed pa'i dus na byin rlabs mi 'ong gsung / des na da nas bzung nas tshe 'di/ bar do/ phyi ma/ sangs ma rgyas kyi bar du chos 'di dang skad cig kyang mi 'bral ba/ 'di ston ba'i dge bshes dang mjal ba'i smon lam gdab gsung / gsum pa rgyud la skyes pa'i dpang po ni/ dpang po gnyis kyi gtso bo gzung / /zhes ba'o/ /gsum pa sbyong ba'i dgos pa ni/ chos kun dgongs pa gcig tu 'dus/

/yon tan gzhan pas khyad par 'phags/ /zhes pa ste/ de la tshig rkang dang po'i don ni gong du bshad pa bzhin no/ /gnyis pa'i don ni chos 'di ni mthun rkyen gzhan la mi ltos pa'i yon tan gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pa yin te/ chos gzhan pa mthun rkyen gzhan la ltos dgos pas khams bzang dgos pa dang / na so gzhon dgos pa dang / dben pa dgos pa dang / bla ma'i rtsar bsgom dgos pa dang / na tsha la sogs med pa dgos pa dang / shes pa'i byer zug med pa dgos pa sogs du ma yod pa la/ 'di la gzhi thun mong gi tshul khrims dang / thun mong ma yin pa theg pa chen po'i dam tshig gnyis med kha med yin/ de gnyis med na rtsa ba med pa bya ba yin pas yong mi srid/ de gnyis yod na rkyen gzhan gang la yang ltos mi dgos pas gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa yin no/ /de ltar na yon tan khyad par du 'phags pa'i rgyu mtshan rkyen gzhan la mi ltos pa la byed na/ rkyen la mi ltos pa'i rgyu mtshan ci yin snyam na/ mi mthun sgom gyi grogs su bsgyur/ /zhes pa ste/ 'di rkyen ngan lam du bsgyur ba'i skabs su byas na yang bde/ 'dir yang rgyu mtshan du sbyar du btub pas/ sdug bsngal dang nyon mongs pa drag po dang ma 'dzom pa sogs thams cad 'di'i cha rkyen du byed pa ste/ tshe 'di la sgom gzhan thams cad zhog la nyi ma de ring nas 'di sgoms/ nga yang mos pa byed pa yin pas khyed la'ang skye ste 'ong / 'di med na sgom bzang zer ba thams cad 'dom thug byung tsa na gnyen po ma go ba'am/ 'di bzhin du dngos 'gal du ma song bar brgyud 'gal du song ba shed kyis nyon mongs pa chung du ma song bar khengs dregs sam nga rgyal cher song nas yod par snang / 'di rgyud la lan cig dran pa'am/ bsgoms tsa na nyon mongs pa rams kyis byung ba de 'jam lhan gyis 'gro bar snang / des na rang rgyud la mi 'dod pa byung ba dang 'byung gis dogs pa na sems can kyi mi 'dod pa byung ba dang 'byung gis dogs pa thams cad len pa'o/

/'di go na stong pa nyid kyang ngang gis go nas yong / 'di med na lta ba mtho ba dang sgom bzang zer ba thams cad yus kyis brgyal nas yong / khyad par du spyi'i khur khur ba la 'di med kha med yin/ 'di min en tsam gyi dge rtsa dung la rdul 'phyid gsung / de ltar na gong gi sgom gyi grogs su bsgyur na/ thams cad theg chen lam du bsgyur zhes bya ste/ snyigs ma lnga po bdo ba/ mi dge ba mtha' dag tshang ba/ tshe la yang chos la sogs pa gang yang bya long med pa/ lta ba ngan pa sna tshogs pas gzings pa'i dus 'dir gtong len gnyis la sbyangs te ci byed theg chen kyi lam du bsgyur ro/ /de dag gis ni tshigs su bcad pa'i don bstan pa yin no/ /da ni tshig lhug pas rang gi sems la gros gdab pa ston pa/ yus ma bsgom/ de bsgoms na nges par gshags ngan yong bas/ gshags ngan ma rgod/ de mi rgod pa la 'di dgos pas/ ko long ma sdom/ de la 'di dgos pas 'or che ma 'dod/ de yang mi rtag pas mi yong bas/ yud tsam pa mi bya/ yang dus la bab pa na ngan lan byed pa mi rung pas/ 'phrang ma bsgug rang gi nyes pa gzhan la bkal du mi rung ba ni/ mdzo khal glang la mi 'byo/ yang 'dod shos ci thob byed pa'i 'gyogs kyi rtse ma gtod/ 'khon 'dzin dam du byed pa'i gzhung bzang po ma bsten/ gnad la mi dbab/ go log mi bya/ lha bdud du mi dbab/ yengs kyang thub par bya/ res 'jog mi bya/ gto log mi bya/ gnyis po srog dang bsdo/ rtog dpyod gnyis kyis thar bya/ dol chod du sbyang / dug can gyi zas spang / skyid kyi yan lag tu sdug ma tshol/ zhes gsungs te 'di dag gi don ni gong du bshad pa dang 'dra'o/ /rgyal ba sras bcas kun gyi bgrod gcig lam/ /theg chen sde snod ma lus kun gyi bcud/ /bla ma rnams kyi thugs dam kun gyi gtso/ /blo sbyong gdams pa zab mo 'di yin no/ /zhes pa tshogs bshad ma'o// ༈ //bzhi pa blo sbyong gi lus la zur 'debs nyer mkho'i man ngag gzhan bstan pa ni/

theg pa chen po'i blo sbyong zhes bgyi ba spyir yang bka' sde snod kyi chos thams cad nas gsungs/ khyad par gyis kyang byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug ba'i bsam gtan le'u nas/ bdag nyid skyon bcas gzhan la yang / /yon tan rgya mtshor shes byas nas/ /bdag 'dzin yongs su dor ba dang / /gzhan blang ba ni bsgom par bya/ /zhes gsungs/ de la sogs pa'i tshigs su bcad pa de rnams kyi don go hril gyis dril ba la/ spyir 'khor bar 'khyams par byed pa'i rgyu nyon mongs pa brgyad khri bzhi stong / de tshur bsdu na drug rtsa ba'i nyon mongs pa'am/ nyi shu nye ba'i nyon mongs pa/ de'i rtsa ba nga dang bdag tu 'dzin pa 'di yin te/ rang bzhin grub pa med pa zhig la nga bdag tu bzung nas 'di'i kha zin gshags 'debs byas pas/ tshe 'di la dge rgyu las mi dge bar song ba'am/ bde rgyu las sdug bsngal du song bar nges pa rang gi kha zin gshags 'debs byas pas lan/ da 'og man chad du yang bdag tu 'dzin pa 'di ma spangs na de snga kho na bzhin du 'khyams pas/ 'das ma 'ongs da ltar dus gsum du sdug tu 'jug mkhan rang gis rang la gces par 'dzin pa'i 'gong po nga bdag bya ba 'di yin min la the tshom mi za/ 'di'i kha zin shags 'debs byas pas phan na lta mthong ba thos pa yid la 'gyus pa rnams lag len la ma btab pa gcig kyang med de 'khor ba las snga 'dris gang yang ring du ma song bas/ da yod gang legs la thong / byugs legs la thong snyam du byas nas rang bzhin du ling bskyur la thong / lhod de glod la thong / shigs kyis bshig la thong / sems can rnams cir mi yong min/ pha ma drin can sha stag yin pas/ sems can rnams kyi rgyu'i dus kyi sdig pa/ 'bras bu'i dus kyi sdug bsngal thams cad ko ba skyi gris bzhar ba bzhin du blangs nas rang gi lus po 'di'i steng du hril hril smin par bsam/ rang gi dge ba dang bde ba sems can la smin par bsam/

de gnyis phar log tshur log tu bsgom/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba yang blos blangs la sems can la smin par bsgom/ theg pa chen po blo sbyong zhes bya pa'i don go de lta bu zhig yin gsung / mkhan po pa'i zhal nas/ blo sbyong bya ba mdor na bdag khyad du bsad nas sems can la gus pa bsgom pa yin gsung / bdag khyad du gsod pa bya ba 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas sdug tu 'jug mkhan rang gces par 'dzin pa'i 'gong po 'di yin pas/ gzhi 'di brlag na yang brlag tu gzhug gsungs te/ don du ma la 'jug gsung / sems can la gus pa bsgom pa bgyi ba/ gzhan khams gsum 'khor ba'i sems can 'di rnams cir mi yong min/ pha ma drin can sha stag yin pas sems can la gus pa bsgom pa lus ngag yid gsum gyi zho sha mi sri bar phan 'dogs pa yin gsung / 'di nyams su len pa'i tshul/ jo bos bla ma gser gling pa la gsan pa'i rtsa tshig ni/ 'gro ba'i ded dpon bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dang po sngon 'gro dag la bslab/ /dngos gzhi gtong len spel mar sbyang / /len pa'i go rim rang nas brtsam/ /de nas ma la bsgom par bya/ /de gnyis rlung la bskyon par bya/ /yul gsum dug gsum dge rtsa gsum/ /rjes kyi man ngag mdor bsdus pa'o/ /snga ma dag ni bsdus nas ni/ /stobs lnga dag dang sbyar bar bya/ /'bral med gsum dang ldan par bya/ /thog mtha' gnyis la bya ba gnyis/ /gnyis po tshang nas thams cad blang / /'phral la gang thug sgom dang sbyar/ /rnal 'byor thams cad gcig gis bya/ /cir snang lam du shes par bya/ /rgyu yi gtso bo rnam gsum blang / /spyod lam kun tu tshig gis sbyang / /rtag tu yengs ni thub par bya/ /kun la bka' drin che bar bsgom/ /le lan thams cad gcig la bda'/ /chos rnams dgongs pa gcig tu 'dus/ /spyi don gsum dang ldan par bya/ /skyid kyi yan lag sdug mi btsal/

/rkyen la ltos pa med par sbyang / /go log mi bya gto log min/ /rgyu yi gtso bo ngos gzung la/ /dka' ba gsum la bslab par bya/ /dpang po gnyis kyi gtso bo gzung / /lha ni bdud du mi dbab bo/ /nyams pa med pa rnam gsum bsten/ /bla ma'i dam tshig spyi dang mthun/ /gnyis po srog dang bsdos la bsrung / /'dun pa bsgyur la rang sor gzhag /yud tsam mi bya res 'jog spang / /gzhan phyogs gang yang mi bsam mo/ /gzhung bzang mi brten 'phrang bsgug spang / /'or che ma 'dod yus mi bsgom/ /'bras bur re ba thams cad spang / /lto log tu yang mi sbyang ngo / /yan lag nyams pa brjod mi bya/ /gshags ngan ma rgod ko long min/ /'gyogs rtse mi gtod gnad mi dbab/ /mdzo khal glang la mi bkal zhing / /gnyis po gang byung bzod par bya/ /yid bde 'ba' zhig rgyun du bsten/ /rtog dpyod gnyis kyi thar bya zhing / /dol chod du ni sbyang bar bya/ /bkol ba gsum la rtag tu bslab/ /log na gnyen po de nyid bsgom/ /brtan pa thob nas gsang ba spyad/ /rmi lam snang ba sems kyi ngo bor bstan/ /sems nyid sgyu ma ji bzhin stong par rtogs/ /sna tshogs sprin bzhin stong ba'i ngang las byung / /chu yi chu bur bzhin du dbye ba med/ /de phyir brjod med spros bral nam mkha' bzhin/ /theg pa chen po blo sbyong gi rtsa ba jo bo chen po rjes mdzad pa'o/ /bla ma gser gling pa las brgyud pa'o/ /rdzogs so// //don de nyams su len pa la zur 'debs nyer mkho'i man ngag lnga las/ jo bo'i rnam par thar pa rgya mtsho las/ rgyal srid spangs nas thar pa bsgrubs lugs dang / bla ma gser gling pa la chos 'di zhu ru byon pa'i rnam thar ni yig chung logs su mdzad pa las shes par bya zhing / bla ma brgyud pa'i lo rgyus bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang bcas pa ni gong du bshad zin to// ༈ //gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i gnas skabs su don dam byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa'i zur 'debs kyi man ngag ni/

dpang gyur skye bo phal cher deng sang gshegs gyur kyang / /gser gling rgyal po'i sras gyur 'gro mgon a ti shas/ /shes rab mig long long khrid med pa'i skye bo la/ /chos dbyings gsal byed sgron me'i man ngag 'di gsungs so/ /de yang rgyal ba'i sras po thams cad mkhyen pa thob par 'dod pa rnams kyis lam thabs shes rab gnyis la bslab dgos kyi/ ya bral lam du mi 'gro ste/ de ni lam dang 'bras bu'i gnad kyis 'phul ba yin/ de'i go rim yang thabs sngon la bsgom ste/ brtan pa thob nas gsang ba spyad/ /ces gsungs pas thabs brtan pa'i tshad ni/ stong pa nyid bsgoms pas las rgyu 'bras la g.yel du mi 'gro zhing / sems can la snying rje chung du ma song bar phyir la chos la dmigs pa'i snying rje cher 'gro ba yin/ gsang ba ni stong pa nyid de/ de las dang po pa la bstan du mi rung ste/ rgyud tshod dang mi ldan pas lam du mi 'gro ste/ mdo las bdud rtsi dug tu 'gyur ba'i dpe gsungs/ de ltar blo dman pa la gsang ba'i don dam byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa la dpe lngas don lnga gtan la dbab pa ni/ rmi lam snang ba sems kyi ngo bor bstan/ /sems nyid sgyu ma ji bzhin stong par rtogs/ /sna tshogs sprin bzhin stong pa'i ngang las byung / /zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar rmi lam gyi dpes snang ba sems su gtan la dbab/ sgyu ma'i dpes sems nyid stong par gtan la dbab/ sprin gyi dpes stong pa las snang ba 'byung bar gtan la dbab/ chu bur gyi dpes snang stong dbyer med du gtan la dbab/ nam mkha'i dpes brjod med spros bral du gtan la dbab pa'o/ /gdams pa 'di nyams su len pa la sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum las/ dang po ni/ spyi'i sngon 'gro rnams dang / skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du 'gro bas lha dang bla ma la gsol ba gdab bo/ /gnyis pa la sbyor dngos rjes gsum las sbyor ba gzung ba'i yul gtan la dbab pa/

'dzin pa'i sems gtan la dbab pa/ stong pa las snang ba 'byung bar gtan la dbab pa/ snang stong dbyer med du gtan la dbab pa'o/ /dngos gzhi mnyam gzhag spros bral bsgom pa'o/ /rjes thun mtshams sgyu ma ltar shes par bya ba'o/ /sbyor ba'i chos 'di rnams la nges shes rnyed par bsam la/ de nas rnam snang gi chos bdun dang ldan pas gsol ba btab la lha dang bla ma rang la bstims nas mnyam par gzhag go /rjes bsngo ba dang smon lam bya'o/ /'di dag gi skabs su bla mas yang yang nyams sad byas la nges shes skyes pa dang / nges par ngo 'phrod par bya'o/ /bying rgod la sogs pa'i skyon byung na/ sgrim klod sogs shes par bya zhing thun chung la grangs mang bar bya'o/ /gzhan yang gegs sel sogs dgos na man ngag gzhan las gsungs pa ltar shes par bya zhing / yun ring du bsgoms na nyams rtogs rgyud la skye bas yun bsrings nas bsgom pa gal che'o/ /man ngag 'di'i nyams len gyi mthar thug lta ba spros bral rtogs pa'i ngang nas de ltar ma rtogs pa la snying rje chen po skye zhing / stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can bsgom pa nyams len gyi mthar thug yin no/ /thabs sngon du song bas shes rab don dam byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa'i phyag len gyi rim pa'o/ /'gro kun byang chub myur thob shog/ ༈ //gsum pa thabs kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems kyis bdag gzhan brje ba bsgom pa la nyer mkho zur 'debs kyi man ngag ni/ dge bshes ston pa'i man ngag nyams len du byed na/ zas la brten pa'i blo sbyong / dbugs la brten pa'i blo sbyong / lus gang gā'i rlung gi bye ma snyed du sprul nas 'gro ba rigs drug gi sdug bsngal dang du len pa'i blo sbyong / sha khrag la brten pa'i blo sbyong / gtor ma la brten pa'i blo sbyong / 'byung ba bzhi la brten pa'i blo sbyong / lus yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po cher sprul pa'i blo sbyong /

blo sbyong 'chi kha ma'i man ngag ste/ blo sbyong thun brgyad ma zhes 'byung ba dang / blo sbyong kun tu bzang po zhes pa las rlabs po che'i sems/ mi bsgul pa'i sems/ rdo rje lta bu'i sems gsum sbyong zhing bsgom pa'i tshul gsungs pa rnams shes par byas nas bsgom par bya ste/ 'dir yi ge mang ba'i 'jigs pas ma bris so// ༈ //bzhi pa de ltar byang chub kyi sems gnyis nyams su len pa'i gnas skabs su rkyen ngan bar chad thams cad kyis mi tshugs pa'i man ngag zur 'debs ni/ bzhi tshan bzhi/ gnyis tshan gcig ste bco brgyad do/ /de'ang 'di ltar/ mgon po gser gling pa bla ma rin po che yab sras brgyud pa dang bcas pa la gus pa chen pos phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ mkhyen rab dang thugs rje'i mnga' bdag mgon po gser gling pa'i zhal nas/ jo bo la bu khyed snyigs ma'i dus su gzhan don byed pa la bka' sde snod/ lung rigs pa/ bla ma'i man ngag thams cad hril te dril nas stan thog gcig tu nyams su len na/ /nad dang / gnod pa dang / gdon bgegs dang / bdud dang mu stegs la sogs rkyen ngan bar chad thams cad kyis mi tshugs pa'i chos 'di rnams dgos te/ 'di skad du/ rtog pa thams cad 'bur 'joms te/ /gnyen po thams cad bcom brdeg yin/ /'dun ma thams cad chig 'dril te/ /lam rnams thams cad chig chod yin/ /gnyen po rnam byang gi chos bzhi po/ /mtha' 'khob 'dul na dgos pa yin/ /'khor ngan log sgrub bzod pa la/ /snyigs ma'i dus su mkho ba yin/ /zhes pa'i don ni/ rnam par rtog pa gang byung ma thag nas 'bur 'joms dang 'bur 'joms su bya dgos te/ kho ga na snang dbang po gang gi yul na snang / dbyibs dang kha dog ji lta bu zhig snang btsal lo/ /'di dug sbrul lam khyi smyon dang 'dra ste nyer mi rung / byung 'drog rang la gnyen pos le lo ma shor bar gzhom ste/

mdo las/ 'dod pa khyod kyi rtsa ba ni/ /shes te kun tu rtog las byung / /khyod la rtogs par mi 'gyur ba/ de phyir nga la mi 'byung ngo / /zhes dang / rnam rtog ma rig chen po ste/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtshor ltung byed yin/ mi rtog ting 'dzin la gnas na/ /mkha' bzhin dri ma med par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / 'jug pa las/ so so'i skye bo rnams ni rtog pas bcings/ /mi rtog rnal 'byor pa ni grol 'gyur bas/ /rtog rnams log par gyur pa gang yin de/ rnam par dpyod pa'i 'bras bur mkhas rnams gsungs/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa theg pa chen po'i bstan bcos thams cad nas byang chub sgrub pa'i gegs chen por bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /des na le lo ma shor ba gal che'o/ /'dir blo sna mang na mthar mi phyin pa'i rgyu yin pas/ chos zab zab po la'ang ma 'byams par/ 'dun ma thams cad rtog pa 'joms pa la chig chod du 'dril dgos te/ mdo las kyang / yid la byed pa thams cad bdud las su bshad de/ des na ji srid rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas ma thob kyi bar du tshogs sbyor mthong sgom la sogs pa'i sa dang lam thams cad rtog pa 'bur te byung res gnyen pos 'joms pa la 'dun ma 'dril bar 'dis chig chod du bya'o/ /mdor na rtog pa 'bur te byung res kyis gnyen pos kyang de'i rtsar sleb dgos/ gnyen pos rnam rtog de 'joms pa la 'dun ma thams cad 'dril dgos/ lam thams cad kyang de kho nas gcod dgos so/ /de ni blang bya gnyen po rnam byang gi chos bzhi yin no/ /yang 'di skad gsungs te/ rkyen ngan dge ba'i bshes gnyen te/ /'dre gdon rgyal ba'i sprul pa yin/ /na tsha sdig sgrib kyi phyags ma ste/ /sdug bsngal chos nyid kyi yo lang yin/ /kun nas nyon mongs kyi chos bzhi ste/ /mtha' 'khob 'dul na dgos pa yin/ /'khor ngan log sgrub bzod pa la/ /snyigs ma'i dus su mkho ba yin/ /zhes pa'i don ni/

de nas na tsha dang sdug bsngal la sogs mi 'dod pa'i 'gal rkyen gang byung yang des bskul ma byas la/ de'i steng du sems can thams cad kyi nad dang sdug bsngal yang blos lings te blangs/ longs nges snyam du dga' ba'i 'dun pa bya/ de bzhin du bde skyid la sogs mthun rkyen gang byung yang sems can la byin pas sems can kyi tshogs rdzogs pa la dga' ba'i blo sbyang ngo / /de bzhin du gzugs sgra dri ro sogs snang ba'i rkyen gang byung yang btsal bas mi rnyed/ mi rnyed pa'i don la glod la bzhag pas chos nyid la skul ba'i rkyen dge ba'i bshes gnyen yin/ byang chub sgrub pa'i grogs yin pas dga' ba bsgom mo/ /rgyal 'gong bsen mo sa bdag la sogs pa'i gnod pa byung tsa na des skul ma byas nas sems can la gnod pa dang / sdug bsngal ci yod pa blos lings te blangs nas yongs nges snyam du dga' ba'i 'du shes bya/ gnod byed rnams la byams snying rje byang chub sems kyis lus kyi sha khrag gang 'dod byin pas byang chub kyi grogs su 'gyur ba'i grogs byed pa yin pas/ gdon thams cad sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa yin pas de dag la dga' ba dang gus pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa bsgom mo/ /lhag par na tsha byung ba'i dus su sems can thams cad kyi na tsha sdug bsngal rang gi snying gi nang du blangs nas/ sems can thams cad kyis spangs pa phun sum tshogs pa thob pa yin go bcad snyam du dga' ba bsgom/ nad med pa'i dus su des bskul nas rang gi bde ba rgyu dang bcas pa 'gro ba la byin pas sems can thams cad kyi rtogs pa phun sum tshogs pa thob pa yin go bcad snyam du dga' ba bsgoms pa sdig sgrib kyi phyags ma yin te/ sdig sgrib la skad cig tsam yang bsdad pa'i glags med do/ /sdug bsngal brgya tham pa byung na tshol thebs brgya tham pa yong / de yod ma myong bas ma rnyed thebs brgya tham pa yong pas/

de la spangs pa brgya tham pa rtogs pa brgya tham pa ste/ chos nyid kyi yo lang chen po yin te/ de la dga' ba'i 'du shes bsgom par bya'o/ /de rnams ni spang bya kun nas nyon mongs lam khyer gyi chos bzhi yin no/ /yang 'di skad du/ skyid kyi kha gnon chen po ste/ /sdug gi mjug mthud chen po yin/ /ltas ngan g.yang du 'gugs pa ste/ /mi mkho shos la 'dod thog yin/ /gnyen po log gnon gyi chos bzhi ste/ /mtha' 'khob 'dul na dgos pa yin/ /'khor ngan log sgrub bzod pa la/ /snyigs ma'i dus su mkho ba yin/ /zhes pa'i don ni/ de nas dge sbyor gyi gegs su 'gro ba'i bza' btung / longs spyod snyan grags la sogs pa skyid 'dod kyi kha gnon la 'dod pa chung la chog shes pa'i sgo nas sdug gi mjug mthud de/ rkang pa na na bskor ba bya/ sked pa na na phyag bya/ 'dod pa che na gzhan la sbyin/ g.yeng ba la dga' na mtshams bcad/ smra ba la dga' na smra bcad bya'o/ /gtam ngan nam/ byur shan nam/ byad kha'am/ phur kha la sogs mi 'dod pa'i ltas ngan chen po byung na/ bdag 'dzin gyi 'gong po 'dul ba'i thabs yin bas bkra shis dang g.yang du 'gugs shing / da dung thongs shig ces shes pa'i dpa' bskyed la/ de 'dra'i rigs mi mkho shos thams cad bdag la byung bas/ da 'di thul nas da phyin chad 'khor bar mi skye snyam du de la 'dod thog tu bya ste/ bzod pa gsum la mthu thob par bya'o/ /de ni gnyen po kun tu spyod pa log gnon gyi chos bzhi yin no/ /yang 'di skad du/ bdag ni las ngan gyi rtsa ba ste/ /rgyangs kyis bskyur ba'i chos shig yin/ /gzhan ni byang chub kyi 'byung khungs te/ /cangs kyis len pa'i chos shig yin/ /spang gnyen mjug sdud kyi chos gnyis te/ /mtha' 'khob 'dul na dgos pa yin/ /'khor ngan log sgrub bzod pa la/ /snyigs ma'i dus su mkho ba yin/ /zhes pa'i don ni/ mdor na bdag mi 'dod pa thams cad kyi 'byung gnas/

las ngan thams cad kyi rtsa ba yin pas/ 'di la gces spras ma byed par lings te bskyur la/ dgra dga' na dgra khyer/ 'dre dga' na 'dre khyer/ mi rings na tshos la zo/ ring na khur la rgyug ces rang thed la btang la/ sems can thams cad kyi don byed pa ste/ rang don yal bar dor nas brtson pas gzhan don lhur mdzad pa ni/ bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi 'byung khungs yin pas sems can thams cad brtse bas cangs te rang la blang ba ni/ spang gnyen mjug sdud kyi chos rnam pa gnyis yin te/ sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi lag len khyad par can yin no/ /yang 'di skad du/ rgyangs kyis bskyur la lhod kyis glod/ /shigs kyis bshig la 'bol le gzhag /stong nyid kyi rgyas 'debs bzhi yin te/ /mtha' 'khob 'dul na dgos pa yin/ /'khor ngan log sgrub bzod pa la/ /snyigs ma'i dus su mkho ba yin/ /de ltar nyams su blangs gyur na/ /skyes bu mi 'ching grol bar 'gyur/ /zhes pa'i don ni/ /gzung 'dzin gyi rtog pa thams cad phar rgyangs te bskyur la/ spros bral chos kyi dbyings su shes pa gsal la rtog pa med par lhod de glod la/ gang gis kyang ma bcings par gzhag par bya'o/ /de yang shes pa snga ma'i rjes su mi 'brang / ma 'ongs pa'i sngon mi bsu/ da lta ba ma bcings par shigs te bshig bcas bcos dang sgro skur med par rang sor 'bol le glod la gzhag go /de ni stong nyid kyi rgyas 'debs yin no/ /nyams len de ltar byas na las kyis 'khor bar mi 'ching grol ba thar pa thob par 'gyur ro/ /nyams len 'di las gzhan zhig yin na dus snyigs ma'i sems can rmu rgod thul bar mi 'gyur la/ 'di dang ldan na bar chad kyis mi tshugs pas 'gro don ngang gis 'byung zhes gsung ngo / /bla ma gser gling pa'i gsung ji lta ba bzhin bkod pa'o gsung / ༈ lnga pa de ltar byang chub kyi sems gnyis bsgom pa la zur 'debs blo sbyong gi gegs sel sogs 'khyer so dang bcas pa ni/

bla ma thugs rje can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /theg pa chen po blo sbyong gi gegs sel ni/ ltas ngan g.yang du len/ bdud srid du gcod/ bar chad lam du 'jug mi mkho shos la 'dod thog tu byed pa yin gsungs/ dang po ni/ 'jig rten pa kun srin bya'am/ wa brgyal ba la sogs pa'i ltas ngan pa byung ba'i dus su mo 'debs/ rtsis byed/ cho ga byed pa yin te 'o cag ltas dang mtshan ma ngan pa byung ba'i dus su sdug tu 'jug mkhan bdag tu 'dzin pa 'di yin pas/ 'jig rten gyi khams kyi ltas ngan pa 'byung gis dogs pa dang byung ba'i sdug bsngal thams cad bdag la smin/ bdag tu 'dzin pa 'di brlag tu chug cig snyam du len pa yin/ gnyis pa ni/ sdug tu 'jug mkhan bdag tu 'dzin pa 'di yin pas/ lus la mi dang mi ma yin pa'i gnod pa byung ba'i dus su nga ni 'dis sdug tu bcug nas 'dug khyed 'di la dga' na da lta khyer/ mgo po ya bdud rgyal po khyer/ rkang pa ma bdud rgyal mo khyer/ phar lha 'dre gnyen rgu khyer cig sogs bya/ 'di la gnod pa skyel ba rnams bka' drin che/ dgra 'dul rogs pa yin/ 'dre 'dul rogs pa yin pas/ 'jig rten gyi lha 'dre mi gsum srid du bcad nas 'gong po 'di ci brlag la gtong / snying tshim gal med do snyam du srid du gcod/ gsum pa ni/ lus kyi na tsha dang / sems kyi sdug bsngal sogs mi mkho ba dang bar chad ci byung yang khyod rang gis bdag tu bzung bas lan pa yin pas/ da dung yang bdag 'dzin ma spangs na bar chad 'ong bas/ 'jig rten gyi khams na bar chad byung dang 'byung gis dogs pa thams cad bdag gi steng du da lta nyid du hril gyis smin la bdag 'dzin 'di thul gyis brlag tu chug cig snyam du lam du 'jug pa yin/ bzhi pa ni/ 'di la phan btags pas phan na lta ci tsam pa'i phan cig btags pa yin te/ des 'khor ba las ring du ma song bas 'di brlag tu 'jug dgos pa yin pa la mi mkho ba byung ba de go bcad/

bla ma'i byin rlabs yin/ bka' drin che/ da dung yang mi mkho ba thams cad 'di'i thog tu thong la thul gyis brlag tu chug cig snyam du 'dod thog tu byed pa yin gsungs/ theg pa chen po blo sbyong gi ma 'ongs ba'i 'gal rkyen spong ba la gsum ste/ blo sbyong brjed pa'i gnas bzhi ni/ 'chi ba'i dus kyi gnad gcod/ bar do/ /ma'i mngal/ skye ba phyi ma'o/ /blo sbyong 'chor ba'i gnas bzhi ni/ mi'i gnod pa drag po byung ba/ mi ma yin gyi gnod pa drag po byung ba/ 'byung ba'i na tsha drag po byung ba/ de dag ma byung yang nyon mongs pa drag po skyes pa'o/ /de'i gnyen po bsten pa ni/ bla ma dkon mchog la mchod pa phul nas bdag gi rgyud la theg pa chen po'i blo sbyong gi rtogs pa phyin ci ma log pa skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ blo sbyong brjed pa'i gnas bzhir mi brjed pa dang / 'chor ba'i gnas bzhir mi 'chor bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab/ chos skyong la gtor ma phul nas kyang de ltar bya'o/ /rang gis bsod nams bsags nas kyang theg pa chen po'i blo sbyong bdag gi rgyud la skye bar gyur cig brjed pa'i gnas bzhir mi brjed par gyur cig 'chor ba'i gnas gzhir mi 'chor bar gyur cig ces smon lam gdab bo/ /sems can spyi mthun gyi bsod nams kyis kyang de ltar ro/ /theg pa chen po blo sbyong nyams su len pa'i thag chod bzhi ste/ lam chig chod/ 'dun ma chig 'dril/ rtog pa 'bur 'joms/ gnyen po bcom brdeg bya ba yin gsung / lam chig chod yin te/ sa lam rtsi rgyu med/ bdag 'dzin shas su che che sdug bdag 'dzin shas su chung chung skyid/ 'di de ring brlag na de ring 'tshang rgya/ sang brlag na sang 'tshang rgya/ 'di ma brlag na sangs rgyas med/ 'di brlag na nam brlag tsa na 'tshang rgya ba yin gsung ngo / /'dun ma chig 'dril yin te/ 'gro 'chag nyal 'dug gi spyod lam ci byed kyang bdag ci brlag dang /

sems can la phan ci thogs las med/ gzhan gyi 'dun ma mang po bya rgyu med gsung / rtog pa 'bur 'joms bya ba yin te/ kha cig na re rtog pa spong zer/ rtog pa spang mi dgos lam du 'khyer ba yin/ chos sku'i rdzas yin te/ nyon mongs pa 'di dang po chung ngu zhig skye bas de ma thag 'joms dgos pa yin te/ de ma thag ma bcom na cher skyes nas mi spong ste/ de dang po nyon mongs pa skyes ma thag gnyen po dran pa tsam gyis ldog pa la o lo o ci byas nas mi spong gsung / rtog pa de skyes na gang nas skyes/ gnas na gar gnas/ 'gags na gar 'gags pa brtags pas rang bzhin med par shes par byas nas/ sngar 'dris kyi mi dang 'phrad pa bzhin du rang bzhin med par lam du 'khyer ba yin/ yang na rdo tshan gyi steng du kha ba babs pa bzhin du stong pa nyid du gtong ba yin/ gnyen po bcom brdeg bya ba yin te/ nyon mongs pa skyes ma thag gnyen po gang la gang phan gyis phag mgo re la gtun bu chang re'i tshul du bsgom gsung / theg pa chen po blo sbyong bsgom pa la gnyen po bsten tshul gsum ste/ med sprul/ phrad gzhom/ rjes bsnyegs bya ba'o gsung / dang po ni/ dper na sog po stag 'dul ba de dang po 'thab stangs byed/ stag 'dul ba bslabs pas/ stag byung ba'i dus su stag thul ba zhig yong / sngar ma bslabs na stag mi thul bar de'i dbang du 'gro/ de bzhin du nyon mongs pa 'dod chags sogs gang shas che ba de ram ram sprul nas/ yang de 'drog la log ter bzlog nas gtong / blo lung ma bstan du mi 'jog par de bzhin du sbyangs pas nyon mongs pa skyes pa'i dus su gnyen pos rkyen thub nas 'ong / nyon mongs pa'i dbang du mi 'gro/ sngar de bzhin du ma bslabs na gnyen pos rkyen mi thub/ nyon mongs pa'i dbang du cha ba yin gsung / phrad gzhom bya ba yin te/ rgan rgon gnyis la rkun ma byung ba bzhin mi bya/

de bzhin du nyon mongs pa 'di yang dang po nas che ba rang mi skye/ dang po chung ngu zhig skye bas/ de skyes ma thag tu khyod yin zhig byas nas log ter bzlog nas btang na nyon mongs pa'i dbang du mi 'gro/ gnyen pos rkyen thub nas 'ong / de dus su ma bzlog na je che je che la song nas de nas gnyen po rang gis mi thul bas nyon mongs pa skyes ma thag tu phag mgo 'bur re la gtun bu chang re'i tshul du log ter bzlog nas gtang ngo / /rjes bsnyegs bya ba ni/ nyon mongs pa'i dbang du song ba de'i rjes bsnyegs pa yin te/ a tsa ma khyod 'dra ba'i mkhos chung cig yong ba/ de lta bu byed pa'i gshags ci yod snyam du rjes bsnyegs pa yin/ gzhan yang nyon mongs pa skyes pa na/ 'o khyod 'di tsug byas pas 'khor bar 'khyams pa yin/ da dung 'di tsug byed dam byas nas log ter bzlog nas gtong ba yin gsungs/ sbyor ba la med sprul/ dngos gzhi la phrad gzhom/ mjug la rjes bsnyegs bya ba yin gsungs/ blo sbyong gi nad 'don ni/ spung ba/ bskyed pa/ sbyang ba gsum yin gsung / spung ba ni/ rang la na tsha byung ba'i dus su 'jig rten gyi khams na na tsha byung ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig yod pas/ de thams cad da lta nyid du nga la smin par gyur la/ sems can rnams kyi sdug bsngal de thams cad rgyun chad par gyur cig snyam du bsgom ste/ sems can gyi sdug bsngal rang la spung ba yin/ bskyed pa ni/ gang na sar bug pa zang thal zhig bsgom/ de je che je che la song bas stong pa nyid du phyams te song bar bsgoms la/ de'i ngang du lhan gyis 'jog pa yin gsung / sbyang ba ni gang na ba'i sar a dkar po zhig bsgoms la de je chung je chung la yal te/ rang bzhin med par song bar bsgoms la de'i ngang du lhan gyis 'jog pa yin gsungs/ theg pa chen po blo sbyong gi gnas skabs kyi dgos pa bzhi ni/ skyid kyi kha gnon yin/

sdug gi mjug mthud yin/ gcig pur sdod na skyo rogs yin/ na na nad g.yog bya ba yin gsung / de'ang 'di ltar chos 'di lta bu zhig med na/ en zhig skyid skyid 'dra na mi bya dgu bya 'dod nas yong bas/ khyod 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin yin pa la skyid snyam pa de log shes yin pas de skye na gang na skye/ gnas na gang na gnas/ 'gag na gar 'gag kha dog dang dbyibs ji ltar 'dug bltas pas rang bzhin med par shes pas skyid kyi kha gnon yin/ chos 'di lta bu zhig med na/ sdug bsngal byung ba dang nga la 'di 'dra zhig yong ba snyam nas yi mug ste/ sdug bsngal je cher 'gro ba yin pa la blo sbyong 'di yod tsa na/ spyir sdug bsngal thams cad kyi rtsa ba bdag tu 'dzin pa 'di yin/ des na khyed rang gis phung po 'di la bdag tu bzung bas lan pa yin te/ sdug bsngal gyi rgyu cha rkyen tshogs pas lan/ 'ben ma btsugs na mda' mi 'phog tho ma brtsigs na bya mi 'bab/ dpe de bzhin du bdag tu ma bzung na sdug bsngal yong don med pa la khyed rang gis bdag tu bzung bas lan pa yin/ snying tshim/ bdag tu ma bzung na sdug bsngal 'di 'dra yong don ci yod/ sa rdo ri brag dang nam mkha' stong pa la sdug bsngal yod dam snyam du byas pas sdug bsngal de zhi nas 'gro ste/ sdug gi mjug mthud yin/ gcig pur sdod na skyo rogs yin te/ chos 'di lta bu zhig med na/ gcig pur sdod mi tshugs te/ khang par bsdad na phyir 'gro snying 'dod/ phyir bsdad na khang par 'gro snying 'dod nas yong ba la/ chos 'di 'dra ba zhig yod na/ spyir 'gro ba'i sdug thams cad skyed par byed pa'i rtsa ba bdag tu 'dzin pa 'di yin te/ rang bzhin grub pa med pa zhig la nga bdag tu bzung bas sdug tu bcug pa yin pas/ da yang gang legs la thong / byug legs la thong snyam du bya/ khams gsum 'khor ba'i sems can 'di rnams cir mi 'ong min/

pha ma drin can sha stag yin pas sems can rnams kyi sdug bsngal rang gi snying khong du len/ rang gi dge ba dang bde ba sems can la bsngo/ de gnyis phar log tshur log tu bsgoms pas 'di'i don zhig myong tsa na/ nyin thung mtshan thung la cha ba yin pas/ gcig pur sdod na skyo rogs yin/ na na nad g.yog yin te/ blo sbyong 'di med na na tsha zhig byung na/ nad g.yog kun la'ang mi mgu/ 'dis nga la 'di bas drag pa zhig byed thang ba la/ 'di la nga drin che ba yin te snyam nas yus kyis brgyal nas yong ba yin pa la/ blo sbyong 'di yod tsa na/ khyod na ba sus kyang ma lan/ khyod rang gis bdag tu bzung bas lan pa yin/ bdag du ma bzung na na tsha yong don med/ khyod la nad g.yog byas pas phan na de snga phan chad nad g.yog thob par byas pa la tshad med/ sman 'di ma 'gams bya ba med/ rim grol 'di ma byas bya ba med/ dpyad byas pa la lhag ma lus pa med de 'khor ba las ma thar/ da res thul gyis brlag tu chug cig snying tshim bdag tu 'dzin pa 'di ci brlag la thong / 'di ma brlag na sangs rgyas 'thob mi srid gsung / de khyed rang gis lus la bdag tu bzung bas lan pa yin snyam du bsgom pas/ gzhan la nga rgyal bskyed sa med par 'gro ba yin pas na na nad g.yog yin bya ba yin gsung / theg pa chen po blo sbyong gi lus ngag yid gsum gyi 'khyer so/ sdug bsngal byung na kun gyi blang / /dge ba byung na tshogs su bsngo/ /lus ngag sgyu ma brag cha bzhin/ /'od gsal sems la 'gro 'ong med/ /bya ba gsungs pas/ dang po la gnyis te/ nye rim nas blang ba dang / che rim nas blang ba'o/ /dang po ni/ pha ma nye du 'brel ba'i sdug bsngal thams cad da lta nyid du bdag la smin par gyur cig sdug bsngal de thams cad rgyun chad par gyur cig snyam du bsgom/ gnyis pa ni/ dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal thams cad bdag la smin par gyur la/ sdug bsngal de thams cad rgyun chad par gyur cig snyam du bsgom/

de nas yi dwags/ dud 'gro/ lha ma yin/ lha mi thams cad kyi blang ba'o/ /dge ba byung na tshogs su bsngos la/ dge ba'i rtsa ba ci byung yang bdag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di thams cad pha ma gnyis dang / rigs drug gi sems can thams cad la smin par gyur cig sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan/ sdug bsngal dang bral bar gyur cig snyam du bsgom/ lus ngag sgyu ma brag ca bzhin bya ba lus sgyu ma dang 'dra ste/ sgyu ma mkhan pos sngags dang rdzas kyi nus pa la brten nas ltad mo ba'i mig la sbyor sngags btab nas/ sgyu ma sprul pa sna tshogs byed pa zhig snang yang bden par mi 'dzin/ snang ba nyid kyi dus na yang grub pa med la/ rtag chad gnyis dang bral ba snang ba tsam po des mtshon bya'i don rang gi lus 'di la tshur mtshon nas bsgoms pas/ snang la rang bzhin med par bsgom/ ngag brag cha dang 'dra ste/ brag cha yod pa'i brag de lung pa gcong rong dog pa/ brag tshang ring ba/ mkhregs pa gcig la/ a ce brag ca lha mo byas tsa na/ ji skad bos pa bzhin lan 'debs/ yod byas brag ca yin/ med byas bsnyon med du byung / snang ba tsam po des ngag lhang lhang po 'di la mtshon nas bsgom pas brag cha dang khyad par med par thongs nas snang la rang bzhin med par bsgom/ 'od gsal sems la 'gro 'ong med bya ba/ 'od gsal gyi sems 'dir song bya ba med/ 'dir gnas bya ba med/ 'dir 'gags bya ba med/ skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral ba ci'i ngo bor yang ma grub pa nam mkha' lta bu'o/ /de ltar lus sgyu ma dang 'dra/ ngag brag cha dang 'dra/ sems la rang bzhin grub pa med pas nam mkha' lta bur rang bzhin med pa stong pa nyid kyi ngang du lhan gyis 'jog pa yin gsungs/ ༈ /lnga pa bla ma rnams kyi gdams pa dang / blo sbyong gzhan rnams kyang phyogs tsam mtshon te bstan pa la mang du yod pa las/ re zhig bla ma gser gling pas jo bo la gdams pa blo sbyong sems pa'i rim pa zhes pa la le'u bzhi yod pa'i/

dang po las/ 'khor ba'i nags su dka' thub bzod/ /skye ba spangs te rang 'dod 'joms/ /mi 'dod 'jigs pas mi brdzi ba'i/ /dpa' bo rnams la gus btud nas/ /bde gshegs lam srol bskyang ba'i phyir/ /rgyal bu snying stobs chen po ltar/ /gzhan don 'ba' zhig ram bsams nas/ /bdag gzhan nges par brje bar bya/ /zhes dang / kwa ye thog ma med dus nas/ /da dung bdag rgyud ma thul bas/ /gshis ngan bdud kyi khang pa na/ /nyon mongs las kyi pho nya 'khor/ /khyod kyis pha ma ma bsams pas/ /sems can thams cad sdug bsngal kyang / /da dung bag phebs bde gyur te/ /gnyen po'i go cha mi gyon ang / /de ni gyod brdal chen po yin/ /phyin chad ldog pa'i go ba long / /bdag rgyud 'gong po ma thul na/ /pha ma'i srog la 'brab bo a/ /rang gi bde skyid 'joms so a/ /'khor ba'i gting rdor mchi'o a/ /zhes so/ /le'u gnyis pa las/ nyon mongs rnam rtog skyes pa'i tshe/ /rgya khras bye'u ded pa ltar/ /dmigs su bskor la bkar ded gyis/ /lag tu zin tshe brlag par gyis/ /ngan rtog snying la zhen pa'i tshe/ /dgra rkun ngos 'dzin byed pa ltar/ /dbyibs dang spu ris chod mdzod la/ /phyin chad rtog pa med par gyis/ /bzang rtog dgra ru langs pa'i tshe/ /gshed ma bur rdzus zin pa ltar/ /zin ma thag tu mgo gnon la/ /srog chod ldog pa med par gyis/ /zhes so/ /le'u gsum pa las/ nga'o bya ba mgo skor yin/ /dgos zhes bya ba ngo dga' yin/ /gzhan ma zhes pa dgra tshig yin/ /mi dgos zhes pa bar chad yin/ /bdag gzhan zhes pa 'byed tshig yin/ /chags sdang zhes pa 'khrugs pa yin/ /de 'dra'i rnam dbye su byed pa/ /de ni zab mo'i chos las nyams/ /mkhas pa dgra bo 'joms 'dod na/ /dang por nga bdag khyad du bsad/ /gang gis skur pa btab gyur kyang / /de la dag tshangs rnams mi bya/ /gang gis gnod pa bskyal gyur kyang / /kha 'dzin gshags 'debs yong mi bya/

/lus srog longs spyod phral gyur kyang / /rang gis bsags pas lan no zhes/ /lhag par rang la snying tshim bgrang / /gang gis 'dre gdon rbad gyur kyang / /de la 'khu 'phrig mi bya ste/ /gzhan gyi bsam pa tshim par bya/ /mi phod bsam pa brdzi ba ste/ /snying dang 'dra ba'i 'khor la sogs/ /sha la brtse bas phrogs gyur kyang / /rang la gal med snying tshim bgrang / /phan btags drin lan log 'jal tshe/ /skad cig tsam yang mi 'khrugs par/ /bzod bskul bka' drin dran par bya/ /zhes dang / shes pa mi dga' skyo ba na/ /rang la gshags 'debs 'di ltar bya/ /khyod kyi gshis spyod 'di 'dra na/ /gnas mal 'di yang yang rab yin/ /blo sems 'di kun bde mo yin/ /gzhan du khyed kyi sdug sran 'dis/ /dmyal bar ma skyes kha rje che/ /btso bsreg ma myong kha rje che/ /yi dwags bkres skom grong khyer du/ /bskal bar ma skyes kha rje che/ /mi gtsang srin po'i grong khyer du/ /'dam rdzab chen por rab 'phyo zhing / /bskal bar ma skyes kha rje che/ /gzhan yang 'jigs pa rab bsams shing / /bdag la khrel bdas chen po bya/ /lto la gyong bskur dka' thub bya/ /gos la gyong bskur dman cha blang / /bde skyid khyad bsad gnyen po bsgom/ /bya byed lings bskyur byar med bsten/ /ci byed byang chub grogs su bsgyur/ /zhes so/ /le'u bzhi pa las/ /gtam 'di nyon dang bdag 'dzin can/ /las 'di soms dang khur po can/ /skye ba gtan gyi so nams de/ /tshe thung 'di la bsgrub dgos na/ /long yod bsten pa'i snying med po/ /gdon 'di gang gis brlams pa yin/ /sngar yang skyid 'dod ches pas phung / /de ltar yin mod zur mgo rags/ /da dung gshis ngan ma spangs na/ /rgya 'dis shin tu phung ba yin/ /da dung gzhan don ma bsams par/ /nga sgos 'ba' zhig bsten byas na/ /rang gzhan thams cad mgo bskor nas/ /mnar med gnas su nges par 'jug /tshe 'di'i kha 'dzin gshags 'debs kyis/

/'dre rtog zur mgo su bas rags/ /na tsha sdug bsngal su bas mang / /gzer zug sdug bsngal nad du che/ /tsha grang sdug bsngal dmyal ba 'dra/ /dbul phongs sdug bsngal su bas che/ /bkres skom 'jigs skrag yi dwags 'dra/ /zhe sdang gdug rtsub su bas che/ /dug sbrul khyi smyon nyid dang mtshungs/ /yod na yod pas skyong phyir sdug /med na med pas tshol phyir 'khyams/ /gang ltar byas kyang sdug bsngal g.yos/ /ji ltar byas kyang skabs don stor/ /rtsa ba bdag 'dzin ches pas lan/ /sdug sran snying rus chung bas lan/ /byams pa'i zhing sa ral bas lan/ /snying rje'i rtsa ba chad pas lan/ /sems bskyed dge ba stor bas lan/ /ma rabs grogs la bsten pas lan/ /de rnams thams cad 'das pa'i chos/ /'dun ma brlag zin yar la chod/ /da ni su la'ang re ma che/ /phyi nang gang la'ang dogs ma 'cha'/ /don med rtog pa'i sngun ma bsu/ /sngar byas dran pa'i rjes ma bcad/ /bdag 'dzin byed ri zhe mna' skyol/ /ngan gshags byed ri zhe mna' skyol/ /mi la 'dzugs ri zhe mna' skyol/ /'dod yon sems re zhe mna' skyol/ /jo bo sems can mar soms la/ /sdug byur thams cad rang gis khur/ /bub kha thams cad rang gis long / /khrel bdas chen po rang la gyis/ /soms shig soms shig 'jigs pa soms/ /zlog cig sngar byas las ngan bzlog /de ltar nyon mongs rab chod la/ /phyi nas dus skabs thams cad du/ /bdag 'di'i sdug kha ma gzung zhig /las ngan gsog na khrom du sgrog /ngo lkog byed na kha sma phob/ /nang yan gyis la nang mtshang shig /spyod ngan dgug la the les thob/ /gtsang rtog skyes tshe mdze ros 'dul/ /gdon rtog skyes tshe gnyan dgu 'grims/ /skyug bro skyes tshe rnag khrag 'jibs/ /kha rgyangs ma che bdag 'dzin skyungs/ /byin rlabs ma zhu 'dre la byin/ /mthu bo che la blo ma gtad/ /mo bon dag la blo mi dbab/ /drag sngags dag la sems mi gtad/

/rdzas dang ling ga rang la bya/ /'dre gdon nad kyis btab pa na/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa la sogs pa'i/ /khro bo thams cad phyir la khyed/ /ma hā kā la la sogs pa'i/ /gtum po thams cad pha tshad khyed/ /nga ni de ring lan chags 'jal/ /srung skyob ra mda' sbron ri shi/ /de ring 'khor 'das shan shan 'byed/ /'dus shig 'dus shig sha za dang / /dbugs len thams cad rtsa 'dir 'dus/ /bsha' bshu'i rogs la sleb par shog /sha bgos rogs la sleb par shog /khyed rnams nga yi pha ma yin/ /bu yi sha khrag rol du shog /khyed rnams drin can pha ma yin/ /de ring bzang lan len du shog /sngon chad lus sems gces par bzung / /rgyu des da dung 'khor bar 'khyams/ /sngon chad bya dga' rang gis khyer/ /rgyu des da dung na tshas btab/ /sngon chad gzhan la gnod pa bskyal/ /rgyu des khur po ri bas lci/ /sngon chad byas pa'i 'gyod lugs la/ /da ni khu 'phrig za ri shi /da ni lan chags ston mo 'gyed/ /mgron rigs srid rtse man chad nas/ /dmyal khams bco brgyad yan chad na/ /thams cad 'dir shog sha khrag rol/ /spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu ga nas/ /rkang mthil sor mo yan chad la/ /kho bo zhen chags mi byed kyis/ /thams cad bag phob tshim par zo/ /zhi bar gyis shig brlag bar gyis/ /phung bar gyis shig rtsa ba chod/ /choms choms myogs myogs bdag la ya/ /shags shags tshal tshal bdag la ya/ /rbad rbad thum thum bdag la ya/ /hūm̐ dza:phyis 'di med par gyis/ /'khor ba'i 'khor lo rgyun chod cig /las ngan phung po rab thor cig /sngon chad 'di ni gces par bzung / /da ni 'di nyid brlag par mdzod/ /ma rung lhags pa'i mthu stobs can/ /sha khrag rol pa'i gdug pa can/ /dbugs len gshed po sa ma ya/ /khyed kyis bdag 'di choms par gyis/ /khyed kyis bdag 'di chom pa na/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas rnams las lhag /khyed kyis bdag 'di ma choms na/ /rang rang las kyis brlag par 'gyur/

/da ni shes nas 'jigs pa yi/ /tshogs rdzogs 'ching ba grol bar 'gyur/ /de las grol bar ma gyur na/ /'dir tshogs gshed ma thams cad kyis/ /rlung dang mkhris pa bad kan dang / /'dus pa nad kyi phung po dang / /mi bzod sdug bsngal drag po thong / /snang yul srid pa 'khor 'das na/ /mi 'dod ji snyed yod pa rnams/ /thams cad bdag gi steng du thongs/ /'gro kun nyon mongs las dang ni/ /sdug bsngal srid pa khegs par gyis/ /nges par sems can thams cad kyi/ /sdug bsngal rang gi snying nang du/ /da lta nyid du smin par shog /rgyu des 'gro ba ma lus pa/ /las ngan rgyu 'bras drungs phyung nas/ /spangs pa phun sum tshogs par shog /bdag la yod pa'i dge ba rnams/ /thams cad 'gro ba yongs la bsngo/ /rgyu des 'gro ba ma lus pa/ /rtogs pa phun sum tshogs par shog /de ltar 'gro ba thams cad kyis/ /spangs rtogs phun tshogs thob gyur te/ /byams dang snying rje chen po'i dpal/ /chos sku nyag gcig thob pa na/ /de las byung ba'i tshogs gnyis kyis/ /bdag nyid 'khor bar rag la lus/ /gang yang byang chub ma thob par/ /myong 'gyur nyon mongs rgyu 'bras rnams/ /tshe 'dir rgyud la smin par shog /tshe 'di'i nyon mongs rgyu 'bras rnams/ /da lo nyid la smin par shog /de yang zla ba 'di la shog /de yang de ring nyid la shog /de yang skad cig 'di la shog /de ring gzer thung la sogs pa'i/ /zug gzer drag po myong ba'i tshe/ /nad 'di 'gro ba yongs kyi nad/ /sgos khur nyid du blangs pa yin/ /da ni thog tu phebs pa yin/ /gtong len gnad du song ba yin/ /a la la ho nga re dga'/ /nges par sems can bde ste mchi/ /sdug bsngal bdag gis len pa yin/ /da ni go re bcad do zhes/ /na tsha skyes pa tsam gyis kyang / /'os med na tsha 'dus pa yin/ /na go bdag gis chod pa yin/ /tsha go bdag gis chod pa yin/ /bkres skom 'khyags go chod pa yin/

/lus la na tsha skyes gyur kyang / /sems kyi dga' ba 'phel bar bya/ /zhes 'byung ste rgyas par de nyid las shes par bya'o/ /yang jo bos bla ma ngharma rakṣi ta la zhus pa'i blo sbyong mtshon cha'i 'khor lo dang / rma bya dug 'joms gnyis las/ dang po mtshon cha'i 'khor lo las/ /lus la mi bzod na tsha byung ba'i tshe/ /'gro ba'i lus la gnod pa bskyal ba yi/ /las ngan mtshon cha rang la 'khor ba yin/ /da ni na tsha ma lus rang la blang / /rang gi sems la sdug bsngal byung ba'i tshe/ /nges par gzhan gyi sems rgyud dkrugs pa yi/ /las ngan mtshon cha rang la 'khor ba yin/ /zhes sogs rgyas par gsungs nas/ /mdor na mi 'dod thog tu bab pa rnams/ /mgar ba rang gi ral gris bsad pa ltar/ /las ngan mtshon cha rang la 'khor ba yin/ /ngan song gnas su sdug bsngal myong ba yang / /mda' mkhan rang gi mda' yis bsad pa ltar/ /las ngan mtshon cha rang la 'khor ba yin/ /khyim gyi sdug bsngal thog tu bab pa yang / /bskyangs pa'i bu tshas pha ma bsad pa ltar/ /las ngan mtshon cha rang la 'khor ba yin/ /da ni rtag par rab tu 'byung bar rigs/ /zhes gsungs te las gsog pa yang nyon mongs pa'i dbang gis yin zhing / nyon mongs pa thams cad kyang rtsa ba bdag 'dzin gyis bskyed par dgongs nas/ /de ltar lags pas dgra bo bdag gis zin/ /'jab nas bslu ba'i chom rkun bdag gis zin/ /rab du brdzus nas bslu ba'i zog po 'di/ /e ma bdag 'dzin 'di yin the tshom med/ /'khor ba'i nags su rang dbang ma mchis pas/ /las kyi mtshon cha thogs nas rgyugs byed pa/ /bdag 'dzin 'gong po zhes bya'i gdug rtsub can/ /rang gzhan phung du 'jug pa'i dam nyams khug /khug cig khug cig khro bo gshin rje'i gshed/ /rgyob zhig rgyob zhig dgra bdag snying la bsnun/ /phung byed rtog pa'i mgo la chems se chem/ /dgra bdag gshed ma'i snying la mā ra ya/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gzhan yang / ngan song gsum du sdug la bskyal gyur kyang /

/bred mi shes par rgyu la rgyugs pa yi/ /phung byed rtog pa'i mgo la chems se chem/ /dgra bdag gshed ma'i snying la mā ra ya/ /zhes sogs rgyas par gsungs nas/ /ngo tsha'i gnas la ngo tshar mi byed par/ /ngo mi tsha la ngo tshar byed pa yi/ /phung byed rtog pa'i mgo la chems se chem/ /dgra bdag gshed ma'i snying la mā ra ya/ /byas na rung ba gcig kyang mi byed par/ /mi rigs bya ba thams cad byed pa yi/ /phung byed rtog pa'i mgo la chems se chem/ /dgra bdag gshed ma'i snying la mā ra ya/ /e ma bdag lta'i 'gong po 'joms mdzad pa'i/ /bde gshegs chos kyi sku mnga' mthu stobs can/ /bdag med las kyi mtshon cha dbyug to can/ /the tshom med par klad la lan gsum bskor/ /rngams stabs chen pos dgra 'di bsgral du gsol/ /shes rab chen pos rtog ngan gzhom du gsol/ /snying rje chen pos las la bskyab tu gsol/ /nges par bdag 'di brlag par mdzad du gsol/ /'khor ba pa la sdug bsngal ci mchis pa/ /bdag 'dzin 'di la nges par spung du gsol/ /gang la nyon mongs dug lnga ci mchis pa/ /rigs mthun 'di la nges par spung du gsol/ /'di ltar nges pa'i rtsa ba ma lus pa/ /the tshom med par rig pas ngos zin kyang / /da dung 'di yi kha zin gshags 'debs na/ /'dzin mkhar de nyid brlag par mdzad du gsol/ /zhes pa ni bdag tu 'dzin pa'i skyon dang nyes dmigs rgyas par bsams nas/ de gzhom pa'i phyir yi dam gyi lha la gsol ba 'debs pa'o/ /da ni rang nyid kyis kyang bdag gces par 'dzin pa spong zhing gzhan gces par 'dzin pa bskyed pa ni/ da ni le lan thams cad gcig la bda'/ /skye bo yongs la bka' drin che bar bsgom/ /gzhan gyi mi 'dod bdag gi rgyud la blang / /bdag gi dge rtsa 'gro ba yongs la bsngo/ /zhes dang / rigs mthun skye rgu yongs kyi sdug bsngal rnams/ /skyid 'dod bdag gi steng du spung bar bya/ /gal te rang 'dod 'khri ba zhugs pa'i tshe/

/bzlog la rang gi bde skyid 'gro la sbyin/ /zhes dang / nam zhig bdag dang pha mar gyur pa rnams/ /'og min gnas su byang chub ma thob bar/ /'gro ba drug tu las kyis 'khyams na yang / /phan tshun gcig sems gcig gis 'dzin par shog /de tshe 'gro ba gcig gi don du yang / /ngan song gsum du bdag gis yongs zhugs nas/ /sems dpa' chen po'i spyod pa ma nyams par/ /ngan song sdug bsngal bdag gis 'drongs par shog /de ma thag tu dmyal ba'i srung ma rnams/ /bdag la bla ma'i 'du shes skyes gyur nas/ /mtshon cha dag kyang me tog char du gyur/ /gnod pa med par zhi bde 'phel bar shog /ngan song ba yang mngon shes gzungs thob nas/ /lha mi'i lus blangs byang chub sems bskyed de/ /bdag gi drin lan chos kyis sob par shog /bdag ni bla mar bzung nas bsten par shog /de tshe mtho ris 'gro ba thams cad kyang / /bdag dang mtshungs par bdag med rab bsgoms nas/ /srid dang zhi bar rnam par mi rtog par/ /mnyam pa nyid du ting 'dzin bsgom par shog /mnyam pa nyid du rang ngo 'phrod par shog /de ltar byas na dgra 'di choms par 'gyur/ /de ltar byas na rnam rtog choms 'gyur te/ /mi rtog ye shes bdag med goms gyur nas/ /gzugs sku'i rgyu 'bras ci ste thob mi 'gyur/ /kwa ye de dag thams cad rten 'brel yin/ /rten 'brel ltos pa rang tshugs med pa yin/ /phar bsgyur tshur bsgyur brdzun snang sgyu ma yin/ /mgal me bzhin du snang ba'i gzugs brnyan yin/ /zhes sogs don dam byang chub kyi sems bsgom tshul yang rgyas par gsungs nas/ /mjug tu/ de ltar kun rdzob byang chub sems dang ni/ /don dam byang chub sems la sbyang ba yis/ /tshogs gnyis bar chad med par mthar phyin nas/ /don gnyis phun sum tshogs pa thob par shog /ces gsungs/ blo sbyong rma bya dug 'joms la le'u lnga yod pa'i dang po las/ rgyal bu thams cad sgrol du gyur pa na/

/bu dang bu mo rgyal srid byin pa ltar/ /shin tu 'phreng ba'i 'khor dang longs spyod sogs/ /phangs pa med par yongs su gtang bar bya/ /rgyal bu snying stobs chen por gyur pa na/ /stag mo rang gi sha yis bsos pa ltar/ /shin tu gces pa'i sgyu lus phung po 'di/ /sha za'i tshogs la dga' bas sbyin par bya/ /rgyal bu byams pa'i stobs su gyur pa na/ /gnod sbyin rang gi khrag gis bsos pa ltar/ /gcad par dka' ba'i snying khrag dron mo 'di/ /khrag 'thung dag la brtse bas sbyin par bya/ /tshong dpon khye'u chu 'bebs gyur ba na/ /bde gshegs mtshan brjod nya rnams drangs pa ltar/ /chos kyis phongs pa'i skye bo thams cad la/ /dam pa chos kyi sbyin pa sbyin par bya/ rgyal bu dge don chen por gyur pa'i tshe/ /ngan don log sgrub thugs rjes bzod pa ltar/ /'khor gyis log bsgrub gshis ngan 'khrugs pa la/ /snying rje chen pos lhag par brtse bar bya/ /byang chub sems dpa' spre 'ur gyur pa na/ /sdig cag khron pa'i gnas nas drangs pa ltar/ /ngan pa dag la phan btags mi shong yang / /bzang lan mi 'dod snying rjes drang bar bya/ /kyi hud pha mar ma gyur su yang med/ /'khor ba'i nags na bde ba skad cig med/ /ces so/ /le'u gnyis pa las/ /nyon mongs dug lnga lam du slong tshul sogs gsungs nas/ gzhan gyi blo la sna tshogs kun don kyang / /phugs su gnyen po'i btsun tshugs ma shor bar/ /dge sdig dag gi blang dor srog la bsdo/ /sdug bsngal gyur kyang byang chub dang du blang / /nyin dang mtshan du sdug bsngal gyur na yang / /'khor ba spyi yi nyes dmigs ma bsams na/ /da dung sdug bsngal rgyu la 'jug dogs yod/ /de phyir las kyi nyes dmigs snying la gzir/ /de lta yin mod mi 'dod sdug bsngal rnams/ /bdag 'dzin 'joms pa'i gnyen por bsten par bya/ /bdud dmag bye ba dung phyur dgrar langs kyang / /nga'o snyam pa'i 'jigs skrag spang bar bya/

/dbugs len gshed mas srog la brabs gyur kyang / /bdag la phan pa'i rim gro bsten mi bya/ /'di ltar mi 'dod thog tu ma babs na/ /'dod pa'i thabs la nam yang 'jug mi srid/ /mkhas pas spyad na mi 'dod ma lus pa/ /'dod rgu'i 'byung gnas yin pas dang du blang / /'di ltar log sgrub dang du len pa yi/ /sems dpa' rnams kyi go cha ma gyon na/ /'khor ba pa la bde ba yod mi srid/ /de phyir mi 'dod dang du blang bar bya/ /'di ni thub pa chen po'i rnam thar las/ /dam pa rnams kyis bslab par bya ba'i chos/ /zhes so/ /le'u gsum pa las/ /blo ldan gang gis nyin mtshan dus drug tu/ /'khor ba spyi dang sgos kyi skyon rnams la/ /brtags shing dpyad pas shin tu skrag gyur nas/ /so sor thar pa'i sdom pa blangs te bsrung / /rang nyid thar ba'i sdom pa brtan pa na/ /rang nyid ji srid sangs rgyas ma thob bar/ /'gro ba dag kyang pha dang mar bcad de/ /de dag don tu smon 'jug sdom pa blang / /byams brtse'i sems kyis smon pa brtan pa na/ /rang nyid 'khor ba'i nags su sdug bsngal kyang / /cir yang mi sems sdug bsngal gzhan don du/ /srog la bsdos te dka' spyad bsten par bya/ /de tshe log sgrub mtha' yas gang byung yang / /rmi lam sgyu ma chos kyi dbyings su bsam/ /'di ltar goms na thub pa'i rnam thar yin/ /zhes so/ /le'u bzhi pa las/ nye bar 'khor ltar btsun pa'i mthar thug cing / /rta thul bzhin du bag yod mdzes gyur kyang / /byang chub lam la pha ma mi 'dren na/ /rang bde'i thar pa rdog pas brdzi rgyu yin/ /rig pa'i gnas la mkhas pa'i mthu thob cing / /bla ma lta bur kun gyis khur na yang / /bstan pa spyi yi khur chen mi 'khur zhing / /rang 'dod gtsor byed the les gdab bya yin/ /sangs rgyas bstan la dgra bo langs pa na/ /so sor thar la bzang por rlom gyur nas/ /legs par bshad pa'i 'bul mchog mi byed par/

/bstan pa 'jig la 'dam pa mtshang re che/ /'di ltar so sor thar pa phar zhog gi /rang nyid ngan 'gro chen por 'gro dgos kyang / /bstan pa 'jig ba'i dgra bgegs mi sgrol ri/ /dam nyams dgra bgegs pha rol bsgral bya yin/ /nyon mongs las kyis bdas pa'i gti mug can/ /bstan dang sems can spyi la mi sems par/ /rang la gnod par byed pa'i dgra bo la/ /khros nas sngags kyis pha rol sgrol ba de/ /tshul khrims 'chal lam ma 'chal mtshang re che/ /gang yang rgyal ba rnams kyis khrel ba yi/ /rang don las ni rnam pa kun mi bsten/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba rnams kyis bsngags gyur na/ /ji ltar gyur kyang las de bsgrub par rigs/ /mkhyen par mdzod cig blo dang ldan pa rnams/ /lag len thams cad dog mtha' dag nas bya/ /chos dang 'gal ba srog dang bsdos te spang / /spyi la mi gnod ngang la ci phan bya/ /zhes so/ /le'u lnga pa las/ kho bo bde ba can du mi smon zhing / /dben par 'dug la mi dga' zhes sogs gsungs nas/ da ni 'jig rten khams rnams thams cad kyi/ /mthu chen thams cad bdag gi dgrar langs kyang / /go bo'i ba spu tsam yang mi g.yo bar/ /'khor ba'i gnas 'dir go cha bgo bar bya/ 'jig rten dag na shin tu mi 'dod pa/ /ltas ngan sna tshogs dmag tu 'thibs pa rnams/ /dgra bdag gshis ngan rang nyid gzhom pa'i phyir/ /g.yang du len pa'i go cha bgo bar bya/ /'jig rten dag na shin tu mi mkho ba'i/ /las dang nyon mongs sgyu ma'i 'khrugs pa rnams/ /bdag tu 'dzin pa'i srog dang bral ba'i phyir/ /dang du len pa'i go cha bgo bar bya/ /zhes dang / bdag cag 'khor ba 'di ru sdug bsngal bas/ /'di yi lan rtsa rdo rus gtugs pa na/ /rnam rtog snying gi gzhal yas ya gi na/ /nga'o zhes pa'i rgyal po bzhugs pa mthong / /de la le lan bdas shing 'thabs pa na/ /ci zer nga ni thog med dus nas zhugs/ /bdag nyid bdag gi dgra yin su la 'thab/ /bdag nyid mgon yin thams cad su la skyob/

/bya dang mi bya yongs la dpang po rang / /rang gis rang nyid thul na grol bar 'gyur/ /gzhan gyis gzhan zhig 'dul na 'thab rtsod yin/ /a a skye med nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang / /i i 'jigs med spros dang bral ba'i sku/ /oṃ oṃ rnam dag chos skur ngo 'phrod nas/ /kā ru ṇi kas thugs rjes 'dzin par shog /ces te/ rgyas par de dag nyid du shes par bya'o/ /yang bla ma byams pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ blo sbyong mgur du bzhes pa ni/ kwa ye pha mar gyur pa'i 'gro ba ma lus drang ba'i phyir/ /bdag la yod pa'i nyon mongs dug lnga gang dag gis/ /sems can rnams kyi dug lnga ma lus drang bar bya/ /'dod chags la sogs med pa'i dge ba gang yod rnams/ /'gro drug sems can rnams la snyoms par brim par bya/ /na tsha la sogs 'bras bur gyur pa'i sdug bsngal gyis/ /de dang rigs mthun sdug bsngal ma lus drang bar bya/ /na tsha la sogs med pa'i phan bde gang yin de/ /'gro drug sems can rnams la snyoms par brim par bya/ /de ltar byas na rang nyid 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho 'dir/ /skad cig tsam yang 'khyams pa'i go skabs ga la srid/ /'on kyang ji srid byang chub ma thob bar/ /myong 'gyur nyon mongs rgyu 'bras ji snyed pa/ /thams cad skye ba 'di la yongs su rdzogs par bya/ /de yang da lo zla ba 'di la drang bar bya/ /de yang de ring da lta nyid du rdzogs byas nas/ /sdug bsngal brang breng rabs chad tsam zhig zabs su bsten/ /blo 'di 'byongs par gyur cig byams pa'i rnal 'byor la/ /zhes byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems gyer sgom rdo rje'i glur blangs pa 'di byams pa'i rnal 'byor pa bdag gis yun du kha ton byas pa na/ re zhig chu bo gaṅgā'i 'gram du thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa'i bcom ldan 'das byams pa lha'i rgyal po'i cha lugs su bzhugs nas/ byams ba'i rnal 'byor pa can du byon nas 'di skad gsung /

thos pa tsam gyis ngan 'gro'i sdug bsngal sel ba'i glu/ /bsams pa tsam gyis 'khor ba'i ljon pa gcod pa'i glu/ /bsgoms pa tsam gyis byang chub myur du 'byin pa'i glu/ /byams pa snying rje byang chub sems kyi glu 'di mtshar/ /nyon mongs dug lngas dgra bzhin 'joms par rigs na yang / /khyod kyi 'di ltar na ni rgyud la bsten pa mtshar/ /na tsha sdug bsngal kun nas bzod par dka' na yang / /khyod kyis 'di ltar na ni ngo mtshar rmad du byung / /rang don yal bar dor nas gzhan don lhur mdzad de/ /rang dbang med par 'khor bar 'khyams pa su yis dka'/ /des na rang don bsam pa skad cig ma 'khris par/ /gzhan gyis mi 'dod bdag gis len pa dam pa yin/ /theg pa chen po'i gsung rab mtha' yas mu med kyang / /'di ru ma 'dus rdul tsam gang yang yod ma yin/ /de phyir rnal 'byor khyod kyis rdo rje'i glu dbyangs 'di/ /thos sam bsam mam sgom pa'am ni bshad kyang rung / /'jig rten lha dang bcas pa'i skyabs gnas dam pa ste/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba rnams kyi thugs kyi nying khu de/ /khyod kyi blo la shar ba ngo mtshar shin tu che/ /zhes shin tu dges pas rdo rje'i glu tshig gi lan du gsungs pa dang / byams pa'i rnal 'byor pa shin tu nyams dga' zhing the tshom gyi mdud pa grol nas dpa' bo chen po rdo rje'i g.yul du zhugs so/ /kye ho/ /'di ltar nyin lan gsum mtshan lan gsum dus dang gnas skabs dran pa brjed pa ma mchis par chos 'di blo la sbyangs shing khams sos rdo rje'i glu blangs pa dang / lha dang klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye'i tshogs dang / sha za dang / srin po la sogs pa ma rang gi bu gcig pu la byams pa bzhin du gus par dbang du 'dus par gyur te/ gzhan yang yul gyi rgyal po dang / blon po dang / btsun mo dang / bram ze dang / khyim bdag dang /

khye'u bu mo dmangs rigs la sogs pa thams cad dbang du 'dus te/ dga' bas rjes su 'brang zhing mthong ba dang thos pa thams cad kyang byams pa'i rang bzhin can du gyur to/ /gzhan yang rta glang po ma he spre'u 'dab chags chu ru skyes pa/ ri'i sems can gcan gzan gyi tshogs tha na grog sbur yan chad 'gro ba rigs drug rang la mi 'jigs shing / bag phebs pa ltar rnal 'byor pa'i drung du 'khod par gyur to/ /de ltar rnal 'byor pa'i thugs kyi dgongs pa la/ bdag gis byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems kyi don yid la byas/ tshig kha ton du byas/ snyan pa rdo rje'i glu blangs pa la brten nas/ thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa'i bcom ldan 'das byams pas zhal mngon sum du bstan/ dgyes pa'i gsung byung nas the tshom gyi drwa ba thams cad bcad/ de la brten nas kho bo bzod pa dang brtson 'grus la sogs pa zla ba yar gyi ngo bzhin du 'phel bar gyur/ de'i dbang gis 'di ltar 'gro ba'i rigs mi mthun pa thams cad kyang / mas bu mthong ba bzhin du bdag la kun dga' bar gyur/ de dag gi bzang lan du bcom ldan 'das byams pa la theg pa chen po'i mchod pa dbul bar dgongs nas rdo rje'i glu blangs pa ni/ thog med dus nas nye bar 'brel pa yi/ /pha mar gyur pa'i sems can ma lus pa/ /byang chub mchog la 'god pa'i yi dam bsam/ /chos 'dis byams pa mgon la mchod par bgyi/ /de tshe rang don skad cig ma 'khris bar/ /gzhan don 'ba' zhig snying la goms par bya/ /'di ni byang chub sgrub ba'i gtso bo yin/ /chos 'dis byams pa mgon la mchod par bgyi/ /bde sdug btang snyoms tshor ba ci byung yang / /byang chub 'byin pa'i grogs su dang du blangs/ /bskal pa du mar bsod nams cig sog kyang / /nyan thos sdar ma'i chos su shor ma gyur/ /chos 'dis byams pa mgon la mchod par bgyi/ /de tsam zhig tu mi 'dod ci byung yang /

/bzod pa'i go cha cung zad shor ma gyur/ /lhag par drin gyis bskyangs pa'i skye bo yis/ /log sgrub byas kyang 'dzum pa'i bzhin gyis bskyangs/ /chos 'dis byams pa mgon la mchod par bgyi/ /sdang ba'i skye bos phyogs nas sdig bsags kyang / /ngan pa'i bsams pa skad cig shor ma gyur/ /snang srid bdud dang lha 'dre dgrar langs kyang / /rang 'dod 'khris pa'i srung skyob byed ma myong / /chos 'dis byams pa mgon la mchod par bgyi/ /nges par 'chi ba'i nad kyis btab gyur kyang / /chos min dag la yid brtan 'cha' ma myong / /ser sna goms pas 'byor ba chung na yang / /log pa'i 'tsho bas lto gos byed ma myong / /chos 'dis byams pa mgon la mchod par bgyi/ /ngan pa'i grogs kyis kun nas bskor na yang / /gnyen po'i rang tshugs gang la'ang skyel ma myong / /mdor na 'gro 'am 'dug gam ci byed kyang / /ma brtags bya ba gang yang byed ma myong / /chos 'dis byams pa mgon la mchod par bgyi/ /de ltar yin mod 'on kyang chos rnams la/ /bden par rtog pa rdul tsam yong ma myong / /'di ni byang chub sgrub pa'i gtso bo yin/ /chos 'dis byams pa mgon la mchod par bgyi/ /de ltar sgrub pa'i mchod pa dam pa 'di/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi bsam pa sbyang ba'i phyir/ /byams pa'i dpung gis yon 'di bzhes su gsol/ /bzhes la blo 'di 'byongs par mdzad du gsol/ /zhes pa'i mchod pa dang / bar snang la mchod pa'i lha mo lnga dang / sgra dang 'od la sogs pa yid du 'ong ba'i mchod pa gzhan yang dpag tu med pa'i rnam pa byung bar gyur to/ /de'i tshe theg pa chen po la blo sbyong ba'i skyes bu dam pa rnams chos 'di ngo mtshar ba'i gnas su rig nas/ 'di'i phyogs su dka' ba spyod pa dang / zhus shing nyams su len pa du ma byung mod/ gtso bor gyur pa ni jo bo rje nyid de/ skyes bu dam pa des rgya bod kyi sa cha la skyes bu don du gnyer ba rnams la ldog khrid du gdams so/

/byams pas/ byams pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ des jo bo rje la'o/ /gzhan yang / thog med brtse bas bskyangs pa yi/ /drin can rnams la snying rje bsam/ /zhes sogs rje btsun bir+wa pa'i blo sbyong dang / jo bos rje btsun ma sgrol ma dang khro gnyer can gnyis la gsan pa gsang sngags lugs gyi blo sbyong ku su lu'i tshogs gsog dang bcas pa dang / skyid na bde ba tshogs su bsngo/ /phan bdes nam mkha' gang bar shog /sdug na kun gyi sdug bsngal khur/ /sdug bsngal rgya mtsho skem par shog /ces pa paṇa chen shākya shrī'i skyid sdug lam khyer dang / rje btsun sgrol ma dang rdo rje phag mo gnyis kyis/ gang byung gis chog na ci byas bde/ /sems bzhag par sdod na phyin kyang chog /blo chos dang 'dres na shi yang rung / /sems skye med rtogs na 'chi rgyu med/ /ces sum pa lo tsā ba la gdams pa'i blo sbyong dang / bka' gdams thor bu pa grub thob lce sgom gyi sems sbyong rnams kyang shes par byas nas nyams su blang zhing / yang byang chub kyi sems la brten nas nyon mongs pa lam du blang ba'i man ngag /'khon sbyang ba'i man ngag /sdig pa sbyang ba'i man ngag 'gro mgon bod du 'byon khar rnam dag gtsug gi nor bu la gdams pa'i blo sbyong dang / mchims chen pos mdzad pa'i blo sbyong thun gcig ma rnams kyang yig chung logs su 'byung ba bzhin shes par bya'o/ /yang bod kyi bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po glang ri thang pa rdo rje seng ge sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas kyi sprul par grags pa des mdzad ba'i blo sbyong tshig rkang brgyad pa ni/ spyir sems can thams cad la yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che ltar bslab pa/ khyad par du gnas gang du sdod rung / grogs su dag 'grogs kyang phyogs thams cad nas rang la dman par blta la/ snying thag pa rus pa'i gting nas gzhan la gus par bya ba la bslab pa'ang / spyod lam thams cad du rang gi rgyud la brtags la nyon mongs pa skyes ma thag btsan thabs su gdong nas bzlog pa bslab pa'ang /

shin tu rang bzhin ngan pa dang sdig pa dang sdug bsngal drag pos non pa rnams la shin tu rnyed par dka' zhing gces par bslab pa'am/ rang la skur ba la sogs pa'i nyes skyon gang byung yang dag tshangs mi bya bar gyong kha rang gis blang ba la bslab pa'am/ rang gis sngar phan btags pa'am/ re che ba'i sa nas yul des mgo bskor dang / gdong med byas na bka' drin che ba'i bsam pas dge ba'i bshes gnyen du bsgom pa la bslab pa'am/ mdor na dngos sam brgyud nas bde ba dang phan par 'dug pa thams cad ma rnams la dbul zhing / ma de dag gi gnod pa dang sdug bsngal thams cad gus pas rang gi snying khong du blang ba la bslab pa'am/ de dag thams cad kyang thabs la nyen 'byung ba srid pas tshe 'di'i rtog pa dang cung zad kyang ma 'dres par bya zhing / chos thams cad sgyu mar shes pa'i blos dngos po gang la'ang ma chags par bslab pa ste/ brgyad po 'di thugs dam gyi gtso bo yin no/ /don de dag smon lam du byas nas 'debs pa/ bdag ni sems can thams cad la/ /yid bzhin nor bu las lhag pa'i/ /don mchog sgrub pa'i bsam pa yis/ /rtag tu gces par 'dzin par shog /gang du su dang 'grogs pa'i tshe/ /bdag nyid kun nas dman lta zhing / /gzhan la bsam pa thag pa yis/ /mchog tu gus par 'dzin par shog /spyod lam kun tu rang rgyud la/ /rtog cing nyon mongs skyes ma thag /bdag gzhan ma rungs byed pas na/ /btsan thabs gdong nas bzlog par shog /rang bzhin ngan pa'i sems can ni/ /sdig sdug drag pos non mthong tshe/ /rin chen gter dang 'phrad pa ltar/ /rnyed par dka' ba'i gces 'dzin shog /bdag la gzhan gyis phrag dog gis/ /gshe skur la sogs mi rigs pa'i/ /gyong kha rang gis len pa dang / /rgyal kha gzhan la 'bul bar shog /gang la bdag gis phan btags pa'i/ /re ba che ba gang zhig gis/ /shin tu mi rigs gnod byas na'ang / /bshes gnyen dam par lta bar shog /mdor na dngos dang brgyud pa yis/

/phan bde ma rnams kun la 'bul/ /ma yi gnod dang sdug bsngal kun/ /gsang bas bdag la len par shog /de dag kun kyang chos brgyad kyi/ /rtog pa'i dri mas ma sbags shing / /chos kun sgyu mar shes pa yis/ /zhen med bcings pa las grol shog /ces pa'i tshul gyis so/ /theg ba chen po blo sbyong gi lus yan lag dang bcas pa'i don cung zad bshad pa 'di ni rang bzo dor te/ rje btsun gong ma'i gsung 'ba' zhig la brten nas dkon mchog 'bangs kyis gangs bu ler sbyar ba'o// //blo sbyong legs bshad kun 'dus kyi brgyud pa ni/ thub ba'i dbang po/ ma pham mgon po/ thogs med sku mched/ grol sde rnam gnyis/ gu ṇa mi tra/ seng ge bzang po/ gang ba spel/ ku sā li che chung / gser gling pa/ a ti sha/ 'brom ston/ pu to ba/ sha ra ba/ 'chad ka ba/ se spyil bu pa/ lha ston 'od zer bla ma/ lha sdings pa byang chub 'bum/ de dbon kun dga' rgya mtsho/ dbu mdzad yon tan dpal/ mkhan bde ba dpal/ mkhan grags pa gzhon nu/ byang sems bsod nams grags pa/ rgyal sras thogs med pa/ mang mkhar tshul khrims dpal/ sems dpa' chen po gzhon nu rgyal mchog /byams chen sku skye/ rje kun dga' bkra shis/ 'phags mchog yon tan rgya mtsho/ gnyug la paṇa chen/ spyan snga ngag dbang chos grags/ brag dgon spyan snga gzhon nu chos dpal bzang po/ rdo rje 'chang pha bong kha pa dpal 'byor lhun grub/ bka' drin mnyam med zur thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol/ des bdag za hor ban+de la bka' drin du stsal lo/ /blo sbyong legs bshad kun 'dus 'chad thabs dang bcas pa 'di nyid mdo khams sde dge lhun grub steng du spar du sgrubs pa dge/ // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 dkon mchog 'bangs/ blo sbyong legs bshad kun 'dus/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
